units.id: mission:FWC Scouting 1|name|16|0
units.english: Scout Kaus Borealis
units.italian: Esplora Kaus Borealis

units.id: mission:FWC Scouting 1|description|17|0
units.english: Travel through the <waypoints> system to determine how strong the Navy presence is there, while JJ works to gather a fleet to attack it.
units.italian: Attraversa il sistema <waypoints> per stabilire quanto è forte la presenza della Marina lì, mentre JJ lavora a radunare una flotta per attaccarla.

units.id: mission:FWC Scouting 1|log|27|0
units.english: Drove the Navy out of Delta Sagittarii with the help of the "Wolf Pack," a militia group in favor of more extreme measures who launched a preemptive strike before the main Free Worlds force arrived. The Free Worlds are now committed to fighting the Republic to a standstill rather than proving their innocence; the defector has been recaptured by the Syndicate and whatever information he had to share is now lost.
units.italian: Hai scacciato la Marina da Delta Sagittarii con l'aiuto del "Branco di Lupi", un gruppo di miliziani favorevole a misure più estreme che ha lanciato un attacco preventivo prima che arrivasse la forza principale delle Free Worlds. Le Free Worlds sono ora impegnate a combattere la Repubblica fino a ridurla all'impotenza invece di dimostrare la propria innocenza; il disertore è stato ripreso dal Sindacato e tutte le informazioni che aveva da condividere sono ormai perdute.

units.id: mission:FWC Scouting 1|It was a close battle, and could have gone very differently if it were not for the Wolf Pack strike that happened before you arrived and that disabled or destroyed the majority of the Navy fleet. You can't help but wonder how the Wolf Pack managed to assemble a large enough fleet to do that sort of damage.|29|0
units.english: It was a close battle, and could have gone very differently if it were not for the Wolf Pack strike that happened before you arrived and that disabled or destroyed the majority of the Navy fleet. You can't help but wonder how the Wolf Pack managed to assemble a large enough fleet to do that sort of damage.
units.italian: È stata una battaglia combattuta, e sarebbe potuta andare molto diversamente senza l'attacco del Branco di Lupi, avvenuto prima del tuo arrivo e che ha messo fuori uso o distrutto la maggior parte della flotta della Marina. Non puoi fare a meno di chiederti come abbia fatto il Branco di Lupi a mettere insieme una flotta abbastanza grande da fare un danno simile.

units.id: mission:FWC Scouting 1|	"Well," says JJ, "the die is cast. It's too late now to wonder what that business with the Syndicate was about; now we're in a fight to the finish with the Republic. And that means we must strike soon, before they have time to bring in more reinforcements. Captain <last>, I'd like you to perform a scouting mission while I'm working on gathering a new fleet. Our next target has to be the Navy base on New Iceland. If we can drive them out of that system, our position will be much better. So, I'd like you to fly through Kaus Borealis and return here to report on their fleet strength. Understood?"|30|0
units.english: "Well," says JJ, "the die is cast. It's too late now to wonder what that business with the Syndicate was about; now we're in a fight to the finish with the Republic. And that means we must strike soon, before they have time to bring in more reinforcements. Captain <last>, I'd like you to perform a scouting mission while I'm working on gathering a new fleet. Our next target has to be the Navy base on New Iceland. If we can drive them out of that system, our position will be much better. So, I'd like you to fly through Kaus Borealis and return here to report on their fleet strength. Understood?"
units.italian: "Beh," dice JJ, "il dado è tratto. È troppo tardi ormai per chiedersi che cosa fosse quella storia con il Sindacato; ora siamo in una lotta all'ultimo sangue con la Repubblica. Il che significa che dobbiamo colpire presto, prima che abbiano il tempo di portare altri rinforzi. Capitano <last>, vorrei che facessi una missione di ricognizione mentre io lavoro a radunare una nuova flotta. Il nostro prossimo obiettivo dev'essere la base della Marina su New Iceland. Se riusciamo a scacciarli da quel sistema, la nostra posizione migliorerà molto. Quindi vorrei che passassi per Kaus Borealis e tornassi qui a riferire sulla consistenza della loro flotta. Chiaro?"

units.id: mission:FWC Scouting 1|	"No problem."|32|0
units.english: "No problem."
units.italian: "Nessun problema."

units.id: mission:FWC Scouting 1|	"Sure, but first, can you tell me how the Wolf Pack was able to do so much damage to the Navy?"|34|0
units.english: "Sure, but first, can you tell me how the Wolf Pack was able to do so much damage to the Navy?"
units.italian: "Certo, ma prima puoi dirmi come ha fatto il Branco di Lupi a fare così tanti danni alla Marina?"

units.id: mission:FWC Scouting 1|	"As I said," says JJ, "they've gathered a surprising number of bounty hunters and others who operate on the fringes of society, and who are sympathetic to our cause."|35|0
units.english: "As I said," says JJ, "they've gathered a surprising number of bounty hunters and others who operate on the fringes of society, and who are sympathetic to our cause."
units.italian: "Come ho detto," dice JJ, "hanno radunato un numero sorprendente di cacciatori di taglie e altra gente che opera ai margini della società, e che simpatizza per la nostra causa."

units.id: mission:FWC Scouting 1|	"One more thing," says Freya, "while you're traveling up North, I wonder if you could help to escort a convoy from the Zeta Aquilae system. There's no huge rush, but they're carrying supplies we need for a new reactor core for the Dreadnoughts, so the sooner you can meet up with them, the sooner the new reactors will be available."|37|0
units.english: "One more thing," says Freya, "while you're traveling up North, I wonder if you could help to escort a convoy from the Zeta Aquilae system. There's no huge rush, but they're carrying supplies we need for a new reactor core for the Dreadnoughts, so the sooner you can meet up with them, the sooner the new reactors will be available."
units.italian: "Un'altra cosa," dice Freya, "mentre sei a nord, mi chiedevo se potessi aiutare a scortare un convoglio dal sistema Zeta Aquilae. Non c'è nessuna fretta estrema, ma trasportano i rifornimenti che ci servono per un nuovo nucleo del reattore per i Dreadnought, quindi prima li incontri, prima avremo i nuovi reattori."

units.id: mission:FWC Attack Kaus Borealis|name|63|0
units.english: Attack Kaus Borealis
units.italian: Attacca Kaus Borealis

units.id: mission:FWC Attack Kaus Borealis|description|64|0
units.english: Destroy the Navy fleet defending Kaus Borealis. The Wolf Pack will attack them first to soften them up.
units.italian: Distruggi la flotta della Marina che difende Kaus Borealis. Il Branco di Lupi li attaccherà per primo per ammorbidirli.

units.id: mission:FWC Attack Kaus Borealis|When you return to New Portland, a sizable Free Worlds fleet is already parked on the landing pads surrounding the spaceport. JJ explains to you, "When the Navy struck and cut our territory in half, a lot of these ships were cut off from their chain of command and just went and sheltered wherever they could. So it took a bit of doing to gather them all together. And now what we need is another stirring victory, or they'll begin to scatter again."|77|0
units.english: When you return to New Portland, a sizable Free Worlds fleet is already parked on the landing pads surrounding the spaceport. JJ explains to you, "When the Navy struck and cut our territory in half, a lot of these ships were cut off from their chain of command and just went and sheltered wherever they could. So it took a bit of doing to gather them all together. And now what we need is another stirring victory, or they'll begin to scatter again."
units.italian: Quando torni su New Portland, una flotta consistente delle Free Worlds è già parcheggiata sulle piazzole intorno allo spazioporto. JJ ti spiega: "Quando la Marina ha attaccato e ha tagliato in due il nostro territorio, molte di queste navi sono rimaste separate dalla loro catena di comando e si sono rifugiate dove potevano. Quindi ci è voluto un po' per radunarle tutte. E ora ci serve un'altra vittoria che dia entusiasmo, o ricominceranno a disperdersi."

units.id: mission:FWC Attack Kaus Borealis|	"Are you saying we risk having members of our militia desert?"|79|0
units.english: "Are you saying we risk having members of our militia desert?"
units.italian: "Stai dicendo che rischiamo che i membri della nostra milizia disertino?"

units.id: mission:FWC Attack Kaus Borealis|	"Well, the fact that they all returned to fight is a good sign."|81|0
units.english: "Well, the fact that they all returned to fight is a good sign."
units.italian: "Beh, il fatto che siano tutti tornati a combattere è un buon segno."

units.id: mission:FWC Attack Kaus Borealis|	"Yes," says JJ, "some of them already have. Think of it from the perspective of a militia member: you signed up to defend one planet against occasional pirates, not to spend years traveling from system to system battling the Navy. Some people have just had enough. This war needs to end, and end soon."|84|0
units.english: "Yes," says JJ, "some of them already have. Think of it from the perspective of a militia member: you signed up to defend one planet against occasional pirates, not to spend years traveling from system to system battling the Navy. Some people have just had enough. This war needs to end, and end soon."
units.italian: "Sì," dice JJ, "alcuni l'hanno già fatto. Mettiti nei panni di un miliziano: ti sei arruolato per difendere un pianeta da qualche pirata ogni tanto, non per passare anni a spostarti da un sistema all'altro combattendo la Marina. Alcuni ne hanno semplicemente abbastanza. Questa guerra deve finire, e finire presto."

units.id: mission:FWC Attack Kaus Borealis|	"Well," says JJ, "at least some of them returned to fight. But many of them didn't. Think of it from the perspective of a militia member: you signed up to defend one planet against occasional pirates, not to spend years traveling from system to system battling the Navy. Some people have just had enough. This war needs to end, and end soon."|87|0
units.english: "Well," says JJ, "at least some of them returned to fight. But many of them didn't. Think of it from the perspective of a militia member: you signed up to defend one planet against occasional pirates, not to spend years traveling from system to system battling the Navy. Some people have just had enough. This war needs to end, and end soon."
units.italian: "Beh," dice JJ, "almeno alcuni sono tornati a combattere. Ma molti no. Mettiti nei panni di un miliziano: ti sei arruolato per difendere un pianeta da qualche pirata ogni tanto, non per passare anni a spostarti da un sistema all'altro combattendo la Marina. Alcuni ne hanno semplicemente abbastanza. Questa guerra deve finire, e finire presto."

units.id: mission:FWC Attack Kaus Borealis|	"Well, we can't exactly conquer the Republic. Shouldn't we try diplomacy?"|91|0
units.english: "Well, we can't exactly conquer the Republic. Shouldn't we try diplomacy?"
units.italian: "Beh, non possiamo certo conquistare la Repubblica. Non dovremmo provare la diplomazia?"

units.id: mission:FWC Attack Kaus Borealis|	"It sounds to me like we need to make a convincing enough show of strength that Parliament will agree to a ceasefire."|93|0
units.english: "It sounds to me like we need to make a convincing enough show of strength that Parliament will agree to a ceasefire."
units.italian: "A me sembra che dobbiamo mostrare una forza abbastanza convincente perché il Parlamento accetti un cessate il fuoco."

units.id: mission:FWC Attack Kaus Borealis|	"Yes," says JJ, "it will have to be a diplomatic solution in the end. But we must negotiate that solution from a position of strength, not weakness. And that means driving the Navy out of our territory."|96|0
units.english: "Yes," says JJ, "it will have to be a diplomatic solution in the end. But we must negotiate that solution from a position of strength, not weakness. And that means driving the Navy out of our territory."
units.italian: "Sì," dice JJ, "alla fine dovrà essere una soluzione diplomatica. Ma dobbiamo negoziarla da una posizione di forza, non di debolezza. E questo significa scacciare la Marina dal nostro territorio."

units.id: mission:FWC Attack Kaus Borealis|	"Precisely," says JJ, "and the only way to do that is to drive the Navy out of our territory. And if that isn't enough... we have plans for that contingency as well."|99|0
units.english: "Precisely," says JJ, "and the only way to do that is to drive the Navy out of our territory. And if that isn't enough... we have plans for that contingency as well."
units.italian: "Esattamente," dice JJ, "e l'unico modo per farlo è scacciare la Marina dal nostro territorio. E se non dovesse bastare... abbiamo dei piani anche per quell'eventualità."

units.id: mission:FWC Attack Kaus Borealis|	"So, now we attack Kaus Borealis?" you ask.|102|0
units.english: "So, now we attack Kaus Borealis?" you ask.
units.italian: "Quindi ora attacchiamo Kaus Borealis?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FWC Attack Kaus Borealis|	"That's right," he says. "Once again, the Wolf Pack will go in first and soften them up, then you and your ships will clean up. I've already given the Wolf Pack orders to attack, so please head straight to Kaus Borealis so you can join the fray before they have time to recover."|103|0
units.english: "That's right," he says. "Once again, the Wolf Pack will go in first and soften them up, then you and your ships will clean up. I've already given the Wolf Pack orders to attack, so please head straight to Kaus Borealis so you can join the fray before they have time to recover."
units.italian: "Esatto," dice. "Ancora una volta il Branco di Lupi andrà avanti per primo e li ammorbidirà, poi tu e le tue navi farete pulizia. Ho già dato al Branco di Lupi l'ordine di attaccare, quindi vai dritto a Kaus Borealis per unirti alla mischia prima che abbiano il tempo di riprendersi."

units.id: mission:FWC Attack Kaus Borealis|dialog|107|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but there are still Navy ships circling overhead. You should take off and help finish them off.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ci sono ancora navi della Marina che girano là sopra. Dovresti decollare e aiutare a finirle.

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1|name|181|0
units.english: Scout out Cebalrai
units.italian: Esplora Cebalrai

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1|description|182|0
units.english: Scout out the Navy presence in the <waypoints> system, then report back to Tomek on <planet>.
units.italian: Esplora la presenza della Marina nel sistema <waypoints>, poi riferisci a Tomek su <planet>.

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1|log|192|0
units.english: Captured the Kaus Borealis system from the Navy, even though the locals are still loyal to the Republic. Also, learned that the Wolf Pack ships have been using nuclear missiles, and that is why they were so effective in decimating the Navy fleet.
units.italian: Hai conquistato il sistema Kaus Borealis strappandolo alla Marina, anche se la gente del posto è ancora leale alla Repubblica. Hai anche scoperto che le navi del Branco di Lupi usano missili nucleari, ed è per questo che sono stati così efficaci nel decimare la flotta della Marina.

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1|As you bring your ship in for a landing, it occurs to you that this is the first time that you have fought a battle for a Republic star system that had not voluntarily decided to join the Free Worlds, and you are not sure what to do next. Fortunately, soon more Free Worlds ships begin arriving, and one of them is carrying Alondo. Tomek is with him. "Hi there, <first>," says Tomek. "Bet you didn't expect to see me again, huh?"|194|0
units.english: As you bring your ship in for a landing, it occurs to you that this is the first time that you have fought a battle for a Republic star system that had not voluntarily decided to join the Free Worlds, and you are not sure what to do next. Fortunately, soon more Free Worlds ships begin arriving, and one of them is carrying Alondo. Tomek is with him. "Hi there, <first>," says Tomek. "Bet you didn't expect to see me again, huh?"
units.italian: Mentre porti la nave ad atterrare, ti rendi conto che questa è la prima volta che combatti per un sistema stellare della Repubblica che non aveva deciso spontaneamente di unirsi alle Free Worlds, e non sei sicuro di che cosa fare adesso. Per fortuna, presto cominciano ad arrivare altre navi delle Free Worlds, e una di queste trasporta Alondo. Tomek è con lui. "Ciao, <first>," dice Tomek. "Scommetto che non ti aspettavi di rivedermi, eh?"

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1|	Alondo says, "<first>, I'll leave you and Tomek to catch up. I should go talk to the governor immediately. There's no way the locals will have failed to notice the nuclear explosions happening in space right over their heads."|195|0
units.english: Alondo says, "<first>, I'll leave you and Tomek to catch up. I should go talk to the governor immediately. There's no way the locals will have failed to notice the nuclear explosions happening in space right over their heads."
units.italian: Alondo dice: "<first>, vi lascio a voi due, così vi aggiornate. Io devo andare subito a parlare con il governatore. Non c'è modo che la gente del posto non si sia accorta delle esplosioni nucleari nello spazio proprio sopra la loro testa."

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1|	"What? We weren't using nukes, just conventional weapons."|197|0
units.english: "What? We weren't using nukes, just conventional weapons."
units.italian: "Come? Non stavamo usando testate nucleari, solo armi convenzionali."

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1|	"Wait, is that what the Wolf Pack was using?"|199|0
units.english: "Wait, is that what the Wolf Pack was using?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, è questo che stava usando il Branco di Lupi?"

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1|	"Yes," says Tomek, "but the Wolf Pack was using nukes." Seeing the incredulous look on your face, he says, "Well, how did you think they were doing all that damage? You thought they had some massive battle fleet hidden somewhere that no one knows about?"|202|0
units.english: "Yes," says Tomek, "but the Wolf Pack was using nukes." Seeing the incredulous look on your face, he says, "Well, how did you think they were doing all that damage? You thought they had some massive battle fleet hidden somewhere that no one knows about?"
units.italian: "Sì," dice Tomek, "ma il Branco di Lupi usava testate nucleari." Vedendo la tua espressione incredula, dice: "Beh, come pensavi che facessero tutti quei danni? Credevi che avessero una flotta da battaglia enorme nascosta da qualche parte che nessuno conosce?"

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1|	"That's right," says Tomek. He doesn't seem terribly happy about it. "How else would they be doing so much damage to the Navy? It's not like they've got a massive battle fleet stashed away somewhere."|205|0
units.english: "That's right," says Tomek. He doesn't seem terribly happy about it. "How else would they be doing so much damage to the Navy? It's not like they've got a massive battle fleet stashed away somewhere."
units.italian: "Esatto," dice Tomek. Non sembra affatto contento. "In che altro modo avrebbero potuto fare così tanti danni alla Marina? Non è che abbiano una flotta da battaglia enorme messa da parte da qualche parte."

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1|	Alondo hurries off to the city hall to try to meet with the governor, and Tomek explains, "All the Wolf Pack has is a handful of very fast ships armed with nukes. They jump into the system, unload the missiles at whatever targets they can find, and then hightail it out of there before the Navy has a chance to respond. This is quite a mess you all have gotten into while I was gone, by the way."|208|0
units.english: Alondo hurries off to the city hall to try to meet with the governor, and Tomek explains, "All the Wolf Pack has is a handful of very fast ships armed with nukes. They jump into the system, unload the missiles at whatever targets they can find, and then hightail it out of there before the Navy has a chance to respond. This is quite a mess you all have gotten into while I was gone, by the way."
units.italian: Alondo si affretta verso il municipio per cercare di incontrare il governatore, e Tomek spiega: "Il Branco di Lupi ha solo una manciata di navi molto veloci armate di testate nucleari. Entrano nel sistema, scaricano i missili su tutti i bersagli che trovano, e poi se la svignano prima che la Marina abbia il tempo di reagire. Bel pasticcio in cui vi siete cacciati mentre ero via, comunque."

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1|	"Weren't you under house arrest?"|210|0
units.english: "Weren't you under house arrest?"
units.italian: "Non eri agli arresti domiciliari?"

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1|	"So, does the fact that you're here mean the Senate pardoned you?"|211|0
units.english: "So, does the fact that you're here mean the Senate pardoned you?"
units.italian: "Quindi il fatto che tu sia qui significa che il Senato ti ha graziato?"

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1|	"Yes," he says. "After that incident with the Alphas on Poisonwood, some folks in the Senate started thinking that I was right to view the pirates as a threat. And when the Navy went on the offensive, they decided I was needed for the war effort. So I've been reinstated. Glad to hear you're on Council now too."|212|0
units.english: "Yes," he says. "After that incident with the Alphas on Poisonwood, some folks in the Senate started thinking that I was right to view the pirates as a threat. And when the Navy went on the offensive, they decided I was needed for the war effort. So I've been reinstated. Glad to hear you're on Council now too."
units.italian: "Sì," dice. "Dopo quell'incidente con gli Alphas su Poisonwood, alcuni al Senato hanno cominciato a pensare che avessi ragione a considerare i pirati una minaccia. E quando la Marina è passata all'offensiva, hanno deciso che servivo allo sforzo bellico. Quindi sono stato reintegrato. Sono contento di sapere che ora sei anche tu nel Consiglio."

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1|	"So, what's our next step?"|214|0
units.english: "So, what's our next step?"
units.italian: "Allora, qual è il nostro prossimo passo?"

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1|	"I'm still really confused about why we're using nukes. Or where we got them from."|216|0
units.english: "I'm still really confused about why we're using nukes. Or where we got them from."
units.italian: "Continuo a non capire perché usiamo testate nucleari. Né da dove le prendiamo."

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1|	Tomek frowns. "I'm not too happy about that, myself. The Wolf Pack is buying them from a warlord on Greenrock. And the way they're paying him is with uranium, so every nuke he gives to us means another one or two he can build for himself. Not a good situation, if you ask me, but I guess the Wolf Pack thought it was the only way to turn the tide of the war."|217|0
units.english: Tomek frowns. "I'm not too happy about that, myself. The Wolf Pack is buying them from a warlord on Greenrock. And the way they're paying him is with uranium, so every nuke he gives to us means another one or two he can build for himself. Not a good situation, if you ask me, but I guess the Wolf Pack thought it was the only way to turn the tide of the war."
units.italian: Tomek aggrotta la fronte. "Non ne sono contento nemmeno io. Il Branco di Lupi le compra da un signore della guerra su Greenrock. E lo paga con l'uranio, quindi ogni testata che ci dà significa una o due che può costruirsi da solo. Non è una bella situazione, se vuoi la mia opinione, ma immagino che il Branco di Lupi pensasse che fosse l'unico modo per ribaltare le sorti della guerra."

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1|	"So, what do we do now?" you ask.|218|0
units.english: "So, what do we do now?" you ask.
units.italian: "Allora, che cosa facciamo adesso?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1|	"Well," he says, "if we can take Cebalrai, our entire territory will be behind just two choke points, which will allow us to defend ourselves against the Navy without spreading the fleet too thin. So next, I'd like you to go scout out the Cebalrai system and report on the Navy's position there."|220|0
units.english: "Well," he says, "if we can take Cebalrai, our entire territory will be behind just two choke points, which will allow us to defend ourselves against the Navy without spreading the fleet too thin. So next, I'd like you to go scout out the Cebalrai system and report on the Navy's position there."
units.italian: "Beh," dice, "se riusciamo a prendere Cebalrai, tutto il nostro territorio resterà dietro appena due colli di bottiglia, il che ci permetterà di difenderci dalla Marina senza sparpagliare troppo la flotta. Quindi come prossimo passo vorrei che andassi a esplorare il sistema Cebalrai e riferissi sulla posizione della Marina."

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1|There are a few Navy ships here, but nowhere near as many as were in the Kaus Borealis system before your last attack. Perhaps the Navy has decided to pull back their forces.|227|0
units.english: There are a few Navy ships here, but nowhere near as many as were in the Kaus Borealis system before your last attack. Perhaps the Navy has decided to pull back their forces.
units.italian: Ci sono alcune navi della Marina qui, ma niente a che vedere con quelle che c'erano nel sistema Kaus Borealis prima del tuo ultimo attacco. Forse la Marina ha deciso di ritirare le sue forze.

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1B|name|246|0
units.english: Capture Cebalrai
units.italian: Cattura Cebalrai

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1B|description|247|0
units.english: Lead an attack on the Cebalrai system and drive out or destroy any Navy ships that you find there.
units.italian: Guida un attacco al sistema Cebalrai e scaccia o distruggi tutte le navi della Marina che trovi.

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1B|You meet up with Tomek and Alondo and tell them that the defenses in the Cebalrai system did not seem particularly strong. "They must've seen the writing on the wall and pulled back the rest of their fleet," says Alondo.|262|0
units.english: You meet up with Tomek and Alondo and tell them that the defenses in the Cebalrai system did not seem particularly strong. "They must've seen the writing on the wall and pulled back the rest of their fleet," says Alondo.
units.italian: Incontri Tomek e Alondo e racconti loro che le difese nel sistema Cebalrai non sembravano particolarmente forti. "Devono aver visto come stavano le cose e ritirato il resto della flotta," dice Alondo.

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1B|	"Either that," says Tomek, "or they're wary of engaging us again now that they know we're willing to use nukes. Which I'm still not happy about, by the way. It's only a matter of time until they respond in kind. But in any case, our next move is clear: bring a fleet to Cebalrai and capture the system. <first>, you'll be in charge of that fleet. Alondo can travel with you to handle the diplomatic aftermath."|263|0
units.english: "Either that," says Tomek, "or they're wary of engaging us again now that they know we're willing to use nukes. Which I'm still not happy about, by the way. It's only a matter of time until they respond in kind. But in any case, our next move is clear: bring a fleet to Cebalrai and capture the system. <first>, you'll be in charge of that fleet. Alondo can travel with you to handle the diplomatic aftermath."
units.italian: "O," dice Tomek, "sono cauti all'idea di affrontarci di nuovo, ora che sanno che siamo disposti a usare testate nucleari. Il che, per inciso, continua a non piacermi. È solo questione di tempo prima che rispondano con la stessa moneta. Ma in ogni caso la prossima mossa è chiara: porta una flotta a Cebalrai e conquista il sistema. <first>, sarai tu al comando di quella flotta. Alondo può viaggiare con te per gestire le conseguenze diplomatiche."

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1B|	"Before we go on," Alondo says, "you two should know that I just received word that Tarazed has decided to officially sever ties with us."|264|0
units.english: "Before we go on," Alondo says, "you two should know that I just received word that Tarazed has decided to officially sever ties with us."
units.italian: "Prima di andare avanti," dice Alondo, "dovete sapere che ho appena saputo che Tarazed ha deciso di troncare ufficialmente i rapporti con noi."

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1B|	Tomek looks rather somber before saying, "Bold move for a system we have completely surrounded. They're none of our concern right now. Let's make our way to Cebalrai."|265|0
units.english: Tomek looks rather somber before saying, "Bold move for a system we have completely surrounded. They're none of our concern right now. Let's make our way to Cebalrai."
units.italian: Tomek sembra piuttosto cupo prima di dire: "Mossa ardita, per un sistema che abbiamo completamente circondato. Non sono affari nostri, al momento. Andiamo a Cebalrai."

units.id: mission:FWC Cebalrai 1B|dialog|269|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but there are still Navy ships circling overhead. You should take off and help finish them off.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ci sono ancora navi della Marina che girano là sopra. Dovresti decollare e aiutare a finirle.

units.id: mission:FWC Nuke Supply 1|name|334|0
units.english: Uranium Convoy
units.italian: Convoglio di uranio

units.id: mission:FWC Nuke Supply 1|description|335|0
units.english: Travel to Oblivion to escort a freighter that is delivering uranium to a warlord on Greenrock.
units.italian: Va' su Oblivion per scortare un mercantile che consegna uranio a un signore della guerra su Greenrock.

units.id: mission:FWC Nuke Supply 1|As you are bringing your ship in for a landing, you hear an odd plinking sound from the hull, similar to the sound of flying through a swarm of micrometeorites. After a few seconds, you realize that it's the sound of your ship being hit by small arms fire from the town below. Your hull is far too strong to be damaged by bullets, but the message is clear: you are not welcome here.|346|0
units.english: As you are bringing your ship in for a landing, you hear an odd plinking sound from the hull, similar to the sound of flying through a swarm of micrometeorites. After a few seconds, you realize that it's the sound of your ship being hit by small arms fire from the town below. Your hull is far too strong to be damaged by bullets, but the message is clear: you are not welcome here.
units.italian: Mentre porti la nave ad atterrare, senti uno strano tintinnio sullo scafo, simile al suono di volare attraverso uno sciame di micrometeoriti. Dopo qualche secondo capisci che è il rumore della tua nave colpita da armi leggere dalla città sotto di te. Lo scafo è troppo resistente perché i proiettili lo danneggino, ma il messaggio è chiaro: qui non sei il benvenuto.

units.id: mission:FWC Nuke Supply 1|	The spaceport is apparently deserted, and no one seems eager to come out and greet you. A few bullets continue to plink harmlessly off your hull, from snipers in the nearby buildings. "I think it would be best for me to just contact the governor via radio," says Alondo.|347|0
units.english: The spaceport is apparently deserted, and no one seems eager to come out and greet you. A few bullets continue to plink harmlessly off your hull, from snipers in the nearby buildings. "I think it would be best for me to just contact the governor via radio," says Alondo.
units.italian: Lo spazioporto è apparentemente deserto, e nessuno sembra ansioso di uscire a salutarti. Qualche proiettile continua a rimbalzare innocuo sullo scafo, sparato da cecchini negli edifici vicini. "Credo che per me sia meglio contattare il governatore via radio," dice Alondo.

units.id: mission:FWC Nuke Supply 1|	"Don't they know our fleet could easily destroy them if we wanted?"|349|0
units.english: "Don't they know our fleet could easily destroy them if we wanted?"
units.italian: "Non sanno che la nostra flotta potrebbe distruggerli facilmente, se volessimo?"

units.id: mission:FWC Nuke Supply 1|	"Do you think we have any chance at a peace settlement?"|351|0
units.english: "Do you think we have any chance at a peace settlement?"
units.italian: "Pensi che abbiamo qualche possibilità di un accordo di pace?"

units.id: mission:FWC Nuke Supply 1|	"That would be an awful precedent," says Alondo, "perhaps worse than the fact we're using nukes. If civilian populations become a legitimate target, any of our worlds could be attacked at any time. And it's not like there's any way to defend a world from orbital bombardment. No one would ever be able to feel safe in their own homes again."|354|0
units.english: "That would be an awful precedent," says Alondo, "perhaps worse than the fact we're using nukes. If civilian populations become a legitimate target, any of our worlds could be attacked at any time. And it's not like there's any way to defend a world from orbital bombardment. No one would ever be able to feel safe in their own homes again."
units.italian: "Sarebbe un precedente orribile," dice Alondo, "forse peggiore del fatto che usiamo testate nucleari. Se le popolazioni civili diventano un bersaglio legittimo, qualsiasi nostro mondo potrebbe essere attaccato in qualsiasi momento. E non è che ci sia modo di difendere un pianeta da un bombardamento orbitale. Nessuno potrebbe più sentirsi al sicuro a casa propria."

units.id: mission:FWC Nuke Supply 1|	"I hope so," says Alondo. "We'll let them keep shooting at us for a while, to vent their anger and let them prove their point. Then once they see the Navy isn't going to rescue them, we'll negotiate. That's really our only alternative. I do not want to be the person who authorizes the first attack on civilian targets since the dawn of the Republic."|357|0
units.english: "I hope so," says Alondo. "We'll let them keep shooting at us for a while, to vent their anger and let them prove their point. Then once they see the Navy isn't going to rescue them, we'll negotiate. That's really our only alternative. I do not want to be the person who authorizes the first attack on civilian targets since the dawn of the Republic."
units.italian: "Lo spero," dice Alondo. "Li lasceremo sparare ancora un po', per sfogare la rabbia e dimostrare il loro punto. Poi, quando vedranno che la Marina non verrà a salvarli, negozieremo. È davvero la nostra unica alternativa. Non voglio essere la persona che autorizza il primo attacco contro obiettivi civili dall'alba della Repubblica."

units.id: mission:FWC Nuke Supply 1|	You wait for about an hour. Meanwhile, more Free Worlds ships continue to enter the system, one of which is carrying Tomek. He radios you and says, "I think we've got things under control here, which means there's a new mission for you. You probably aren't going to like this, but we need you to escort a freighter from Oblivion. Part of our ongoing deal with the Devil: a shipment of uranium headed for Greenrock."|360|0
units.english: You wait for about an hour. Meanwhile, more Free Worlds ships continue to enter the system, one of which is carrying Tomek. He radios you and says, "I think we've got things under control here, which means there's a new mission for you. You probably aren't going to like this, but we need you to escort a freighter from Oblivion. Part of our ongoing deal with the Devil: a shipment of uranium headed for Greenrock."
units.italian: Aspetti circa un'ora. Nel frattempo altre navi delle Free Worlds continuano a entrare nel sistema, e una di queste trasporta Tomek. Ti chiama via radio e dice: "Credo che qui abbiamo la situazione sotto controllo, il che significa che c'è una nuova missione per te. Probabilmente non ti piacerà, ma dobbiamo che tu scorti un mercantile da Oblivion. Parte del nostro patto in corso con il Diavolo: un carico di uranio diretto a Greenrock."

units.id: mission:FWC Nuke Supply 1|	A Free Worlds ship lands close enough to your own ship that Alondo can transfer over to it without being in sight of the snipers. "Good luck," he says as he departs. "I hope when you return we will have negotiated some sort of meeting with Parliament."|361|0
units.english: A Free Worlds ship lands close enough to your own ship that Alondo can transfer over to it without being in sight of the snipers. "Good luck," he says as he departs. "I hope when you return we will have negotiated some sort of meeting with Parliament."
units.italian: Una nave delle Free Worlds atterra abbastanza vicino alla tua perché Alondo possa trasferirsi senza essere visto dai cecchini. "Buona fortuna," dice andandosene. "Spero che al tuo ritorno avremo negoziato un qualche incontro con il Parlamento."

units.id: mission:FWC Nuke Supply 1B|name|405|0
units.english: Uranium Convoy
units.italian: Convoglio di uranio

units.id: mission:FWC Nuke Supply 1B|description|406|0
units.english: Escort a freighter that is delivering uranium to a warlord on Greenrock.
units.italian: Scorta un mercantile che consegna uranio a un signore della guerra su Greenrock.

units.id: mission:FWC Nuke Supply 1B|You land on <origin> and meet up with the grim-faced captain of a Container Transport named the Blue Yonder. "The cargo is already loaded up," he says, "and I'm ready to go. The sooner we get this stuff out of my cargo bays and I can get back to shipping food and medicine, the better. I really hope you folks on Council know what you're doing."|418|0
units.english: You land on <origin> and meet up with the grim-faced captain of a Container Transport named the Blue Yonder. "The cargo is already loaded up," he says, "and I'm ready to go. The sooner we get this stuff out of my cargo bays and I can get back to shipping food and medicine, the better. I really hope you folks on Council know what you're doing."
units.italian: Atterri su <origin> e incontri il capitano dal volto cupo di un trasporto container di nome Blue Yonder. "Il carico è già a bordo," dice, "e sono pronto a partire. Prima ci togliamo questa roba dalle stive e posso tornare a trasportare cibo e medicine, meglio è. Spero davvero che voi del Consiglio sappiate quello che fate."

units.id: mission:FWC Nuke Supply 1B|dialog|427|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but the Blue Yonder is not here yet! Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma la Blue Yonder non è ancora qui! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FWC Nuke Supply 1C|name|433|0
units.english: Warhead Convoy
units.italian: Convoglio di testate

units.id: mission:FWC Nuke Supply 1C|description|434|0
units.english: Escort a freighter carrying nuclear warheads to Solace.
units.italian: Scorta un mercantile che trasporta testate nucleari fino a Solace.

units.id: mission:FWC Nuke Supply 1C|log|443|0
units.english: Delivered a load of enriched uranium to a warlord's fortress on Greenrock, in exchange for warheads for the Free Worlds to use against the Navy. Hopefully forming such a friendly relationship with dangerous criminals will not cause trouble for the Free Worlds in the future.
units.italian: Hai consegnato un carico di uranio arricchito alla fortezza di un signore della guerra su Greenrock, in cambio di testate che le Free Worlds useranno contro la Marina. Speriamo che stringere un rapporto così amichevole con criminali pericolosi non crei problemi alle Free Worlds in futuro.

units.id: mission:FWC Nuke Supply 1C|You land at one of the many private fortresses on Greenrock owned by various competing warlords. Some workers unload the cargo from the Blue Yonder, and load it up with some lead-lined, well-padded crates that must contain nuclear warheads. You're not sure you like being a part of this, but it may be true that this is the only way you will stand a chance against the Navy.|445|0
units.english: You land at one of the many private fortresses on Greenrock owned by various competing warlords. Some workers unload the cargo from the Blue Yonder, and load it up with some lead-lined, well-padded crates that must contain nuclear warheads. You're not sure you like being a part of this, but it may be true that this is the only way you will stand a chance against the Navy.
units.italian: Atterri in una delle tante fortezze private su Greenrock, di proprietà di vari signori della guerra in competizione. Alcuni operai scaricano il carico dalla Blue Yonder e la riempiono con casse foderate di piombo e ben imbottite, che devono contenere testate nucleari. Non sei sicuro che ti piaccia farne parte, ma forse è vero che è l'unico modo per avere una possibilità contro la Marina.

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1|name|459|0
units.english: Let's Try Diplomacy
units.italian: Proviamo la diplomazia

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1|description|460|0
units.english: Return to Tundra to meet up with Alondo and take him on another visit to Parliament. Maybe this time they will be willing to negotiate a truce.
units.italian: Torna su Tundra per incontrare Alondo e portarlo a un'altra visita al Parlamento. Magari questa volta saranno disposti a negoziare una tregua.

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1|A member of the Wolf Pack who identifies himself as "Odie" oversees the unloading of the warheads from your ship. "Excellent," he says. "It will take a while to install these in missiles. But once we do, in recognition of how much you have assisted us, Fifi has authorized us to sell them to you if you want."|471|0
units.english: A member of the Wolf Pack who identifies himself as "Odie" oversees the unloading of the warheads from your ship. "Excellent," he says. "It will take a while to install these in missiles. But once we do, in recognition of how much you have assisted us, Fifi has authorized us to sell them to you if you want."
units.italian: Un membro del Branco di Lupi che si presenta come "Odie" sovrintende allo scarico delle testate dalla tua nave. "Eccellente," dice. "Ci vorrà un po' per installarle nei missili. Ma una volta fatto, in riconoscimento di quanto ci hai aiutato, Fifi ci ha autorizzato a vendertele, se le vuoi."

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1|	"Great! I think I'd like a dozen of them."|473|0
units.english: "Great! I think I'd like a dozen of them."
units.italian: "Ottimo! Credo che ne vorrei una dozzina."

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1|	"Sorry, I'm following orders by bringing this convoy here, but I want no part in the use of nuclear weapons, even for the sake of winning this war."|475|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm following orders by bringing this convoy here, but I want no part in the use of nuclear weapons, even for the sake of winning this war."
units.italian: "Scusa, sto seguendo gli ordini portando qui questo convoglio, ma non voglio avere niente a che fare con l'uso di armi nucleari, nemmeno per vincere questa guerra."

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1|	"Wait, 'Fifi'? Is that your leader?"|477|0
units.english: "Wait, 'Fifi'? Is that your leader?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, 'Fifi'? È la vostra capa?"

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1|	He laughs. "I'm afraid that's not possible. Unlike most missile systems, we haven't yet developed any sort of feed system that would let you fire multiple missiles from the same gun port. So, it's a weapon you can only fire once from a given port. But on the plus side, two of them are enough to bring down the shields on even the largest Navy vessel."|480|0
units.english: He laughs. "I'm afraid that's not possible. Unlike most missile systems, we haven't yet developed any sort of feed system that would let you fire multiple missiles from the same gun port. So, it's a weapon you can only fire once from a given port. But on the plus side, two of them are enough to bring down the shields on even the largest Navy vessel."
units.italian: Ride. "Temo che non sia possibile. A differenza della maggior parte dei sistemi missilistici, non abbiamo ancora sviluppato nessun tipo di alimentatore che ti permetta di lanciare più missili dalla stessa bocca di fuoco. Quindi è un'arma che puoi sparare una volta sola da una data bocca. Ma il lato positivo è che due bastano a tirare giù gli scudi anche della nave più grande della Marina."

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1|	"That's understandable," he says. "And also foolish and shortsighted. But, I can understand why some people want to cling to the belief that war is some sort of noble endeavor rather than a no holds barred struggle for survival."|483|0
units.english: "That's understandable," he says. "And also foolish and shortsighted. But, I can understand why some people want to cling to the belief that war is some sort of noble endeavor rather than a no holds barred struggle for survival."
units.italian: "È comprensibile," dice. "E anche sciocco e miope. Ma capisco perché alcuni vogliano aggrapparsi all'idea che la guerra sia una specie di nobile impresa invece di una lotta per la sopravvivenza senza esclusione di colpi."

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1|	"Yes," he says, "Fifi is the leader of the Wolf Pack. And she is an absolutely ferocious individual. I assure you that you do not want to be responsible for crossing her. Not that you'll ever have to, of course, because we're all on the same side here." He grins.|486|0
units.english: "Yes," he says, "Fifi is the leader of the Wolf Pack. And she is an absolutely ferocious individual. I assure you that you do not want to be responsible for crossing her. Not that you'll ever have to, of course, because we're all on the same side here." He grins.
units.italian: "Sì," dice, "Fifi è la capa del Branco di Lupi. Ed è una persona assolutamente feroce. Ti assicuro che non vuoi essere responsabile di averla contrariata. Non che ti capiterà mai, naturalmente, perché siamo tutti dalla stessa parte." Sorride.

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1|	Soon after he is done unloading the cargo, you receive a message from Alondo: "Good news, <first>! The Republic has agreed to allow us to make a diplomatic visit to Parliament. Hurry back here to <planet> before they change their minds."|489|0
units.english: Soon after he is done unloading the cargo, you receive a message from Alondo: "Good news, <first>! The Republic has agreed to allow us to make a diplomatic visit to Parliament. Hurry back here to <planet> before they change their minds."
units.italian: Poco dopo che ha finito di scaricare il carico, ricevi un messaggio da Alondo: "Buone notizie, <first>! La Repubblica ha accettato di permetterci una visita diplomatica al Parlamento. Torna qui su <planet> in fretta, prima che cambino idea."

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1B|name|496|0
units.english: Let's Try Diplomacy
units.italian: Proviamo la diplomazia

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1B|description|497|0
units.english: Travel to Earth with Alondo and meet with Parliament to try to negotiate terms of a truce.
units.italian: Va' sulla Terra con Alondo e incontra il Parlamento per cercare di negoziare i termini di una tregua.

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1B|blocked|505|0
units.english: You have reached <origin>, but you don't have a bunk free for Alondo! You should return to <origin> once you have freed one up.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <origin>, ma non hai una cuccetta libera per Alondo! Dovresti tornare su <origin> quando ne avrai liberata una.

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1B|When you meet up with Alondo, he seems excited and optimistic. "The Republic has agreed to one week of safe passage," he says, "just enough time to get us to Earth and back. And what's more, I told them that one of our terms would be a mutual release of all prisoners of war, including Katya, and they agreed."|513|0
units.english: When you meet up with Alondo, he seems excited and optimistic. "The Republic has agreed to one week of safe passage," he says, "just enough time to get us to Earth and back. And what's more, I told them that one of our terms would be a mutual release of all prisoners of war, including Katya, and they agreed."
units.italian: Quando incontri Alondo, sembra entusiasta e ottimista. "La Repubblica ha concesso una settimana di salvacondotto," dice, "giusto il tempo di andare sulla Terra e tornare. E per di più ho detto loro che una delle nostre condizioni sarebbe stata la liberazione reciproca di tutti i prigionieri di guerra, compresa Katya, e hanno accettato."

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1B|	"That's great news! Let's get going!"|515|0
units.english: "That's great news! Let's get going!"
units.italian: "È un'ottima notizia! Andiamo!"

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1B|	"Wait, isn't this the third time they've promised to give Katya back to us? I'm starting to think she isn't even alive anymore."|517|0
units.english: "Wait, isn't this the third time they've promised to give Katya back to us? I'm starting to think she isn't even alive anymore."
units.italian: "Aspetta, non è la terza volta che promettono di restituirci Katya? Comincio a pensare che non sia nemmeno viva."

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1B|	"Well, I sincerely hope you're wrong," says Alondo. "I miss her. We might never have gotten into such dire straits if she had been leading us."|518|0
units.english: "Well, I sincerely hope you're wrong," says Alondo. "I miss her. We might never have gotten into such dire straits if she had been leading us."
units.italian: "Beh, spero sinceramente che tu ti sbagli," dice Alondo. "Mi manca. Forse non saremmo mai arrivati a un punto così disperato se fosse stata lei a guidarci."

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1B|	As you are returning to your ship, Alondo points out an Argosy parked next to you and says, "By the way, this ship will be escorting us on this mission. Providing a bit of extra defense."|521|0
units.english: As you are returning to your ship, Alondo points out an Argosy parked next to you and says, "By the way, this ship will be escorting us on this mission. Providing a bit of extra defense."
units.italian: Mentre tornate alla tua nave, Alondo ti indica un'Argosy parcheggiata accanto e dice: "A proposito, questa nave ci scorterà in questa missione. Per darci un po' di difesa in più."

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1B|	"Um, I don't think an Argosy is strong enough to tip the scales in a battle against the Navy."|523|0
units.english: "Um, I don't think an Argosy is strong enough to tip the scales in a battle against the Navy."
units.italian: "Ehm, non credo che un'Argosy sia abbastanza forte da spostare gli equilibri in una battaglia contro la Marina."

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1B|	"Please tell me that thing isn't armed with nukes. Because that would cause a major diplomatic incident."|524|0
units.english: "Please tell me that thing isn't armed with nukes. Because that would cause a major diplomatic incident."
units.italian: "Ti prego, dimmi che quella cosa non è armata con testate nucleari. Perché sarebbe un incidente diplomatico bello e buono."

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1B|	Alondo sighs. "Yes, but the Senate thought if we brought anything bigger, it might look like an attack fleet rather than an escort. And of course, it's not carrying nukes, because if the Navy picked those up on their sensors, they'd blast us out of the sky long before we could land on Earth. Anyway, let's get going and hope for the best."|526|0
units.english: Alondo sighs. "Yes, but the Senate thought if we brought anything bigger, it might look like an attack fleet rather than an escort. And of course, it's not carrying nukes, because if the Navy picked those up on their sensors, they'd blast us out of the sky long before we could land on Earth. Anyway, let's get going and hope for the best."
units.italian: Alondo sospira. "Sì, ma il Senato pensava che se avessimo portato qualcosa di più grande sarebbe sembrata una flotta d'attacco invece di una scorta. E naturalmente non trasporta testate nucleari, perché se la Marina le rilevasse ai sensori ci abbatterebbe molto prima che possiamo atterrare sulla Terra. Comunque, andiamo e speriamo bene."

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1B|	"No, no, of course not," says Alondo. "If the Navy picked those up on their sensors, they'd blast us out of the sky long before we could land on Earth. Anyway, let's get going and hope for the best."|529|0
units.english: "No, no, of course not," says Alondo. "If the Navy picked those up on their sensors, they'd blast us out of the sky long before we could land on Earth. Anyway, let's get going and hope for the best."
units.italian: "No, no, certo che no," dice Alondo. "Se la Marina le rilevasse ai sensori ci abbatterebbe molto prima che possiamo atterrare sulla Terra. Comunque, andiamo e speriamo bene."

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1B|dialog|538|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but the Big Brother is not here yet! Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma la Big Brother non è ancora qui! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1C|name|544|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Torna su <planet>

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1C|description|545|0
units.english: The peace negotiations with Parliament failed. Return to <planet> without being destroyed by the Navy.
units.italian: I negoziati di pace con il Parlamento sono falliti. Torna su <planet> senza farti distruggere dalla Marina.

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1C|log|555|0
units.english: Visited Earth with Alondo to try to pressure Parliament into agreeing to a peace deal. The negotiations failed. Only escaped the planet safely because a Free Worlds ship in orbit threatened to bombard the Parliament building.
units.italian: Hai visitato la Terra con Alondo per cercare di spingere il Parlamento ad accettare un accordo di pace. I negoziati sono falliti. Siete riusciti a lasciare il pianeta sani e salvi solo perché una nave delle Free Worlds in orbita ha minacciato di bombardare l'edificio del Parlamento.

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1C|log|556|0
units.english: Rescued Katya from the Republic's custody. She is not happy about the extreme measures the Free Worlds are taking to win this war.
units.italian: Hai liberato Katya dalla custodia della Repubblica. Non è contenta delle misure estreme che le Free Worlds stanno prendendo per vincere questa guerra.

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1C|When you land on Earth, the Big Brother flies down to the spaceport with you to see that you arrive safely, then takes off immediately. You and Alondo are escorted to the House of Parliament. As you wait to be called in to speak to Parliament, Alondo seems very nervous, pacing back and forth and fiddling with his watch every few minutes.|559|0
units.english: When you land on Earth, the Big Brother flies down to the spaceport with you to see that you arrive safely, then takes off immediately. You and Alondo are escorted to the House of Parliament. As you wait to be called in to speak to Parliament, Alondo seems very nervous, pacing back and forth and fiddling with his watch every few minutes.
units.italian: Quando atterri sulla Terra, la Big Brother scende allo spazioporto con te per assicurarsi che arrivi sano e salvo, poi riparte subito. Tu e Alondo venite scortati alla Camera del Parlamento. Mentre aspettate di essere chiamati a parlare, Alondo sembra molto nervoso: cammina avanti e indietro e ogni pochi minuti giocherella con l'orologio.

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1C|	Finally you are invited into the Parliament chambers, and Douglas Xao, the Speaker, says, "Representatives of the Free Worlds, we are prepared to hear your demands."|560|0
units.english: Finally you are invited into the Parliament chambers, and Douglas Xao, the Speaker, says, "Representatives of the Free Worlds, we are prepared to hear your demands."
units.italian: Alla fine venite invitati nella sala del Parlamento, e Douglas Xao, il Presidente, dice: "Rappresentanti delle Free Worlds, siamo pronti ad ascoltare le vostre richieste."

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1C|	Alondo says, "We're not here to make demands. We're here to work together to negotiate a peace settlement. The Free Worlds are prepared to return all our prisoners of war, to cede control of the Cebalrai and Kaus Borealis systems back to the Republic, and to promise not to expand our territory north into the so-called 'breadbasket' worlds, even if those worlds want to join us. All we ask in return is autonomy, and peace, and a return of the prisoners you have taken, including Katya Reynolds."|561|0
units.english: Alondo says, "We're not here to make demands. We're here to work together to negotiate a peace settlement. The Free Worlds are prepared to return all our prisoners of war, to cede control of the Cebalrai and Kaus Borealis systems back to the Republic, and to promise not to expand our territory north into the so-called 'breadbasket' worlds, even if those worlds want to join us. All we ask in return is autonomy, and peace, and a return of the prisoners you have taken, including Katya Reynolds."
units.italian: Alondo dice: "Non siamo qui per avanzare richieste. Siamo qui per lavorare insieme a un accordo di pace. Le Free Worlds sono pronte a restituire tutti i nostri prigionieri di guerra, a cedere alla Repubblica il controllo dei sistemi Cebalrai e Kaus Borealis, e a promettere di non espandere il nostro territorio a nord verso i cosiddetti mondi del 'granaio', anche se quei mondi volessero unirsi a noi. In cambio chiediamo solo autonomia, pace, e la restituzione dei prigionieri che avete preso, compresa Katya Reynolds."

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1C|	Xao gestures to the guards, and they escort in a third person to stand beside the two of you. It takes you a moment to realize that it's Katya, looking rather worn-out and bedraggled. She whispers to you, "So, you're using nukes now? Whose damn fool idea was that?"|562|0
units.english: Xao gestures to the guards, and they escort in a third person to stand beside the two of you. It takes you a moment to realize that it's Katya, looking rather worn-out and bedraggled. She whispers to you, "So, you're using nukes now? Whose damn fool idea was that?"
units.italian: Xao fa un cenno alle guardie, che scortano dentro una terza persona e la fanno stare accanto a voi due. Ti ci vuole un momento per capire che è Katya, piuttosto provata e malridotta. Ti sussurra: "Quindi ora usate le testate nucleari? Di chi è stata questa dannata idea?"

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1C|	"It was the only way we could resist the Navy."|564|0
units.english: "It was the only way we could resist the Navy."
units.italian: "Era l'unico modo per resistere alla Marina."

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1C|	"I didn't find out that's what they were doing until afterwards. I don't like it any more than you do."|565|0
units.english: "I didn't find out that's what they were doing until afterwards. I don't like it any more than you do."
units.italian: "Ho scoperto che era questo che stavano facendo solo dopo. Non mi piace più di quanto piaccia a te."

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1C|	"Fair enough," she says, "but I hope it doesn't wreck our chances at negotiation."|566|0
units.english: "Fair enough," she says, "but I hope it doesn't wreck our chances at negotiation."
units.italian: "Giusto," dice, "ma spero che non ci rovini le possibilità di negoziare."

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1C|	Xao addresses the three of you. "We have heard your demands," he says, "and now, here is our response. Katerina Reynolds, Alondo Gruyere, and <first> <last>, you are hereby charged with treason and insurrection. Your trial will begin immediately."|567|0
units.english: Xao addresses the three of you. "We have heard your demands," he says, "and now, here is our response. Katerina Reynolds, Alondo Gruyere, and <first> <last>, you are hereby charged with treason and insurrection. Your trial will begin immediately."
units.italian: Xao si rivolge a tutti e tre. "Vi abbiamo ascoltato," dice, "e ora ecco la nostra risposta. Katerina Reynolds, Alondo Gruyere e <first> <last>, siete accusati di tradimento e di insurrezione. Il vostro processo comincerà immediatamente."

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1C|	"What? We were guaranteed safe passage!"|569|0
units.english: "What? We were guaranteed safe passage!"
units.italian: "Come? Ci era stato garantito il salvacondotto!"

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1C|	"You will regret this! If you arrest us, the Free Worlds will retaliate against you."|570|0
units.english: "You will regret this! If you arrest us, the Free Worlds will retaliate against you."
units.italian: "Ve ne pentirete! Se ci arrestate, le Free Worlds reagiranno contro di voi."

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1C|	As you try to protest, Alondo speaks up. He is not shouting, but his voice carries over the murmur of other voices. "We have a ship in orbit. If we do not return--"|571|0
units.english: As you try to protest, Alondo speaks up. He is not shouting, but his voice carries over the murmur of other voices. "We have a ship in orbit. If we do not return--"
units.italian: Mentre cerchi di protestare, Alondo prende la parola. Non sta urlando, ma la sua voce copre il mormorio delle altre voci. "Abbiamo una nave in orbita. Se non torniamo..."

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1C|	Xao cuts him off. "Your ship is no threat to us. We have already verified that it carries no nuclear weapons, and this building's shielding and anti-missile systems are quite sufficient to defend against conventional weapons. And there is nothing in its cargo hold but ordinary, non-radioactive metals."|572|0
units.english: Xao cuts him off. "Your ship is no threat to us. We have already verified that it carries no nuclear weapons, and this building's shielding and anti-missile systems are quite sufficient to defend against conventional weapons. And there is nothing in its cargo hold but ordinary, non-radioactive metals."
units.italian: Xao lo interrompe. "La vostra nave non è una minaccia per noi. Abbiamo già verificato che non trasporta armi nucleari, e le protezioni di questo edificio e i sistemi antimissile sono più che sufficienti contro armi convenzionali. E nella sua stiva non c'è altro che metalli comuni, non radioattivi."

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1C|	Alondo says, "That's right. Tungsten, to be exact. Aerodynamic tungsten rods, each the size of a tree trunk, with a simple guidance system on one end. Our ship is in low earth orbit, traveling at a velocity of roughly eight kilometers per second." As he speaks, the Parliament chamber gradually grows very quiet. "So we will be returning to our ship," says Alondo, "with Miss Reynolds. If the ship in orbit does not hear from me every two minutes, it will jettison its cargo, and there will be nothing left of this building but a crater." He points to the watch he is wearing, and you realize that it must be some sort of communicator.|573|0
units.english: Alondo says, "That's right. Tungsten, to be exact. Aerodynamic tungsten rods, each the size of a tree trunk, with a simple guidance system on one end. Our ship is in low earth orbit, traveling at a velocity of roughly eight kilometers per second." As he speaks, the Parliament chamber gradually grows very quiet. "So we will be returning to our ship," says Alondo, "with Miss Reynolds. If the ship in orbit does not hear from me every two minutes, it will jettison its cargo, and there will be nothing left of this building but a crater." He points to the watch he is wearing, and you realize that it must be some sort of communicator.
units.italian: Alondo dice: "Esatto. Tungsteno, per l'esattezza. Barre aerodinamiche di tungsteno, ciascuna grande quanto un tronco d'albero, con un semplice sistema di guida a un'estremità. La nostra nave è in orbita terrestre bassa, a una velocità di circa otto chilometri al secondo." Mentre parla, la sala del Parlamento diventa via via molto silenziosa. "Quindi torneremo alla nostra nave," dice Alondo, "con la signorina Reynolds. Se la nave in orbita non riceve mie notizie ogni due minuti, sgancerà il carico, e di questo edificio non resterà che un cratere." Indica l'orologio che porta, e ti rendi conto che dev'essere una specie di comunicatore.

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1C|	After a brief whispered consultation with a few of the other members of Parliament, Xao says, "You will lose this war, and you will pay dearly for it. Guards, let them return to their ship." You hurry back to your ship and take off immediately, aware that as soon as you are out of range of Earth, the Navy will probably be more than willing to attack you.|574|0
units.english: After a brief whispered consultation with a few of the other members of Parliament, Xao says, "You will lose this war, and you will pay dearly for it. Guards, let them return to their ship." You hurry back to your ship and take off immediately, aware that as soon as you are out of range of Earth, the Navy will probably be more than willing to attack you.
units.italian: Dopo una breve consultazione sussurrata con alcuni altri membri del Parlamento, Xao dice: "Perderete questa guerra, e la pagherete cara. Guardie, lasciateli tornare alla loro nave." Vi affrettate verso la vostra nave e decollate subito, consapevoli che appena sarete fuori dalla portata della Terra la Marina sarà probabilmente più che disposta ad attaccarvi.

units.id: mission:FWC Diplomacy 1C|dialog|577|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but you realize that Alondo and Katya are on one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che Alondo e Katya sono su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1|name|628|0
units.english: Defend Cebalrai
units.italian: Difendi Cebalrai

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1|description|629|0
units.english: Destroy the Republic ships that are attacking this system, then land and decide what to do next. Free Worlds reinforcements should be on their way.
units.italian: Distruggi le navi della Repubblica che attaccano questo sistema, poi atterra e decidi che cosa fare. I rinforzi delle Free Worlds dovrebbero essere in arrivo.

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1|When you land on Tundra, Tomek seems glad to see Katya back, but you sense that he's also a little wary of how she will respond to the choices the Free Worlds have been making. "Using nukes, threatening orbital bombardment," says Katya, "treating the Syndicate as an ally. Anything else I missed while I was gone?"|640|0
units.english: When you land on Tundra, Tomek seems glad to see Katya back, but you sense that he's also a little wary of how she will respond to the choices the Free Worlds have been making. "Using nukes, threatening orbital bombardment," says Katya, "treating the Syndicate as an ally. Anything else I missed while I was gone?"
units.italian: Quando atterri su Tundra, Tomek sembra contento di riavere Katya, ma percepisci che è anche un po' diffidente su come reagirà alle scelte che le Free Worlds stanno facendo. "Usare testate nucleari, minacciare un bombardamento orbitale," dice Katya, "trattare il Sindacato come un alleato. Mi sono persa qualcos'altro mentre ero via?"

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1|	"We only want this war to be over as soon as possible."|642|0
units.english: "We only want this war to be over as soon as possible."
units.italian: "Vogliamo solo che questa guerra finisca il prima possibile."

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1|	"We've just been trying to avoid being destroyed by the Navy, and things have gotten a bit out of hand."|643|0
units.english: "We've just been trying to avoid being destroyed by the Navy, and things have gotten a bit out of hand."
units.italian: "Stavamo solo cercando di non farci distruggere dalla Marina, e le cose ci sono un po' sfuggite di mano."

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1|	"I see," she says. "Did you have a plan for what comes next, or are we just winging it now?"|644|0
units.english: "I see," she says. "Did you have a plan for what comes next, or are we just winging it now?"
units.italian: "Capisco," dice. "Avevate un piano per quello che viene dopo, o state improvvisando?"

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1|	Alondo says, "Unfortunately, we do have a plan. Our very last contingency plan. We call it the 'checkmate' option. Our fleet will push north--"|645|0
units.english: Alondo says, "Unfortunately, we do have a plan. Our very last contingency plan. We call it the 'checkmate' option. Our fleet will push north--"
units.italian: Alondo dice: "Purtroppo un piano ce l'abbiamo. Il nostro ultimo piano di riserva. Lo chiamiamo opzione 'scacco matto'. La nostra flotta spingerà a nord..."

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1|	He is interrupted by one of Tomek's men running into the room. "Sir, we have a major Navy fleet incoming. We need all ships in the air immediately to repulse them. Reinforcements are on their way, but they may not get here for a while."|646|0
units.english: He is interrupted by one of Tomek's men running into the room. "Sir, we have a major Navy fleet incoming. We need all ships in the air immediately to repulse them. Reinforcements are on their way, but they may not get here for a while."
units.italian: Viene interrotto da uno degli uomini di Tomek che irrompe nella stanza. "Signore, abbiamo in arrivo una grande flotta della Marina. Dobbiamo mandare in aria tutte le navi immediatamente per respingerli. I rinforzi sono in viaggio, ma potrebbero non arrivare per un po'."

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1|	Tomek says, "So, it begins. Captain <last>, get back to your ship and aid in the defense."|647|0
units.english: Tomek says, "So, it begins. Captain <last>, get back to your ship and aid in the defense."
units.italian: Tomek dice: "Allora comincia. Capitano <last>, torna alla tua nave e aiuta nella difesa."

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1|dialog|809|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but there are still Navy ships circling overhead. You should take off and help finish them off.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ci sono ancora navi della Marina che girano là sopra. Dovresti decollare e aiutare a finirle.

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1|log|811|0
units.english: Defended Tundra against a major Navy counter-offensive. From here, the only recourse available to the Free Worlds seems to be to push deep into Republic territory and capture the Sol system, forcing the Navy to surrender. Nuclear weapons are now for sale on Solace to aid in the final assault.
units.italian: Hai difeso Tundra da una grande controffensiva della Marina. Da qui in poi, l'unica risorsa che resta alle Free Worlds sembra essere spingersi in profondità nel territorio della Repubblica e conquistare il sistema Sol, costringendo la Marina ad arrendersi. Le armi nucleari sono ora in vendita su Solace per sostenere l'assalto finale.

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1|Tomek and Alondo meet you when you land. Tomek says, "Good work aiding in the defense. Now we need to move before the Navy has time to regroup. And the Senate has decided that you will be in charge of the fleet that makes our counterattack."|816|0
units.english: Tomek and Alondo meet you when you land. Tomek says, "Good work aiding in the defense. Now we need to move before the Navy has time to regroup. And the Senate has decided that you will be in charge of the fleet that makes our counterattack."
units.italian: Tomek e Alondo ti incontrano quando atterri. Tomek dice: "Bel lavoro nella difesa. Ora dobbiamo muoverci prima che la Marina abbia il tempo di riorganizzarsi. E il Senato ha deciso che sarai tu al comando della flotta del nostro contrattacco."

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1|	Alondo says, "They have also approved a salary increase for you, to seventeen thousand credits per diem. I know that's probably still not enough, but we are running a bit low on cash."|817|0
units.english: Alondo says, "They have also approved a salary increase for you, to seventeen thousand credits per diem. I know that's probably still not enough, but we are running a bit low on cash."
units.italian: Alondo dice: "Hanno anche approvato un aumento del tuo stipendio, a diciassettemila crediti al giorno. So che probabilmente non basta ancora, ma siamo un po' a corto di liquidità."

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1|	"One other thing," says Tomek. "I don't know how you'll feel about this, but I received word from Solace that they have nukes for sale if you want any. I'd advise against it, but it's up to you. Also, since you will be the flagship of our assault, you should make any improvements you feel are necessary to your ship. Then meet us back here, in the spaceport. Of course, if you're ready to go immediately that's fine, too."|818|0
units.english: "One other thing," says Tomek. "I don't know how you'll feel about this, but I received word from Solace that they have nukes for sale if you want any. I'd advise against it, but it's up to you. Also, since you will be the flagship of our assault, you should make any improvements you feel are necessary to your ship. Then meet us back here, in the spaceport. Of course, if you're ready to go immediately that's fine, too."
units.italian: "Un'altra cosa," dice Tomek. "Non so come la prenderai, ma ho ricevuto notizia da Solace che hanno testate nucleari in vendita, se ne vuoi. Io te lo sconsiglio, ma decidi tu. Inoltre, dato che sarai l'ammiraglia del nostro assalto, dovresti fare tutte le migliorie che ritieni necessarie alla tua nave. Poi raggiungici qui, allo spazioporto. Naturalmente, se sei pronto a partire subito va bene lo stesso."

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1: Equipment|name|824|0
units.english: Upgrade Your Ship
units.italian: Migliora la tua nave

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1: Equipment|description|825|0
units.english: If you want, travel to <destination> to install nuclear missiles in your ship. You may also want to invest in some other upgrades. Then meet Tomek and the others in the spaceport on Tundra.
units.italian: Se vuoi, va' su <destination> per installare missili nucleari sulla tua nave. Potresti anche voler investire in altre migliorie. Poi incontra Tomek e gli altri allo spazioporto su Tundra.

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1: Equipment 2|name|838|0
units.english: Upgrade Your Ship
units.italian: Migliora la tua nave

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1: Equipment 2|description|839|0
units.english: Make any further upgrades to your ship that you consider necessary. Then meet Tomek and the others in the spaceport on Tundra.
units.italian: Fai tutte le ulteriori migliorie alla tua nave che ritieni necessarie. Poi incontra Tomek e gli altri allo spazioporto su Tundra.

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1B|name|851|0
units.english: Attack Menkent
units.italian: Attacca Menkent

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1B|description|852|0
units.english: The Wolf Pack has launched an initial attack on the Menkent system. Follow up with your fleet and finish off the Navy defenses. Katya will ride with you.
units.italian: Il Branco di Lupi ha lanciato un attacco preliminare al sistema Menkent. Segui con la tua flotta e finisci le difese della Marina. Katya viaggerà con te.

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1B|blocked|860|0
units.english: You have returned to <origin>, but you do not have a bunk free for Katya. You should return here once you have a bunk free.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <origin>, ma non hai una cuccetta libera per Katya. Dovresti tornare qui quando ne avrai una.

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1B|You meet up with Tomek in the spaceport. He is talking with the captain of one of a group of four Clippers that have landed next to each other some distance away from the rest of the Free Worlds fleet. The Clippers appear to have unusually large engines and afterburners, and in place of guns they are each carrying four missiles. Tomek sees you approaching and says, "And here's Captain <last>. Captain, are you ready to lead the attack?"|867|0
units.english: You meet up with Tomek in the spaceport. He is talking with the captain of one of a group of four Clippers that have landed next to each other some distance away from the rest of the Free Worlds fleet. The Clippers appear to have unusually large engines and afterburners, and in place of guns they are each carrying four missiles. Tomek sees you approaching and says, "And here's Captain <last>. Captain, are you ready to lead the attack?"
units.italian: Incontri Tomek allo spazioporto. Sta parlando con il capitano di uno di un gruppo di quattro Clipper atterrati uno accanto all'altro, a una certa distanza dal resto della flotta delle Free Worlds. I Clipper sembrano avere motori e postbruciatori insolitamente grandi, e al posto dei cannoni montano ciascuno quattro missili. Tomek ti vede avvicinare e dice: "Ed ecco il capitano <last>. Capitano, sei pronto a guidare l'attacco?"

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1B|	"Yes, I'm ready."|869|0
units.english: "Yes, I'm ready."
units.italian: "Sì, sono pronto."

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1B|	"Are these the Wolf Pack ships?"|871|0
units.english: "Are these the Wolf Pack ships?"
units.italian: "Queste sono le navi del Branco di Lupi?"

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1B|	"Yes indeed," says Tomek. "I know, you probably have mixed feelings about this, but they really are the quickest way to win this war."|872|0
units.english: "Yes indeed," says Tomek. "I know, you probably have mixed feelings about this, but they really are the quickest way to win this war."
units.italian: "Proprio così," dice Tomek. "Lo so, probabilmente hai sentimenti contrastanti al riguardo, ma sono davvero il modo più rapido per vincere questa guerra."

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1B|	Tomek tells the Wolf Pack captain, "Okay, we're ready to go. Launch immediately, and Captain <last> will follow behind you. <first>, Katya has asked to travel with you; she wants to get back into the action, and I thought she might have the best chance of anyone at dealing with the folks on the ground on <planet>. Once again, you'll need to drive off any Navy ships before landing there. Good luck."|874|0
units.english: Tomek tells the Wolf Pack captain, "Okay, we're ready to go. Launch immediately, and Captain <last> will follow behind you. <first>, Katya has asked to travel with you; she wants to get back into the action, and I thought she might have the best chance of anyone at dealing with the folks on the ground on <planet>. Once again, you'll need to drive off any Navy ships before landing there. Good luck."
units.italian: Tomek dice al capitano del Branco di Lupi: "Va bene, siamo pronti. Partite subito, e il capitano <last> vi seguirà. <first>, Katya ha chiesto di viaggiare con te; vuole tornare in azione, e ho pensato che avrebbe più possibilità di chiunque altro di trattare con la gente a terra su <planet>. Ancora una volta, dovrai scacciare tutte le navi della Marina prima di atterrare. Buona fortuna."

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1B|dialog|878|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but there are still Navy ships circling overhead. You should take off and help finish them off.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ci sono ancora navi della Marina che girano là sopra. Dovresti decollare e aiutare a finirle.
