units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1C|name|958|0
units.english: Capture <planet>
units.italian: Cattura <planet>

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1C|description|959|0
units.english: Bring a fleet to <destination>, driving off any Republic ships in the system.
units.italian: Porta una flotta su <destination>, scacciando tutte le navi della Repubblica nel sistema.

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1C|As soon as you land, you and Katya contact Tomek and inform him that the system is yours. "Excellent," he says. "Press on with your fleet and take Vega before they have time to regroup. Another Wolf Pack fleet will meet you there for the final assault on the Sol system."|973|0
units.english: As soon as you land, you and Katya contact Tomek and inform him that the system is yours. "Excellent," he says. "Press on with your fleet and take Vega before they have time to regroup. Another Wolf Pack fleet will meet you there for the final assault on the Sol system."
units.italian: Appena atterri, tu e Katya contattate Tomek e gli comunicate che il sistema è nostro. "Eccellente," dice. "Prosegui con la tua flotta e prendi Vega prima che abbiano il tempo di riorganizzarsi. Un'altra flotta del Branco di Lupi vi incontrerà lì per l'assalto finale al sistema Sol."

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1C|	"Understood. We will depart immediately."|975|0
units.english: "Understood. We will depart immediately."
units.italian: "Capito. Partiremo immediatamente."

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1C|	"Are we really sure we want to attack Earth?"|977|0
units.english: "Are we really sure we want to attack Earth?"
units.italian: "Siamo davvero sicuri di voler attaccare la Terra?"

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1C|	"Have they given us any other choice?" asks Tomek. "We tried diplomacy. And we cannot hope to defeat the entire Navy. So, unless we wish to surrender and all be put on trial as war criminals, we need to press on and gain the upper hand in the only way we can. The Senate and the Council are agreed on this." You have no choice but to follow his orders and to begin getting your fleet ready for the next attack.|978|0
units.english: "Have they given us any other choice?" asks Tomek. "We tried diplomacy. And we cannot hope to defeat the entire Navy. So, unless we wish to surrender and all be put on trial as war criminals, we need to press on and gain the upper hand in the only way we can. The Senate and the Council are agreed on this." You have no choice but to follow his orders and to begin getting your fleet ready for the next attack.
units.italian: "Ci hanno lasciato qualche altra scelta?" chiede Tomek. "Abbiamo provato la diplomazia. E non possiamo sperare di sconfiggere l'intera Marina. Quindi, a meno che non vogliamo arrenderci e finire tutti sotto processo come criminali di guerra, dobbiamo andare avanti e prendere il sopravvento nell'unico modo che abbiamo. Il Senato e il Consiglio sono d'accordo su questo." Non hai altra scelta che seguire i suoi ordini e cominciare a preparare la tua flotta per il prossimo attacco.

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1C|[Take good care of this fleet, because it will have to last you for the rest of this campaign: if ships are disabled, board them to "repair" them once the battle is over. And, when jumping into battle, remember that you can hold down the jump key to get all your ships ready to jump simultaneously, so no single ship enters the system first and bears the brunt of the enemy fire.]|980|0
units.english: [Take good care of this fleet, because it will have to last you for the rest of this campaign: if ships are disabled, board them to "repair" them once the battle is over. And, when jumping into battle, remember that you can hold down the jump key to get all your ships ready to jump simultaneously, so no single ship enters the system first and bears the brunt of the enemy fire.]
units.italian: [Abbi cura di questa flotta, perché dovrà durarti per il resto della campagna: se delle navi vengono messe fuori uso, abbordale per "ripararle" una volta finita la battaglia. E, quando salti in battaglia, ricorda che puoi tenere premuto il tasto del salto per preparare tutte le tue navi a saltare contemporaneamente, così nessuna nave entra nel sistema per prima e si prende tutto il fuoco nemico.]

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1C|dialog|984|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but you realize that Katya is on one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che Katya è su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1C|log|986|0
units.english: The Free Worlds have captured the Vega system, only one hyperjump away from Earth. Nuclear-armed Wolf Pack ships will be arriving shortly to spearhead the assault, but the Navy fleet defending Earth will be massive. Casualties on both sides are likely to be extremely high.
units.italian: Le Free Worlds hanno conquistato il sistema Vega, a un solo salto iper da Terra. Le navi del Branco di Lupi armate di testate nucleari arriveranno a breve per aprire la strada all'assalto, ma la flotta della Marina che difende la Terra sarà enorme. Le perdite da entrambe le parti saranno probabilmente altissime.

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1C|The Vega system is eerily deserted. You suspect that the Navy must have pulled back all available ships to defend Earth, rather than trying to fight you here. You try not to think about how massive the fleet there must be, and how slim your chances are of destroying it.|988|0
units.english: The Vega system is eerily deserted. You suspect that the Navy must have pulled back all available ships to defend Earth, rather than trying to fight you here. You try not to think about how massive the fleet there must be, and how slim your chances are of destroying it.
units.italian: Il sistema Vega è stranamente deserto. Sospetti che la Marina abbia ritirato tutte le navi disponibili per difendere la Terra, invece di provare a combatterti qui. Cerchi di non pensare a quanto debba essere enorme la flotta laggiù, e a quanto siano scarse le tue possibilità di distruggerla.

units.id: mission:FWC Checkmate 1C|	Katya says, "Well, this is it, the final assault. Meet me in the spaceport when you're ready for the attack on Earth."|989|0
units.english: Katya says, "Well, this is it, the final assault. Meet me in the spaceport when you're ready for the attack on Earth."
units.italian: Katya dice: "Beh, ci siamo, l'assalto finale. Incontrami allo spazioporto quando sei pronto per l'attacco alla Terra."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1|name|1037|0
units.english: Defend <planet>
units.italian: Difendi <planet>

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1|description|1038|0
units.english: <planet> is under attack by ships of an unknown type. Drive them off, and then return to the planet to figure out what to do next.
units.italian: <planet> è sotto attacco da navi di un tipo sconosciuto. Scacciale, poi torna sul pianeta per capire che cosa fare.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1|Once you have gathered in the spaceport with the captains in charge of your fleet, Katya contacts Tomek and asks for instructions. He says, "A Wolf Pack fleet should arrive there shortly. They're carrying all the nukes we had left. They will go in first and--"|1048|0
units.english: Once you have gathered in the spaceport with the captains in charge of your fleet, Katya contacts Tomek and asks for instructions. He says, "A Wolf Pack fleet should arrive there shortly. They're carrying all the nukes we had left. They will go in first and--"
units.italian: Dopo che vi siete radunati allo spazioporto con i capitani al comando della tua flotta, Katya contatta Tomek e chiede istruzioni. Lui dice: "Una flotta del Branco di Lupi dovrebbe arrivare lì a breve. Trasportano tutte le testate che ci restano. Andranno avanti per primi e..."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1|	Abruptly, his voice cuts off in a burst of static. "What the hell?" says Katya. She tries to reestablish a connection to Tomek, but is unable to. Confused, she says, "What's going on? Is the Navy destroying the hyperspace communications relays, now? Or jamming them somehow?"|1049|0
units.english: Abruptly, his voice cuts off in a burst of static. "What the hell?" says Katya. She tries to reestablish a connection to Tomek, but is unable to. Confused, she says, "What's going on? Is the Navy destroying the hyperspace communications relays, now? Or jamming them somehow?"
units.italian: All'improvviso la sua voce si interrompe in una scarica di fruscii statici. "Che diavolo?" dice Katya. Cerca di ristabilire un collegamento con Tomek, ma non ci riesce. Confusa, dice: "Che succede? La Marina sta distruggendo i ripetitori delle comunicazioni iperspaziali? O li sta disturbando in qualche modo?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1|	One of the communications technicians says, "They must've taken out the relays. I can't get a signal from Earth, or Tundra, or Bourne, or, well, anywhere else, for that matter, except the Altair system, right next to this one."|1050|0
units.english: One of the communications technicians says, "They must've taken out the relays. I can't get a signal from Earth, or Tundra, or Bourne, or, well, anywhere else, for that matter, except the Altair system, right next to this one."
units.italian: Uno dei tecnici delle comunicazioni dice: "Devono aver messo fuori uso i ripetitori. Non riesco a ottenere un segnale dalla Terra, né da Tundra, né da Bourne, né, beh, da nessun altro posto, per quanto mi riguarda, tranne il sistema Altair, proprio accanto a questo."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1|	"How do the hyperspace relays work? Is there any way around them?"|1052|0
units.english: "How do the hyperspace relays work? Is there any way around them?"
units.italian: "Come funzionano i ripetitori iperspaziali? C'è qualche modo per aggirarli?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1|	"Are you sure the signal has been cut, and not just jammed?"|1054|0
units.english: "Are you sure the signal has been cut, and not just jammed?"
units.italian: "Sei sicuro che il segnale sia stato tagliato, e non solo disturbato?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1|	"Only if you want to communicate at the speed of light," says the technician, "and in that case you'd need to wait a few years to get a message out to Tomek. So no, there is not any way around the relays. They're essential to the galactic communications network, which is why even at the worst parts of this war we've never seriously considered destroying them."|1058|0
units.english: "Only if you want to communicate at the speed of light," says the technician, "and in that case you'd need to wait a few years to get a message out to Tomek. So no, there is not any way around the relays. They're essential to the galactic communications network, which is why even at the worst parts of this war we've never seriously considered destroying them."
units.italian: "Solo se vuoi comunicare alla velocità della luce," dice il tecnico, "e in quel caso dovresti aspettare qualche anno per far arrivare un messaggio a Tomek. Quindi no, non c'è modo di aggirare i ripetitori. Sono essenziali per la rete di comunicazioni galattica, ed è per questo che nemmeno nei momenti peggiori di questa guerra abbiamo mai considerato seriamente di distruggerli."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1|	"I don't know of any technology that could jam them," says the technician. "It's possible, but I think the more likely explanation is that they've been destroyed. Which is crazy, because the entire galactic communications network depends on them. Even at the worst parts of this war we've never seriously considered destroying them."|1062|0
units.english: "I don't know of any technology that could jam them," says the technician. "It's possible, but I think the more likely explanation is that they've been destroyed. Which is crazy, because the entire galactic communications network depends on them. Even at the worst parts of this war we've never seriously considered destroying them."
units.italian: "Non conosco nessuna tecnologia che possa disturbarli," dice il tecnico. "È possibile, ma penso che la spiegazione più probabile sia che siano stati distrutti. Il che è assurdo, perché l'intera rete di comunicazioni galattica dipende da loro. Nemmeno nei momenti peggiori di questa guerra abbiamo mai considerato seriamente di distruggerli."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1|	Just then, another militia officer runs into the room. "We're under attack!" he says. "We need every ship in our fleet in orbit, right now!"|1066|0
units.english: Just then, another militia officer runs into the room. "We're under attack!" he says. "We need every ship in our fleet in orbit, right now!"
units.italian: Proprio allora un altro ufficiale della milizia irrompe nella stanza. "Siamo sotto attacco!" dice. "Ci serve ogni nave della nostra flotta in orbita, adesso!"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1|	"Who is attacking us? The Navy?"|1068|0
units.english: "Who is attacking us? The Navy?"
units.italian: "Chi ci sta attaccando? La Marina?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1|	"Have the Wolf Pack reinforcements arrived yet?"|1069|0
units.english: "Have the Wolf Pack reinforcements arrived yet?"
units.italian: "Sono già arrivati i rinforzi del Branco di Lupi?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1|	"No," he says. "I've never seen ships like these before in my life. The Wolf Pack reinforcements just arrived in orbit, and a second later, these ships appeared and started slicing them to ribbons. If you don't get your fleet up there, there won't be anything left of them."|1072|0
units.english: "No," he says. "I've never seen ships like these before in my life. The Wolf Pack reinforcements just arrived in orbit, and a second later, these ships appeared and started slicing them to ribbons. If you don't get your fleet up there, there won't be anything left of them."
units.italian: "No," dice. "Non ho mai visto navi come queste in vita mia. I rinforzi del Branco di Lupi sono appena arrivati in orbita, e un secondo dopo sono comparse queste navi, che hanno cominciato a farli a pezzi. Se non porti la tua flotta lassù, di loro non resterà niente."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1|	"Yes," he says, "and a second after they arrived, this other fleet of ships appeared, unlike any ships I've ever seen before. They're tearing the Wolf Pack fleet to ribbons. If you don't get up there immediately, none of them will be left alive."|1076|0
units.english: "Yes," he says, "and a second after they arrived, this other fleet of ships appeared, unlike any ships I've ever seen before. They're tearing the Wolf Pack fleet to ribbons. If you don't get up there immediately, none of them will be left alive."
units.italian: "Sì," dice, "e un secondo dopo il loro arrivo è comparsa quest'altra flotta di navi, diverse da qualsiasi nave abbia mai visto. Stanno facendo a pezzi la flotta del Branco di Lupi. Se non sali lassù immediatamente, non ne resterà vivo nessuno."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1|	You hurry to your ship and fire it up for a hasty launch...|1078|0
units.english: You hurry to your ship and fire it up for a hasty launch...
units.italian: Ti precipiti alla tua nave e la accendi per un decollo affrettato...

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1|dialog|1081|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but there are still alien ships circling overhead. You should take off and help finish them off.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ci sono ancora navi aliene che girano là sopra. Dovresti decollare e aiutare a finirle.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1B|name|1160|0
units.english: Investigate <system>
units.italian: Indaga su <system>

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1B|description|1161|0
units.english: This area of space has somehow been cut off from the rest of the galaxy. Visit <planet> to see if they, too, have been invaded by the aliens.
units.italian: Questa zona dello spazio è stata in qualche modo tagliata fuori dal resto della galassia. Visita <planet> per vedere se anche lì sono stati invasi dagli alieni.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1B|log|1170|0
units.english: The moment the nuclear-armed Wolf Pack ships arrived in-system to prepare for the assault on Earth, a fleet of alien ships appeared and attacked them. In addition, the aliens somehow cut off the Vega system from the rest of human space.
units.italian: Nel momento in cui le navi del Branco di Lupi armate di testate nucleari sono arrivate nel sistema per preparare l'assalto alla Terra, è comparsa una flotta di navi aliene e le ha attaccate. Inoltre gli alieni hanno in qualche modo tagliato fuori il sistema Vega dal resto dello spazio umano.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1B|The spaceport is in chaos. You eventually find Katya and report that the alien invasion fleet has been destroyed, but at a steep cost. "I'm sure we'll come to regret those losses deeply," she says. "The Wolf Pack nukes were all spent to repel that assault. And based on what we've found out here, we aren't going to be receiving reinforcements any time soon. We've somehow been cut off from the rest of human space."|1173|0
units.english: The spaceport is in chaos. You eventually find Katya and report that the alien invasion fleet has been destroyed, but at a steep cost. "I'm sure we'll come to regret those losses deeply," she says. "The Wolf Pack nukes were all spent to repel that assault. And based on what we've found out here, we aren't going to be receiving reinforcements any time soon. We've somehow been cut off from the rest of human space."
units.italian: Lo spazioporto è nel caos. Alla fine trovi Katya e le riferisci che la flotta d'invasione aliena è stata distrutta, ma a un prezzo altissimo. "Sono sicura che rimpiangeremo profondamente quelle perdite," dice. "Le testate del Branco di Lupi sono state tutte spese per respingere quell'assalto. E da quello che abbiamo scoperto qui, non riceveremo rinforzi per un pezzo. Siamo stati in qualche modo tagliati fuori dal resto dello spazio umano."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1B|	"How is that possible?"|1175|0
units.english: "How is that possible?"
units.italian: "Come è possibile?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1B|	"Do we have any idea who these aliens are?"|1177|0
units.english: "Do we have any idea who these aliens are?"
units.italian: "Abbiamo idea di chi siano questi alieni?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1B|	"I have no idea," she says, "but the aliens must have the ability to collapse hyperspace links. That's why our communications were cut. It wasn't the relays that were destroyed, it was the hyperspace pathways themselves. And meanwhile, some new links have appeared, to here." She points on your map to a star that, until now, had been completely inaccessible via hyperspace. "Deneb. That must be where the aliens came from."|1181|0
units.english: "I have no idea," she says, "but the aliens must have the ability to collapse hyperspace links. That's why our communications were cut. It wasn't the relays that were destroyed, it was the hyperspace pathways themselves. And meanwhile, some new links have appeared, to here." She points on your map to a star that, until now, had been completely inaccessible via hyperspace. "Deneb. That must be where the aliens came from."
units.italian: "Non ne ho la minima idea," dice, "ma gli alieni devono avere la capacità di far collassare i collegamenti iperspaziali. È per questo che le nostre comunicazioni si sono interrotte. Non sono stati distrutti i ripetitori, sono state le vie iperspaziali stesse. E intanto sono comparsi alcuni collegamenti nuovi, verso qui." Ti indica sulla mappa una stella che, fino a ora, era del tutto inaccessibile per via iperspaziale. "Deneb. Dev'essere da lì che sono arrivati gli alieni."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1B|	"We have no idea," she says. "But, they appear to have the ability to destroy hyperspace links. That's why our communications went dead; it wasn't the relays we lost, it was the pathways themselves. And, they are apparently able to create new links as well." She points to a galactic map that she had been examining when you came in; several links have been scribbled out and new ones have been drawn in. "This is the star we call Deneb," she says, pointing to a star that, until now, had been inaccessible via hyperspace. "This must be where they came from."|1185|0
units.english: "We have no idea," she says. "But, they appear to have the ability to destroy hyperspace links. That's why our communications went dead; it wasn't the relays we lost, it was the pathways themselves. And, they are apparently able to create new links as well." She points to a galactic map that she had been examining when you came in; several links have been scribbled out and new ones have been drawn in. "This is the star we call Deneb," she says, pointing to a star that, until now, had been inaccessible via hyperspace. "This must be where they came from."
units.italian: "Non ne abbiamo idea," dice. "Ma sembrano avere la capacità di distruggere i collegamenti iperspaziali. È per questo che le nostre comunicazioni sono morte: non abbiamo perso i ripetitori, ma le vie stesse. E a quanto pare sono capaci anche di crearne di nuovi." Indica una mappa galattica che stava esaminando quando sei entrato; diversi collegamenti sono cancellati e altri sono stati tracciati. "Questa è la stella che chiamiamo Deneb," dice, indicando una stella che fino a ora era inaccessibile per via iperspaziale. "Dev'essere da lì che sono venuti."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1B|	"What do we do now?" you ask.|1189|0
units.english: "What do we do now?" you ask.
units.italian: "Che cosa facciamo adesso?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 1B|	"Well," she says, "to start out with, we need more information. I'm hoping you can somehow get past the aliens and land on <planet>, and see if they were attacked too and if so, whether anyone is still alive there. I'll stay here with the rest of the Wolf Pack in case we need to repel another attack."|1190|0
units.english: "Well," she says, "to start out with, we need more information. I'm hoping you can somehow get past the aliens and land on <planet>, and see if they were attacked too and if so, whether anyone is still alive there. I'll stay here with the rest of the Wolf Pack in case we need to repel another attack."
units.italian: "Beh," dice, "per cominciare ci servono più informazioni. Spero che tu riesca in qualche modo a superare gli alieni e ad atterrare su <planet>, per vedere se anche lì sono stati attaccati e, in caso affermativo, se qualcuno è ancora vivo. Io resto qui con il resto del Branco di Lupi, nel caso dobbiamo respingere un altro attacco."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2|name|1197|0
units.english: Report to Katya
units.italian: Riferisci a Katya

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2|description|1198|0
units.english: You met someone on Shiver who was able to give you more information about the aliens and their intentions. Report back to Katya with what you discovered.
units.italian: Su Shiver hai incontrato qualcuno in grado di darti più informazioni sugli alieni e sulle loro intenzioni. Riferisci a Katya quello che hai scoperto.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2|log|1207|0
units.english: Found out that the aliens who attacked the Wolf Pack fleet call themselves the Pug. After destroying that fleet, the aliens have not attacked anyone else except a few merchants who tried to resist them. They came from a nearby star system that did not previously have any hyperspace connections to human space, and seem intent on controlling and perhaps enslaving the local human population.
units.italian: Hai scoperto che gli alieni che hanno attaccato la flotta del Branco di Lupi si fanno chiamare Pug. Dopo aver distrutto quella flotta, gli alieni non hanno attaccato nessun altro, tranne qualche mercante che ha provato a resistergli. Sono venuti da un sistema stellare vicino che prima non aveva alcun collegamento iperspaziale con lo spazio umano, e sembrano intenzionati a controllare e forse a ridurre in schiavitù la popolazione umana del posto.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2|When you land at the spaceport on <origin>, you find no evidence of violent struggle; merchant captains are walking around freely, haggling for commodities, and conversing with each other just like in any other spaceport you have visited. However, the spaceport is also being patrolled by small groups of slender, bipedal, pale-skinned aliens. Each one is holding a metal staff that looks like some sort of weapon, but none of them move to attack you.|1209|0
units.english: When you land at the spaceport on <origin>, you find no evidence of violent struggle; merchant captains are walking around freely, haggling for commodities, and conversing with each other just like in any other spaceport you have visited. However, the spaceport is also being patrolled by small groups of slender, bipedal, pale-skinned aliens. Each one is holding a metal staff that looks like some sort of weapon, but none of them move to attack you.
units.italian: Quando atterri allo spazioporto su <origin>, non trovi traccia di violenza: i capitani mercantili camminano liberamente, contrattano merci e parlano fra loro come in qualsiasi altro spazioporto tu abbia visitato. Tuttavia lo spazioporto è anche pattugliato da piccoli gruppi di alieni snelli, bipedi e dalla pelle chiara. Ognuno tiene in mano un bastone di metallo che sembra una specie di arma, ma nessuno si muove per attaccarti.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2|	Soon after you land, you spot a man making his way towards your ship, ducking behind other ships and crates every time a group of aliens looks in his direction. If he is some sort of fugitive from them, it might be unwise to throw your lot in with him. On the other hand, he could have valuable information for you.|1210|0
units.english: Soon after you land, you spot a man making his way towards your ship, ducking behind other ships and crates every time a group of aliens looks in his direction. If he is some sort of fugitive from them, it might be unwise to throw your lot in with him. On the other hand, he could have valuable information for you.
units.italian: Poco dopo l'atterraggio, scorgi un uomo che si fa strada verso la tua nave, nascondendosi dietro altre navi e casse ogni volta che un gruppo di alieni guarda nella sua direzione. Se è una specie di fuggitivo, potrebbe essere poco saggio schierarti con lui. D'altra parte, potrebbe avere informazioni preziose per te.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2|	(Stay around and talk to him.)|1212|0
units.english: (Stay around and talk to him.)
units.italian: (Resta qui e parlagli.)

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2|	(Take off before I draw the aliens' attention.)|1214|0
units.english: (Take off before I draw the aliens' attention.)
units.italian: (Decolla prima di attirare l'attenzione degli alieni.)

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2|	You start to get ready to take off, but he gestures urgently to you. Reluctantly, you decide to wait and hear what he has to say.|1216|0
units.english: You start to get ready to take off, but he gestures urgently to you. Reluctantly, you decide to wait and hear what he has to say.
units.italian: Cominci a prepararti al decollo, ma lui ti fa cenni urgenti. Di malavoglia, decidi di aspettare e sentire che cosa ha da dire.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2|	You open your ship's hatch and allow him to come on board. "What's going on here?" you ask. "Who are these aliens?"|1218|0
units.english: You open your ship's hatch and allow him to come on board. "What's going on here?" you ask. "Who are these aliens?"
units.italian: Apri il portello della nave e lo lasci salire. "Che cosa succede qui?" chiedi. "Chi sono questi alieni?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2|	"I'm a planet-dweller," he says, "so the first I heard of it was when these ships unlike anything I'd ever seen before came down out of the sky, and hovered over the spaceport. Then they began transmitting radio messages on all frequencies, saying that this world is now a part of the Pug Protectorate, and that we must refrain from violence and give them a portion of the goods our world produces."|1219|0
units.english: "I'm a planet-dweller," he says, "so the first I heard of it was when these ships unlike anything I'd ever seen before came down out of the sky, and hovered over the spaceport. Then they began transmitting radio messages on all frequencies, saying that this world is now a part of the Pug Protectorate, and that we must refrain from violence and give them a portion of the goods our world produces."
units.italian: "Sono uno che vive sul pianeta," dice, "quindi la prima volta che ne ho sentito parlare è stato quando queste navi diverse da qualsiasi cosa avessi mai visto sono scese dal cielo e si sono fermate sopra lo spazioporto. Poi hanno cominciato a trasmettere messaggi radio su tutte le frequenze, dicendo che questo mondo ora fa parte del Protettorato Pug, e che dobbiamo astenerci dalla violenza e consegnare loro una parte dei beni che il nostro mondo produce."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2|	"Did anyone try to resist them?"|1221|0
units.english: "Did anyone try to resist them?"
units.italian: "Qualcuno ha provato a resistergli?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2|	"What do you think their intentions are?"|1223|0
units.english: "What do you think their intentions are?"
units.italian: "Che intenzioni pensi che abbiano?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2|	"Did they explain why they cut you off from the rest of the galaxy?"|1225|0
units.english: "Did they explain why they cut you off from the rest of the galaxy?"
units.italian: "Hanno spiegato perché vi hanno tagliato fuori dal resto della galassia?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2|	"A few. Their ships aren't invulnerable; a merchant in an Argosy managed to take out one of their smaller ships when it was landed with its shields down, before they blew his ship out of the air in retaliation. And those staffs they're carrying shoot some kind of stun ray, but if you cut them, they bleed, same as any other creature." He pauses, then taps the knife that is holstered at his belt and says, "Except, they bleed blue. Pale milky blue."|1229|0
units.english: "A few. Their ships aren't invulnerable; a merchant in an Argosy managed to take out one of their smaller ships when it was landed with its shields down, before they blew his ship out of the air in retaliation. And those staffs they're carrying shoot some kind of stun ray, but if you cut them, they bleed, same as any other creature." He pauses, then taps the knife that is holstered at his belt and says, "Except, they bleed blue. Pale milky blue."
units.italian: "Qualcuno. Le loro navi non sono invulnerabili; un mercante su un'Argosy è riuscito a mettere fuori uso una delle loro navi più piccole mentre era atterrata con gli scudi spenti, prima che gli facessero saltare la nave per rappresaglia. E quei bastoni che portano sparano una specie di raggio stordente, ma se li tagli sanguinano, come qualsiasi altra creatura." Si ferma, poi tocca il coltello che porta alla cintura e dice: "Solo che sanguinano blu. Un blu latteo pallido."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2|	"What do you think their intentions are?"|1231|0
units.english: "What do you think their intentions are?"
units.italian: "Che intenzioni pensi che abbiano?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2|	"Did they explain why they cut you off from the rest of the galaxy?"|1233|0
units.english: "Did they explain why they cut you off from the rest of the galaxy?"
units.italian: "Hanno spiegato perché vi hanno tagliato fuori dal resto della galassia?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2|	"Well, they want our resources, of course. And, they say they have come to bring a new era of peace and an end to all violence and conflict. I don't buy it, though; they saw that humanity was too divided to resist them, and they seized the opportunity to invade and plunder us. It's that simple."|1237|0
units.english: "Well, they want our resources, of course. And, they say they have come to bring a new era of peace and an end to all violence and conflict. I don't buy it, though; they saw that humanity was too divided to resist them, and they seized the opportunity to invade and plunder us. It's that simple."
units.italian: "Beh, vogliono le nostre risorse, naturalmente. E dicono di essere venuti a portare una nuova era di pace e a mettere fine a ogni violenza e conflitto. Io però non ci credo; hanno visto che l'umanità era troppo divisa per resistergli, e hanno colto l'occasione per invaderci e depredarci. È semplice così."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2|	"Did anyone try to resist them?"|1239|0
units.english: "Did anyone try to resist them?"
units.italian: "Qualcuno ha provato a resistergli?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2|	"Did they explain why they cut you off from the rest of the galaxy?"|1241|0
units.english: "Did they explain why they cut you off from the rest of the galaxy?"
units.italian: "Hanno spiegato perché vi hanno tagliato fuori dal resto della galassia?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2|	"I'd think that would be obvious. With the hyperspace links cut, there's no way for anyone from outside to assist us. And they struck at a part of human space without much in the way of militias or bounty hunters or Navy protection. And the few half-decent warships that happened to be in system when they attacked have already been destroyed trying to fight them."|1245|0
units.english: "I'd think that would be obvious. With the hyperspace links cut, there's no way for anyone from outside to assist us. And they struck at a part of human space without much in the way of militias or bounty hunters or Navy protection. And the few half-decent warships that happened to be in system when they attacked have already been destroyed trying to fight them."
units.italian: "Direi che è ovvio. Con i collegamenti iperspaziali tagliati, non c'è modo per nessuno da fuori di aiutarci. E hanno colpito una parte dello spazio umano senza granché in fatto di milizie, cacciatori di taglie o protezione della Marina. E le poche navi da guerra decenti che si trovavano nel sistema quando hanno attaccato sono già state distrutte nel tentativo di combatterli."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2|	"Did anyone try to resist them?"|1247|0

units.italian: "Qualcuno ha provato a resistergli?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2|	You thank him for the information, and prepare to return to the <system> system to talk with Katya. Perhaps the fact that the aliens are no longer attacking you means you can negotiate some sort of truce.|1265|0
units.english: You thank him for the information, and prepare to return to the <system> system to talk with Katya. Perhaps the fact that the aliens are no longer attacking you means you can negotiate some sort of truce.
units.italian: Lo ringrazi per le informazioni e ti prepari a tornare nel sistema <system> per parlare con Katya. Forse il fatto che gli alieni non ti attacchino più significa che è possibile negoziare una qualche tregua.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2B|name|1272|0
units.english: Visit the Pug
units.italian: Visita i Pug

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2B|description|1273|0
units.english: Locate the Pug homeworld, which is presumably in the <system> system, and see if you can negotiate with them.
units.italian: Individua il mondo natale dei Pug, che presumibilmente si trova nel sistema <system>, e vedi se puoi negoziare con loro.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2B|blocked|1280|0
units.english: You need to have a bunk free for Katya to continue with the next mission. Complete or abort whatever mission is using up all your passenger space, then return here to <origin>.
units.italian: Per continuare con la prossima missione ti serve una cuccetta libera per Katya. Completa o annulla la missione che sta occupando tutto il tuo spazio passeggeri, poi torna qui su <origin>.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2B|You report to Katya that the alien ships did not attack you on your trip to Shiver and back, and that the locals there seem to have consented to be governed by the aliens in exchange for peace. "We haven't had any further attacks here," she says. "Do you think it's safe to try to visit the alien home world?"|1286|0
units.english: You report to Katya that the alien ships did not attack you on your trip to Shiver and back, and that the locals there seem to have consented to be governed by the aliens in exchange for peace. "We haven't had any further attacks here," she says. "Do you think it's safe to try to visit the alien home world?"
units.italian: Riferisci a Katya che le navi aliene non ti hanno attaccato nel viaggio di andata e ritorno da Shiver, e che la gente del posto sembra aver acconsentito a essere governata dagli alieni in cambio della pace. "Qui non abbiamo avuto altri attacchi," dice. "Pensi che sia sicuro provare a visitare il mondo natale degli alieni?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2B|	"I think as long as we don't attack them, they won't attack us."|1288|0
units.english: "I think as long as we don't attack them, they won't attack us."
units.italian: "Penso che, finché non li attacchiamo, non ci attaccheranno."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2B|	"No, but I do want to get answers from them, and that may be the only way."|1290|0
units.english: "No, but I do want to get answers from them, and that may be the only way."
units.italian: "No, ma voglio delle risposte da loro, e forse è l'unico modo per averle."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2B|	"I'm not so sure," she says. "After all, they did attack us once before. And from what I hear from the Wolf Pack captains, the aliens were the ones who fired first. On the other hand, I don't think we have much choice, unless we want to settle down and spend the rest of our lives as alien vassals, cut off from all our friends in the rest of the galaxy."|1294|0
units.english: "I'm not so sure," she says. "After all, they did attack us once before. And from what I hear from the Wolf Pack captains, the aliens were the ones who fired first. On the other hand, I don't think we have much choice, unless we want to settle down and spend the rest of our lives as alien vassals, cut off from all our friends in the rest of the galaxy."
units.italian: "Non ne sono così sicura," dice. "Dopotutto ci hanno già attaccato una volta. E da quello che sento dai capitani del Branco di Lupi, sono stati gli alieni a sparare per primi. D'altra parte, non credo che abbiamo molta scelta, a meno di volerci sistemare e passare il resto della nostra vita come vassalli alieni, tagliati fuori da tutti i nostri amici nel resto della galassia."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2B|	"Agreed," she says. "They may choose to destroy us, but it's not like we have any other options. I don't particularly want to settle down and spend the rest of our lives as alien vassals, cut off from all our friends in the rest of the galaxy."|1298|0
units.english: "Agreed," she says. "They may choose to destroy us, but it's not like we have any other options. I don't particularly want to settle down and spend the rest of our lives as alien vassals, cut off from all our friends in the rest of the galaxy."
units.italian: "D'accordo," dice. "Potrebbero scegliere di distruggerci, ma non è che abbiamo altre opzioni. Non ho particolare voglia di sistemarmi e passare il resto della mia vita come vassalla aliena, tagliata fuori da tutti i nostri amici nel resto della galassia."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2B|	Katya boards your ship, and you get ready for a diplomatic visit to the alien homeworld.|1302|0
units.english: Katya boards your ship, and you get ready for a diplomatic visit to the alien homeworld.
units.italian: Katya sale sulla tua nave, e vi preparate a una visita diplomatica al mondo natale degli alieni.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2B|dialog|1305|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Katya hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Katya non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2B: Pugglequat|This planet is clearly one of the native Pug worlds, and not a human world that has been occupied. The architecture is entirely alien, and you see no human ships or people here, only the aliens. But, it appears to be mostly a world for mining and factories; all the aliens are busy with their work, and none seem to speak your language or have any interest in talking with you; instead they gesture towards the sky, perhaps as a way of indicating that you should visit the other Pug planet in this system.|1318|0
units.english: This planet is clearly one of the native Pug worlds, and not a human world that has been occupied. The architecture is entirely alien, and you see no human ships or people here, only the aliens. But, it appears to be mostly a world for mining and factories; all the aliens are busy with their work, and none seem to speak your language or have any interest in talking with you; instead they gesture towards the sky, perhaps as a way of indicating that you should visit the other Pug planet in this system.
units.italian: Questo pianeta è chiaramente uno dei mondi nativi dei Pug, e non un mondo umano occupato. L'architettura è del tutto aliena, e non vedi navi né persone umane qui, solo gli alieni. Ma sembra per lo più un mondo di miniere e fabbriche; tutti gli alieni sono impegnati nel loro lavoro, e nessuno sembra parlare la tua lingua o avere interesse a parlare con te; ti fanno invece cenno verso il cielo, forse per indicare che dovresti visitare l'altro pianeta Pug in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|name|1324|0
units.english: Visit <planet>
units.italian: Visita <planet>

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|description|1325|0
units.english: Visit <destination>, which was part of Free Worlds territory before the alien invasion, and see if any military equipment is still available there.
units.italian: Visita <destination>, che faceva parte del territorio delle Free Worlds prima dell'invasione aliena, e vedi se c'è ancora equipaggiamento militare disponibile.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|log|1336|0
units.english: Visited the homeworld of the Pug, the aliens who have taken over this region of space. They claim that when the Free Worlds fleet was threatening to invade Earth, they had no choice but to interfere to prevent humanity from destroying itself. They say that their plan is to slowly bring more and more human worlds under their "protection," but what they are talking about sounds more like slavery.
units.italian: Hai visitato il mondo natale dei Pug, gli alieni che hanno conquistato questa regione dello spazio. Sostengono che, quando la flotta delle Free Worlds minacciava di invadere la Terra, non avevano altra scelta che intervenire per impedire all'umanità di distruggere se stessa. Dicono che il loro piano è portare lentamente sempre più mondi umani sotto la loro "protezione", ma quello di cui parlano somiglia più alla schiavitù.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|log|1337|0
units.english: The Pug are aliens with barrel-shaped bodies, spindly legs, and milky blue blood. They claim to have intervened in the human civil war purely for the sake of preventing more bloodshed and helping humans to live together in peace.
units.italian: I Pug sono alieni dal corpo a botte, gambe esili e sangue blu latteo. Sostengono di essere intervenuti nella guerra civile umana solo per impedire altro spargimento di sangue e aiutare gli umani a vivere insieme in pace.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|This is an entirely alien world. The buildings have strangely flowing, tapered shapes not unlike the Pug starships, and from orbit you count dozens of large cities covering a large portion of the land mass. If this were a human world, you would estimate its population at over a billion. You follow one of the Pug ships that is landing, and discover a large spaceport where a surprising number of human merchant ships are parked, in addition to the aliens.|1339|0
units.english: This is an entirely alien world. The buildings have strangely flowing, tapered shapes not unlike the Pug starships, and from orbit you count dozens of large cities covering a large portion of the land mass. If this were a human world, you would estimate its population at over a billion. You follow one of the Pug ships that is landing, and discover a large spaceport where a surprising number of human merchant ships are parked, in addition to the aliens.
units.italian: Questo è un mondo interamente alieno. Gli edifici hanno forme stranamente fluide e affusolate, non dissimili dalle astronavi Pug, e dall'orbita conti dozzine di grandi città che coprono buona parte della massa continentale. Se fosse un mondo umano, stimeresti la sua popolazione in oltre un miliardo di abitanti. Segui una delle navi Pug che sta atterrando e scopri un grande spazioporto dove, oltre agli alieni, è parcheggiato un numero sorprendente di navi mercantili umane.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|	Elsewhere they have mostly ignored you, but here your ship is quickly approached by a small group of the pale-skinned, delicate aliens. The Pug are oddly proportioned, with long arms and legs but short, barrel-shaped torsos and large heads, and although they only have two legs, their gait is vaguely insectoid. "You are the ones who resisted us," one of them says. "You are not pledged to the Protectorate. Do you wish to make your vow of loyalty and peacefulness at this time?"|1340|0
units.english: Elsewhere they have mostly ignored you, but here your ship is quickly approached by a small group of the pale-skinned, delicate aliens. The Pug are oddly proportioned, with long arms and legs but short, barrel-shaped torsos and large heads, and although they only have two legs, their gait is vaguely insectoid. "You are the ones who resisted us," one of them says. "You are not pledged to the Protectorate. Do you wish to make your vow of loyalty and peacefulness at this time?"
units.italian: Altrove ti hanno per lo più ignorato, ma qui la tua nave viene subito avvicinata da un piccolo gruppo di alieni delicati e dalla pelle chiara. I Pug hanno proporzioni curiose: braccia e gambe lunghe, ma torsi corti a botte e teste grandi, e anche se hanno solo due gambe il loro passo è vagamente insettico. "Voi siete quelli che ci hanno resistito," dice uno di loro. "Non siete vincolati al Protettorato. Volete pronunciare ora il vostro voto di lealtà e di pace?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|	"No, we are here to find out why you attacked us, and to demand that you leave us alone."|1342|0
units.english: "No, we are here to find out why you attacked us, and to demand that you leave us alone."
units.italian: "No, siamo qui per scoprire perché ci avete attaccato, e per pretendere che ci lasciate in pace."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|	"We are willing to make peace, but only if you give us back control of our star systems."|1343|0
units.english: "We are willing to make peace, but only if you give us back control of our star systems."
units.italian: "Siamo disposti a fare la pace, ma solo se ci restituite il controllo dei nostri sistemi stellari."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|	"We have no wish to harm you," says the alien. "In time you will come to recognize that. We intervened in your war only to bring peace and to keep your species from doing great harm to itself. And we must maintain control of these systems until we are certain that you will not continue fighting if the links are restored."|1344|0
units.english: "We have no wish to harm you," says the alien. "In time you will come to recognize that. We intervened in your war only to bring peace and to keep your species from doing great harm to itself. And we must maintain control of these systems until we are certain that you will not continue fighting if the links are restored."
units.italian: "Non abbiamo alcun desiderio di farvi del male," dice l'alieno. "Col tempo lo riconoscerete. Siamo intervenuti nella vostra guerra solo per portare la pace e impedire alla vostra specie di fare un grande male a se stessa. E dobbiamo mantenere il controllo di questi sistemi finché non saremo certi che non continuerete a combattere se i collegamenti vengono ripristinati."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|	"If you wish us no harm, why did you slaughter our fleet?"|1346|0
units.english: "If you wish us no harm, why did you slaughter our fleet?"
units.italian: "Se non volete farci del male, perché avete massacrato la nostra flotta?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|	"You have no business invading our space and interfering in our affairs, regardless of your intentions."|1347|0
units.english: "You have no business invading our space and interfering in our affairs, regardless of your intentions."
units.italian: "Non avevate alcun diritto di invadere il nostro spazio e di intromettervi nei nostri affari, qualunque fossero le vostre intenzioni."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|	"The fleet that was carrying nuclear weapons, weapons of genocide? They chose violence, and so they perished by violence. That is justice."|1350|0
units.english: "The fleet that was carrying nuclear weapons, weapons of genocide? They chose violence, and so they perished by violence. That is justice."
units.italian: "La flotta che trasportava armi nucleari, armi di genocidio? Ha scelto la violenza, e quindi è perita di violenza. Questa è giustizia."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|	Katya says, "I still don't understand what makes you think you have the right to interfere in human affairs."|1351|0
units.english: Katya says, "I still don't understand what makes you think you have the right to interfere in human affairs."
units.italian: Katya dice: "Continuo a non capire che cosa vi faccia pensare di avere il diritto di intromettervi negli affari umani."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|	"'Interfere'?" says the alien. "We have 'interfered' many times before, and always you have benefited. If you do not believe us, ask those who live in the place you call the Deep. We helped them defeat the twisted half-human beings that you created in your foolish attempts to improve your race's genetic code. We have helped keep those creatures in check in the centuries since then. And we have helped in many other ways."|1354|0
units.english: "'Interfere'?" says the alien. "We have 'interfered' many times before, and always you have benefited. If you do not believe us, ask those who live in the place you call the Deep. We helped them defeat the twisted half-human beings that you created in your foolish attempts to improve your race's genetic code. We have helped keep those creatures in check in the centuries since then. And we have helped in many other ways."
units.italian: "'Intromettervi'?" dice l'alieno. "Ci siamo 'intromessi' molte volte in passato, e sempre ne avete tratto vantaggio. Se non ci credete, chiedete a quelli che vivono nel posto che chiamate Deep. Li abbiamo aiutati a sconfiggere le esseri metà umani e distorti che avete creato nei vostri sciocchi tentativi di migliorare il codice genetico della vostra specie. Li abbiamo aiutati a tenere a bada quelle creature nei secoli successivi. E abbiamo aiutato in molti altri modi."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|	"I'm from the Deep, and I've never heard of you before."|1356|0
units.english: "I'm from the Deep, and I've never heard of you before."
units.italian: "Io vengo da Deep, e non ho mai sentito parlare di voi."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|	"What do you want from us in return?"|1359|0
units.english: "What do you want from us in return?"
units.italian: "Che cosa volete da noi in cambio?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|	"What are you planning to do with these systems you have occupied?"|1361|0
units.english: "What are you planning to do with these systems you have occupied?"
units.italian: "Che cosa avete intenzione di fare con questi sistemi che avete occupato?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|	"Then perhaps you know of the myths of 'elves,' and of the tradition of tributation," says the alien. "We had been content with protecting your species from afar, letting your kind take our accomplishments as your own, but it is clear further intervention is necessary."|1363|0
units.english: "Then perhaps you know of the myths of 'elves,' and of the tradition of tributation," says the alien. "We had been content with protecting your species from afar, letting your kind take our accomplishments as your own, but it is clear further intervention is necessary."
units.italian: "Allora forse conoscerete i miti degli 'elfi', e la tradizione della tributazione," dice l'alieno. "Ci bastava proteggere la vostra specie da lontano, lasciando che la vostra gente prendesse i nostri successi come propri, ma è chiaro che serve un intervento ulteriore."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|	Katya says, "So you got sick of babysitting us? Don't see why that means you have to conquer us instead of leaving us alone."|1364|0
units.english: Katya says, "So you got sick of babysitting us? Don't see why that means you have to conquer us instead of leaving us alone."
units.italian: Katya dice: "Quindi vi siete stancati di farci da baby-sitter? Non vedo perché questo significhi che dovete conquistarci invece di lasciarci in pace."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|	"We have brought peace to this region," says the alien, "and we will continue to spread peace until violence has come to an end throughout human space. That is our only desire. All that we ask in return is a portion of the goods your worlds produce, to help offset the cost of watching over and protecting so many human worlds. And after some time, we will again allow human beings autonomous control of certain parts of your territory, when you show yourselves capable of living peacefully."|1366|0
units.english: "We have brought peace to this region," says the alien, "and we will continue to spread peace until violence has come to an end throughout human space. That is our only desire. All that we ask in return is a portion of the goods your worlds produce, to help offset the cost of watching over and protecting so many human worlds. And after some time, we will again allow human beings autonomous control of certain parts of your territory, when you show yourselves capable of living peacefully."
units.italian: "Abbiamo portato la pace in questa regione," dice l'alieno, "e continueremo a diffondere la pace finché la violenza non sarà finita in tutto lo spazio umano. È il nostro unico desiderio. Tutto quello che chiediamo in cambio è una parte dei beni che i vostri mondi producono, per aiutarci a sostenere il costo del sorvegliare e proteggere così tanti mondi umani. E dopo un po', permetteremo di nuovo agli esseri umani il controllo autonomo di alcune parti del vostro territorio, quando dimostrerete di essere capaci di vivere in pace."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|	"By 'spreading peace,' do you mean occupying more systems?" asks Katya.|1367|0
units.english: "By 'spreading peace,' do you mean occupying more systems?" asks Katya.
units.italian: "Con 'diffondere la pace' intendete occupare altri sistemi?" chiede Katya.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|	"We mean bringing an end to your war and your divisions," the alien says. "Those of your worlds and your people who have shown themselves unable to live peacefully, we must govern, to teach them peace. Any who attack us, we must destroy, because we are the bringers of peace, and whoever attacks us is not on the side of peace. Now, are you prepared to pledge your loyalty?"|1368|0
units.english: "We mean bringing an end to your war and your divisions," the alien says. "Those of your worlds and your people who have shown themselves unable to live peacefully, we must govern, to teach them peace. Any who attack us, we must destroy, because we are the bringers of peace, and whoever attacks us is not on the side of peace. Now, are you prepared to pledge your loyalty?"
units.italian: "Intendiamo mettere fine alla vostra guerra e alle vostre divisioni," dice l'alieno. "Quei mondi e quei popoli che si sono dimostrati incapaci di vivere in pace li dobbiamo governare, per insegnare loro la pace. Chiunque ci attacchi lo dobbiamo distruggere, perché noi portiamo la pace, e chi ci attacca non è dalla parte della pace. Ora, siete pronti a dichiarare la vostra fedeltà?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|	"I'm sorry, but you have no right to govern us."|1370|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but you have no right to govern us."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non avete il diritto di governarci."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|	"Very well, we pledge our loyalty."|1372|0
units.english: "Very well, we pledge our loyalty."
units.italian: "Molto bene, dichiariamo la nostra fedeltà."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|	"Very well, if you are not yet ready to consent to be governed by us, we will give you more time," says the alien. "In the meantime, please do not attack our ships, or we will be forced to destroy you. Which we would regret deeply." It makes an odd gesture similar to a bow, and walks off.|1376|0
units.english: "Very well, if you are not yet ready to consent to be governed by us, we will give you more time," says the alien. "In the meantime, please do not attack our ships, or we will be forced to destroy you. Which we would regret deeply." It makes an odd gesture similar to a bow, and walks off.
units.italian: "Molto bene, se non siete ancora pronti ad acconsentire a essere governati da noi, vi daremo più tempo," dice l'alieno. "Nel frattempo, per favore non attaccate le nostre navi, o saremo costretti a distruggervi. Il che ci dispiacerebbe profondamente." Fa uno strano gesto simile a un inchino e si allontana.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|	"I am pleased to hear that," it says. "In time you will come to be thankful that you were present at the beginning of this new era of peace and prosperity for your species. And do not fear for your friends in other parts of human space who are, for a time, cut off from you. You will be reunited soon, under our protection." It makes an odd gesture similar to a bow, and walks off.|1380|0
units.english: "I am pleased to hear that," it says. "In time you will come to be thankful that you were present at the beginning of this new era of peace and prosperity for your species. And do not fear for your friends in other parts of human space who are, for a time, cut off from you. You will be reunited soon, under our protection." It makes an odd gesture similar to a bow, and walks off.
units.italian: "Sono lieto di sentirlo," dice. "Col tempo arriverete a essere grati di essere stati presenti all'inizio di questa nuova era di pace e prosperità per la vostra specie. E non temete per i vostri amici in altre parti dello spazio umano che per un po' saranno tagliati fuori da voi. Vi riunirete presto, sotto la nostra protezione." Fa uno strano gesto simile a un inchino e si allontana.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|	"I don't like this at all," says Katya. "Let's head to <planet> and see if any of our equipment is left there from back when it was part of the front in the war against the Republic. Maybe we can find something useful there."|1384|0
units.english: "I don't like this at all," says Katya. "Let's head to <planet> and see if any of our equipment is left there from back when it was part of the front in the war against the Republic. Maybe we can find something useful there."
units.italian: "Non mi piace per niente," dice Katya. "Andiamo su <planet> e vediamo se resta un po' del nostro equipaggiamento, da quando era parte del fronte nella guerra contro la Repubblica. Magari troviamo qualcosa di utile."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2C|dialog|1387|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Katya hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Katya non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2D|name|1393|0
units.english: Escape Pug Space
units.italian: Fuggi dallo spazio dei Pug

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2D|description|1394|0
units.english: Disable one of the Pug ships, steal its jump drive, and use it to escape from their territory and report to the Free Worlds that an alien invasion is imminent.
units.italian: Metti fuori uso una nave Pug, rubale il motore di salto e usalo per fuggire dal loro territorio e riferire alle Free Worlds che un'invasione aliena è imminente.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2D|Just like Shiver, the spaceport on Oblivion is being patrolled by the Pug, and the locals seem to be resigned to their fate. Not surprisingly, you find that there are not many supplies left from when the main Free Worlds fleet was located here for a few days. But, at least the spaceport has a working repair shop and outfitter.|1408|0
units.english: Just like Shiver, the spaceport on Oblivion is being patrolled by the Pug, and the locals seem to be resigned to their fate. Not surprisingly, you find that there are not many supplies left from when the main Free Worlds fleet was located here for a few days. But, at least the spaceport has a working repair shop and outfitter.
units.italian: Come su Shiver, lo spazioporto su Oblivion è pattugliato dai Pug, e la gente del posto sembra rassegnata al proprio destino. Non sorprende scoprire che restano poche scorte di quando la flotta principale delle Free Worlds era di stanza qui per qualche giorno. Ma almeno lo spazioporto ha un'officina di riparazione e un banco di equipaggiamenti funzionanti.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2D|	While you are exploring the spaceport, a group of men in one of the local pubs see you walking past and gesture to you. "Hey, get in here," whispers one of them. They recognize you as a Council member, and tell you that they are leaders of a local resistance movement, biding their time and waiting for the right moment to strike back against the Pug. "Do you have a plan?" they ask.|1409|0
units.english: While you are exploring the spaceport, a group of men in one of the local pubs see you walking past and gesture to you. "Hey, get in here," whispers one of them. They recognize you as a Council member, and tell you that they are leaders of a local resistance movement, biding their time and waiting for the right moment to strike back against the Pug. "Do you have a plan?" they ask.
units.italian: Mentre esplori lo spazioporto, un gruppo di uomini in uno dei pub locali ti vede passare e ti fa cenno. "Ehi, vieni qui," sussurra uno di loro. Ti riconoscono come membro del Consiglio e ti dicono di essere i capi di un movimento di resistenza locale, in attesa del momento giusto per colpire i Pug. "Avete un piano?" chiedono.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2D|	"Sorry, not yet."|1411|0
units.english: "Sorry, not yet."
units.italian: "Scusate, non ancora."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2D|	"We'll let you know when it's time."|1412|0
units.english: "We'll let you know when it's time."
units.italian: "Vi faremo sapere quando sarà il momento."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2D|	They seem disappointed that you aren't here to liberate them immediately, but you tell them to wait and not do anything foolish, for now, and they tell you how to contact them when you are ready. Back inside your ship, you and Katya talk. "It sounds like the aliens are planning to invade more systems," she says. "We need to get a warning out somehow. And the only way to do that is with a jump drive. We'll need to disable one of the alien ships, take out its jump drive, and install it on your ship. Then we can take your ship to <planet> and contact the Senate and the rest of the Council."|1413|0
units.english: They seem disappointed that you aren't here to liberate them immediately, but you tell them to wait and not do anything foolish, for now, and they tell you how to contact them when you are ready. Back inside your ship, you and Katya talk. "It sounds like the aliens are planning to invade more systems," she says. "We need to get a warning out somehow. And the only way to do that is with a jump drive. We'll need to disable one of the alien ships, take out its jump drive, and install it on your ship. Then we can take your ship to <planet> and contact the Senate and the rest of the Council."
units.italian: Sembrano delusi che tu non sia lì per liberarli immediatamente, ma dici loro di aspettare e, per ora, di non fare niente di sciocco, e loro ti spiegano come contattarli quando sarai pronto. Tornato sulla tua nave, parli con Katya. "Sembra che gli alieni abbiano intenzione di invadere altri sistemi," dice. "Dobbiamo far uscire un avvertimento in qualche modo. E l'unico modo è con un motore di salto. Dovremo mettere fuori uso una delle navi aliene, prendere il suo motore di salto e installarlo sulla tua nave. Poi possiamo portare la tua nave su <planet> e contattare il Senato e il resto del Consiglio."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2D|	"Sounds risky, but let's give it a try!"|1415|0
units.english: "Sounds risky, but let's give it a try!"
units.italian: "Sembra rischioso, ma proviamoci!"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2D|	"Um, do we really want to risk getting the aliens mad at us?"|1417|0
units.english: "Um, do we really want to risk getting the aliens mad at us?"
units.italian: "Ehm, vogliamo davvero rischiare di far arrabbiare gli alieni?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2D|	"I don't think we have any other choice," she says. "Our friends out there need to know what is happening here. And maybe this, at last, will give the Navy a reason to stop fighting us and to begin working together for peace." Reluctantly, you agree.|1419|0
units.english: "I don't think we have any other choice," she says. "Our friends out there need to know what is happening here. And maybe this, at last, will give the Navy a reason to stop fighting us and to begin working together for peace." Reluctantly, you agree.
units.italian: "Non credo che abbiamo altra scelta," dice. "I nostri amici là fuori devono sapere che cosa sta succedendo qui. E magari questo, finalmente, darà alla Marina un motivo per smettere di combatterci e cominciare a lavorare insieme per la pace." Di malavoglia, sei d'accordo.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 2D|dialog|1422|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Katya hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive. (If your escorts don't have jump drives, try parking them so that Katya will be on your flagship.)
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Katya non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi. (Se le tue scorte non hanno motori di salto, prova a parcheggiarle in modo che Katya sia sulla tua ammiraglia.)

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3|name|1428|0
units.english: Talk to the Navy
units.italian: Parla con la Marina

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3|description|1429|0
units.english: Freya is on <planet>, presumably in Navy custody. Travel there and see if, given the current circumstances, the Navy is willing to talk with you.
units.italian: Freya è su <planet>, presumibilmente in custodia della Marina. Va' lì e vedi se, date le circostanze, la Marina è disposta a parlare con te.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3|log|1440|0
units.english: Escaped from the territory captured by the Pug by using a jump drive. Found out that Freya has been captured by the Navy while she was trying to figure out the reason for the hyperspace links disappearing. The Navy thinks that the Free Worlds are behind the hyperspace disruptions. But, making peace with the Navy may be the only way to defeat the Pug.
units.italian: Sei fuggito dal territorio conquistato dai Pug usando un motore di salto. Hai scoperto che Freya è stata catturata dalla Marina mentre cercava di capire il motivo della sparizione dei collegamenti iperspaziali. La Marina pensa che le Free Worlds siano dietro i disservizi iperspaziali. Ma fare la pace con la Marina potrebbe essere l'unico modo per sconfiggere i Pug.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3|Your ship creates quite a stir when it enters the system via jump drive, and the moment you've landed Alondo is waiting outside your hatch to speak with you. "What the heck is going on?" he says. "What happened to your fleet? And how in the world did you get access to a jump drive? We asked the Quarg to sell us one, but they gave us some vague response about 'not meddling in the affairs of other species.'"|1444|0
units.english: Your ship creates quite a stir when it enters the system via jump drive, and the moment you've landed Alondo is waiting outside your hatch to speak with you. "What the heck is going on?" he says. "What happened to your fleet? And how in the world did you get access to a jump drive? We asked the Quarg to sell us one, but they gave us some vague response about 'not meddling in the affairs of other species.'"
units.italian: La tua nave fa un certo scalpore quando entra nel sistema col motore di salto, e appena sei atterrato Alondo ti aspetta fuori dal portello per parlarti. "Che diavolo sta succedendo?" dice. "Che fine ha fatto la tua flotta? E come diamine hai fatto a procurarti un motore di salto? Abbiamo chiesto ai Quarg di venderciene uno, ma ci hanno dato qualche risposta vaga sul 'non intromettersi negli affari di altre specie'."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3|	Katya says, "We were attacked by aliens. They cut the hyperspace links. And they're likely to invade more systems. We need to warn everyone. Including the Republic and the Navy." She explains more of the situation to him, and hands him a copy of your sensor scans of the alien ships.|1445|0
units.english: Katya says, "We were attacked by aliens. They cut the hyperspace links. And they're likely to invade more systems. We need to warn everyone. Including the Republic and the Navy." She explains more of the situation to him, and hands him a copy of your sensor scans of the alien ships.
units.italian: Katya dice: "Siamo stati attaccati da alieni. Hanno tagliato i collegamenti iperspaziali. Ed è probabile che invadano altri sistemi. Dobbiamo avvertire tutti. Compresi la Repubblica e la Marina." Gli spiega meglio la situazione e gli consegna una copia delle scansioni dei sensori delle navi aliene.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3|	Alondo says, "What do you think we should do next?"|1446|0
units.english: Alondo says, "What do you think we should do next?"
units.italian: Alondo dice: "Che cosa pensate che dovremmo fare adesso?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3|	"We should negotiate a ceasefire with the Navy."|1448|0
units.english: "We should negotiate a ceasefire with the Navy."
units.italian: "Dovremmo negoziare un cessate il fuoco con la Marina."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3|	"We should find a way to restore those hyperspace links."|1450|0
units.english: "We should find a way to restore those hyperspace links."
units.italian: "Dovremmo trovare un modo per ripristinare quei collegamenti iperspaziali."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3|	Alondo says, "If they believe your story about an alien invasion, that might work. After all, if humanity is threatened by aliens, surely that takes precedence over fighting us. Only trouble is, most of the Republic seems to think that when those systems disappeared, it was some new weapon the Free Worlds had discovered. They're blaming us for it. They just captured Cebalrai and Menkent back from us, and captured Freya in the process."|1454|0
units.english: Alondo says, "If they believe your story about an alien invasion, that might work. After all, if humanity is threatened by aliens, surely that takes precedence over fighting us. Only trouble is, most of the Republic seems to think that when those systems disappeared, it was some new weapon the Free Worlds had discovered. They're blaming us for it. They just captured Cebalrai and Menkent back from us, and captured Freya in the process."
units.italian: Alondo dice: "Se credono alla tua storia dell'invasione aliena, potrebbe funzionare. Dopotutto, se l'umanità è minacciata dagli alieni, questo ha certo la precedenza sul combattere noi. L'unico problema è che la maggior parte della Repubblica sembra convinta che, quando quei sistemi sono spariti, sia stata qualche nuova arma scoperta dalle Free Worlds. Danno la colpa a noi. Ci hanno appena ripreso Cebalrai e Menkent, e hanno catturato Freya nel processo."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3|	"Freya?" asks Katya. "How did they manage to capture her?"|1455|0
units.english: "Freya?" asks Katya. "How did they manage to capture her?"
units.italian: "Freya?" chiede Katya. "Come hanno fatto a catturarla?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3|	"She was on <planet>," he says, "setting up something she called a 'graviton detector' to analyze the collapsed hyperspace link. When the Navy arrived, we told her to get out of there, but she had just had a breakthrough in her research, and all she said was, 'To hell with your war, this is more important.'" If she's still there, she may be our best hope for figuring this out.|1456|0
units.english: "She was on <planet>," he says, "setting up something she called a 'graviton detector' to analyze the collapsed hyperspace link. When the Navy arrived, we told her to get out of there, but she had just had a breakthrough in her research, and all she said was, 'To hell with your war, this is more important.'" If she's still there, she may be our best hope for figuring this out.
units.italian: "Era su <planet>," dice, "a installare qualcosa che chiamava 'rivelatore di gravitoni' per analizzare il collegamento iperspaziale collassato. Quando è arrivata la Marina, le abbiamo detto di andarsene, ma aveva appena avuto un'intuizione nella sua ricerca, e ha detto solo: 'Al diavolo la vostra guerra, questa è più importante.'" Se è ancora lì, potrebbe essere la nostra migliore speranza per capirci qualcosa.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3|	Alondo says, "That's what Freya was working on. As soon as your fleet disappeared, she began investigating, and she went to <planet> to set up something she called a 'graviton detector' pointed towards Vega. Right before that system was taken, she sent us a message that she had found some sort of residual trace of the link, maybe a way to reopen it."|1460|0
units.english: Alondo says, "That's what Freya was working on. As soon as your fleet disappeared, she began investigating, and she went to <planet> to set up something she called a 'graviton detector' pointed towards Vega. Right before that system was taken, she sent us a message that she had found some sort of residual trace of the link, maybe a way to reopen it."
units.italian: Alondo dice: "È quello su cui stava lavorando Freya. Appena la tua flotta è sparita, ha cominciato a indagare, ed è andata su <planet> a installare qualcosa che chiamava 'rivelatore di gravitoni' puntato verso Vega. Poco prima che quel sistema fosse preso, ci ha mandato un messaggio dicendo di aver trovato una specie di traccia residua del collegamento, forse un modo per riaprirlo."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3|	"Wait," says Katya, "what do you mean, 'right before the system was taken'? By whom?"|1461|0
units.english: "Wait," says Katya, "what do you mean, 'right before the system was taken'? By whom?"
units.italian: "Aspetta," dice Katya, "che cosa vuoi dire con 'poco prima che il sistema fosse preso'? Da chi?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3|	"The Navy," says Alondo. "They think the Free Worlds are behind the disappearance of those systems. And with your fleet gone, we didn't have enough ships left to resist them. Freya could have evacuated, but she stayed behind to finish her research. I believe her exact words were, 'To hell with your war, this is more important.'" If she's still there, she may be our best hope for figuring this out.|1462|0
units.english: "The Navy," says Alondo. "They think the Free Worlds are behind the disappearance of those systems. And with your fleet gone, we didn't have enough ships left to resist them. Freya could have evacuated, but she stayed behind to finish her research. I believe her exact words were, 'To hell with your war, this is more important.'" If she's still there, she may be our best hope for figuring this out.
units.italian: "Dalla Marina," dice Alondo. "Pensano che le Free Worlds siano dietro la sparizione di quei sistemi. E con la tua flotta sparita, non ci restavano abbastanza navi per resistergli. Freya avrebbe potuto evacuare, ma è rimasta per finire la sua ricerca. Credo che le sue parole esatte siano state: 'Al diavolo la vostra guerra, questa è più importante.'" Se è ancora lì, potrebbe essere la nostra migliore speranza per capirci qualcosa.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3|	"Do you think the Navy is letting her continue her research?"|1467|0
units.english: "Do you think the Navy is letting her continue her research?"
units.italian: "Pensi che la Marina la lasci continuare la sua ricerca?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3|	"Can you contact the Navy and ask them for a ceasefire?"|1469|0
units.english: "Can you contact the Navy and ask them for a ceasefire?"
units.italian: "Puoi contattare la Marina e chiedere un cessate il fuoco?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3|	"Or maybe interrogating her," says Alondo, "in which case they've at least discovered that we're as confused as they are about the hyperspace links being cut. I think whatever we do next, we'll need Freya, and we'll need the Navy. I'll contact them and ask them not to fire on your ship. But I can't guarantee they'll let you leave once you're in their control."|1473|0
units.english: "Or maybe interrogating her," says Alondo, "in which case they've at least discovered that we're as confused as they are about the hyperspace links being cut. I think whatever we do next, we'll need Freya, and we'll need the Navy. I'll contact them and ask them not to fire on your ship. But I can't guarantee they'll let you leave once you're in their control."
units.italian: "O magari la stanno interrogando," dice Alondo, "e in quel caso hanno almeno scoperto che siamo confusi quanto loro sul taglio dei collegamenti iperspaziali. Credo che, qualunque cosa facciamo adesso, avremo bisogno di Freya, e avremo bisogno della Marina. Li contatterò e chiederò di non aprire il fuoco sulla tua nave. Ma non posso garantire che ti lascino andare una volta che sei nelle loro mani."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3|	"I'll contact the Navy and tell them you're coming to negotiate, and to please not fire on your ship. That's the best I can do," says Alondo.|1477|0
units.english: "I'll contact the Navy and tell them you're coming to negotiate, and to please not fire on your ship. That's the best I can do," says Alondo.
units.italian: "Contatterò la Marina e dirò loro che stai arrivando per negoziare, e di non aprire il fuoco sulla tua nave. È il meglio che posso fare," dice Alondo.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3|	You and Katya return to your ship and prepare to make a visit to <planet>. Hopefully Freya will still be there, and the Navy will let you talk to her.|1481|0
units.english: You and Katya return to your ship and prepare to make a visit to <planet>. Hopefully Freya will still be there, and the Navy will let you talk to her.
units.italian: Tu e Katya tornate alla nave e vi preparate a una visita su <planet>. Speriamo che Freya sia ancora lì, e che la Marina ti lasci parlare con lei.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3|dialog|1485|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Katya hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Katya non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|name|1490|0
units.english: Bring Freya to <planet>
units.italian: Porta Freya su <planet>
