units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|description|1491|0
units.english: Freya thinks that if she can locate the equipment the Pug used to disrupt the hyperspace links, she may be able to restore them. Take her to <planet>, while Katya stays behind in the Navy's custody.
units.italian: Freya pensa che, se riuscisse a localizzare l'equipaggiamento che i Pug hanno usato per interrompere i collegamenti iperspaziali, potrebbe ripristinarli. Portala su <planet>, mentre Katya resta in custodia della Marina.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|log|1502|0
units.english: Convinced the Navy that the disappearing hyperspace links really are an alien attack and not some sort of Free Worlds super-weapon. Freya thinks that she might be able to undo the hyperspace disruption and allow the Navy to enter the captured territory and begin to drive the Pug back.
units.italian: Hai convinto la Marina che la sparizione dei collegamenti iperspaziali è davvero un attacco alieno e non una specie di superarma delle Free Worlds. Freya pensa di poter annullare il disturbo iperspaziale e permettere alla Marina di entrare nel territorio conquistato e cominciare a respingere i Pug.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|Surprisingly, the Navy lets you land without firing on you; the fact that you entered the system via jump drive probably made a big impression on them. But when your ship lands, it is immediately surrounded by Navy troops. Hesitantly, you and Katya disembark. You are greeted by a Navy admiral who you recognize as William Danforth, the leader of the Navy Oathkeepers. Even among the Free Worlds Danforth is spoken of with respect due to his courage and levelheadedness in battle and his leadership of countless humanitarian missions.|1506|0
units.english: Surprisingly, the Navy lets you land without firing on you; the fact that you entered the system via jump drive probably made a big impression on them. But when your ship lands, it is immediately surrounded by Navy troops. Hesitantly, you and Katya disembark. You are greeted by a Navy admiral who you recognize as William Danforth, the leader of the Navy Oathkeepers. Even among the Free Worlds Danforth is spoken of with respect due to his courage and levelheadedness in battle and his leadership of countless humanitarian missions.
units.italian: Sorprendentemente, la Marina ti lascia atterrare senza spararti; il fatto che tu sia entrato nel sistema col motore di salto deve aver fatto una bella impressione. Ma quando la nave atterra, viene subito circondata da truppe della Marina. Esitando, tu e Katya sbarcate. Vi accoglie un ammiraglio della Marina che riconosci come William Danforth, il capo degli Oathkeepers. Anche fra le Free Worlds si parla di Danforth con rispetto, per il suo coraggio e la sua lucidità in battaglia e per aver guidato innumerevoli missioni umanitarie.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|Surprisingly, the Navy lets you land without firing on you; the fact that you entered the system via jump drive probably made a big impression on them. But when your ship lands, it is immediately surrounded by Navy troops. Hesitantly, you and Katya disembark. You are greeted by Admiral Danforth, the leader of the Oathkeepers who previously assisted you to drive the Alphas and their mercenary fleet away from Poisonwood.|1509|0
units.english: Surprisingly, the Navy lets you land without firing on you; the fact that you entered the system via jump drive probably made a big impression on them. But when your ship lands, it is immediately surrounded by Navy troops. Hesitantly, you and Katya disembark. You are greeted by Admiral Danforth, the leader of the Oathkeepers who previously assisted you to drive the Alphas and their mercenary fleet away from Poisonwood.
units.italian: Sorprendentemente, la Marina ti lascia atterrare senza spararti; il fatto che tu sia entrato nel sistema col motore di salto deve aver fatto una bella impressione. Ma quando la nave atterra, viene subito circondata da truppe della Marina. Esitando, tu e Katya sbarcate. Vi accoglie l'ammiraglio Danforth, il capo degli Oathkeepers che in precedenza ti aveva aiutato a scacciare gli Alphas e la loro flotta mercenaria da Poisonwood.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|	Standing next to Danforth is someone you think might be his bodyguard: a dark-skinned woman dressed entirely in black. Even the whites of her eyes are black: when she gets closer, you can see that it is actually a scleric tattoo, an intricate Celtic knotwork pattern inked into the whites of her eyes. Surprisingly, Katya recognizes her. "Raven!" says Katya. You aren't sure if Katya sounds happy to see her, or scared.|1512|0
units.english: Standing next to Danforth is someone you think might be his bodyguard: a dark-skinned woman dressed entirely in black. Even the whites of her eyes are black: when she gets closer, you can see that it is actually a scleric tattoo, an intricate Celtic knotwork pattern inked into the whites of her eyes. Surprisingly, Katya recognizes her. "Raven!" says Katya. You aren't sure if Katya sounds happy to see her, or scared.
units.italian: Accanto a Danforth c'è quella che pensi possa essere la sua guardia del corpo: una donna dalla pelle scura vestita interamente di nero. Persino il bianco dei suoi occhi è nero: quando si avvicina, vedi che è in realtà un tatuaggio sclerale, un intricato disegno di nodi celtici inciso nel bianco degli occhi. Con sorpresa, Katya la riconosce. "Raven!" dice Katya. Non sei sicuro che Katya sembri contenta di vederla, o spaventata.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|	"Hello Councilor," says the woman.|1513|0
units.english: "Hello Councilor," says the woman.
units.italian: "Salve, consigliera," dice la donna.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|	Danforth says, "We hear you have come from the disconnected territory, and that you bring word of a potential alien invasion. Come with us, please." He ushers you into one of the Navy Cruisers that are parked nearby, and into a room you assume is his private office; the guards check you and Katya for weapons and then leave you alone with Danforth and Raven. "Now," says Danforth, "you will answer our questions."|1514|0
units.english: Danforth says, "We hear you have come from the disconnected territory, and that you bring word of a potential alien invasion. Come with us, please." He ushers you into one of the Navy Cruisers that are parked nearby, and into a room you assume is his private office; the guards check you and Katya for weapons and then leave you alone with Danforth and Raven. "Now," says Danforth, "you will answer our questions."
units.italian: Danforth dice: "Ci risulta che venite dal territorio isolato, e che portate notizie di una possibile invasione aliena. Venite con noi, per favore." Vi accompagna su uno degli incrociatori della Marina parcheggiati lì vicino, e in una stanza che supponi essere il suo ufficio privato; le guardie vi perquisiscono, te e Katya, in cerca di armi, poi vi lasciano soli con Danforth e Raven. "Ora," dice Danforth, "risponderete alle nostre domande."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|	He gestures to Raven, who walks up to you and holds out her hands. "Take my hands, please, Captain," she says.|1515|0
units.english: He gestures to Raven, who walks up to you and holds out her hands. "Take my hands, please, Captain," she says.
units.italian: Fa un cenno a Raven, che si avvicina a te e ti tende le mani. "Prendimi le mani, per favore, Capitano," dice.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|	(Take her hands.)|1517|0
units.english: (Take her hands.)
units.italian: (Prendile le mani.)

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|	"Um, why? What are you going to do to me?"|1519|0
units.english: "Um, why? What are you going to do to me?"
units.italian: "Ehm, perché? Che cosa mi farai?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|	"She's a Questioner, <first>," says Katya, quietly. "One of the ones who interrogated me when I was their prisoner. Just take her hands, and tell her nothing but the truth."|1520|0
units.english: "She's a Questioner, <first>," says Katya, quietly. "One of the ones who interrogated me when I was their prisoner. Just take her hands, and tell her nothing but the truth."
units.italian: "È una degli Interrogatori, <first>," dice Katya, sottovoce. "Una di quelle che mi hanno interrogata quando ero loro prigioniera. Prendile le mani e non dire altro che la verità."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|	Reluctantly, you take her hands, and she begins asking you questions about the aliens. You answer as truthfully as you can. Holding hands with a total stranger while she stares unblinkingly into your eyes and questions you is an uncomfortably invasive and intimate experience, heightened by your suspicion that if you tell a lie, she will somehow know. By the time she is done questioning you, you are soaked in sweat and your hands are shaking. Raven turns to Danforth and says, "They're telling the truth."|1522|0
units.english: Reluctantly, you take her hands, and she begins asking you questions about the aliens. You answer as truthfully as you can. Holding hands with a total stranger while she stares unblinkingly into your eyes and questions you is an uncomfortably invasive and intimate experience, heightened by your suspicion that if you tell a lie, she will somehow know. By the time she is done questioning you, you are soaked in sweat and your hands are shaking. Raven turns to Danforth and says, "They're telling the truth."
units.italian: Di malavoglia le prendi le mani, e lei comincia a farti domande sugli alieni. Rispondi il più sinceramente possibile. Tenere le mani di una perfetta sconosciuta mentre ti fissa negli occhi senza battere ciglio e ti interroga è un'esperienza invadente e intima in modo scomodo, accentuata dal sospetto che, se dicessi una bugia, lei in qualche modo lo saprebbe. Quando ha finito di interrogarti, sei madido di sudore e le tue mani tremano. Raven si volta verso Danforth e dice: "Dicono la verità."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|	You and Katya both breathe a sigh of relief, and Danforth says, "Very well. Let's take them to see Miss Winters."|1523|0
units.english: You and Katya both breathe a sigh of relief, and Danforth says, "Very well. Let's take them to see Miss Winters."
units.italian: Tu e Katya tirate entrambi un sospiro di sollievo, e Danforth dice: "Molto bene. Portiamoli a vedere la signorina Winters."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|	He leads you back out of his ship and to a warehouse where people in overalls and lab coats are busy working on one of the strangest machines you have ever seen. Freya is one of them. "Katya!" she says. "<first>! Glad you could join us."|1524|0
units.english: He leads you back out of his ship and to a warehouse where people in overalls and lab coats are busy working on one of the strangest machines you have ever seen. Freya is one of them. "Katya!" she says. "<first>! Glad you could join us."
units.italian: Vi guida fuori dalla sua nave e in un magazzino dove persone in tuta da lavoro e camici bianchi sono indaffarate intorno a una delle macchine più strane che tu abbia mai visto. Freya è una di loro. "Katya!" dice. "<first>! Sono contenta che siate qui."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|	"Are you working for the Navy now?"|1526|0
units.english: "Are you working for the Navy now?"
units.italian: "Ora lavori per la Marina?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|	"We heard you might have a way to reopen the hyperspace links."|1527|0
units.english: "We heard you might have a way to reopen the hyperspace links."
units.italian: "Abbiamo saputo che potresti avere un modo per riaprire i collegamenti iperspaziali."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|	"Well," she says, "technically I'm a prisoner. But they're helping me with my research."|1530|0
units.english: "Well," she says, "technically I'm a prisoner. But they're helping me with my research."
units.italian: "Beh," dice, "tecnicamente sono una prigioniera. Ma mi stanno aiutando con la mia ricerca."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|	Katya asks, "Have you figured out how to restore the hyperspace links?"|1531|0
units.english: Katya asks, "Have you figured out how to restore the hyperspace links?"
units.italian: Katya chiede: "Hai capito come ripristinare i collegamenti iperspaziali?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|	"No," says Freya, "but I at least discovered it might be possible. The links aren't severed completely, you see. There's some sort of distortion signal, actively interfering with them. If we can eliminate the interference, the links might come back. But the interference is coming from the other end."|1534|0
units.english: "No," says Freya, "but I at least discovered it might be possible. The links aren't severed completely, you see. There's some sort of distortion signal, actively interfering with them. If we can eliminate the interference, the links might come back. But the interference is coming from the other end."
units.italian: "No," dice Freya, "ma almeno ho scoperto che potrebbe essere possibile. I collegamenti non sono recisi del tutto, vedi. C'è una specie di segnale di distorsione che li disturba attivamente. Se riusciamo a eliminare l'interferenza, i collegamenti potrebbero tornare. Ma l'interferenza arriva dall'altro capo."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|	Danforth says, "Captain <last>, we will release Miss Winters to travel with you, provided that Councilor Reynolds remains here in her place. If you succeed in restoring a hyperspace link to the disconnected systems, we will release both of them. Is that an acceptable deal?"|1535|0
units.english: Danforth says, "Captain <last>, we will release Miss Winters to travel with you, provided that Councilor Reynolds remains here in her place. If you succeed in restoring a hyperspace link to the disconnected systems, we will release both of them. Is that an acceptable deal?"
units.italian: Danforth dice: "Capitano <last>, rilasceremo la signorina Winters perché viaggi con te, a condizione che la consigliera Reynolds resti qui al suo posto. Se riuscirai a ripristinare un collegamento iperspaziale verso i sistemi isolati, rilasceremo entrambe. È un accordo accettabile?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|	"Okay, we will agree to that."|1537|0
units.english: "Okay, we will agree to that."
units.italian: "Va bene, siamo d'accordo."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|	"What if Freya can't restore the link?"|1539|0
units.english: "What if Freya can't restore the link?"
units.italian: "E se Freya non riesce a ripristinare il collegamento?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|	"Then Councilor Reynolds will remain here as our prisoner," he says.|1541|0
units.english: "Then Councilor Reynolds will remain here as our prisoner," he says.
units.italian: "Allora la consigliera Reynolds resterà qui come nostra prigioniera," dice.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|	"Go, <first>," says Katya. "It's our best chance."|1542|0
units.english: "Go, <first>," says Katya. "It's our best chance."
units.italian: "Vai, <first>," dice Katya. "È la nostra migliore possibilità."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|	You return to your ship with Freya, who is carrying a large collection of sensors and equipment. "Let's try <planet> first," she says, "and see if there's any alien technology there that we can use. I hope you still have some ships left in your battle fleet to help defend us."|1544|0
units.english: You return to your ship with Freya, who is carrying a large collection of sensors and equipment. "Let's try <planet> first," she says, "and see if there's any alien technology there that we can use. I hope you still have some ships left in your battle fleet to help defend us."
units.italian: Torni alla tua nave con Freya, che porta una grande quantità di sensori e attrezzature. "Proviamo prima con <planet>," dice, "e vediamo se c'è tecnologia aliena che possiamo usare. Spero che ti restino ancora delle navi della flotta da battaglia per aiutarci a difenderci."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3A|dialog|1547|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Freya hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Freya non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3B|name|1553|0
units.english: Defend <planet>
units.italian: Difendi <planet>

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3B|description|1554|0
units.english: Freya found a piece of alien technology that she believes can be used to restore the hyperspace link. Hold off the Pug for long enough for her to figure out how it works.
units.italian: Freya ha trovato un pezzo di tecnologia aliena che ritiene utilizzabile per ripristinare il collegamento iperspaziale. Trattieni i Pug abbastanza a lungo perché lei capisca come funziona.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3B|Flying low over <planet> and hoping the Pug are not tracking you, you contact the resistance group you met earlier. Meanwhile, Freya says, "I've got an energy signal. Looks like the graviton pulses that are disrupting the hyperspace link." She gives you the coordinates, and you forward them to the resistance group. With some help from your ship's weapons, they are able to eliminate the Pug guards that are nearby.|1566|0
units.english: Flying low over <planet> and hoping the Pug are not tracking you, you contact the resistance group you met earlier. Meanwhile, Freya says, "I've got an energy signal. Looks like the graviton pulses that are disrupting the hyperspace link." She gives you the coordinates, and you forward them to the resistance group. With some help from your ship's weapons, they are able to eliminate the Pug guards that are nearby.
units.italian: Volando basso sopra <planet> e sperando che i Pug non ti stiano tracciando, contatti il gruppo di resistenza che avevi incontrato. Nel frattempo Freya dice: "Ho un segnale energetico. Sembrano gli impulsi di gravitoni che stanno disturbando il collegamento iperspaziale." Ti dà le coordinate, e tu le inoltri al gruppo di resistenza. Con un po' di aiuto dalle armi della tua nave, riescono a eliminare le guardie Pug nei paraggi.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3B|	You land your ship, meet up with the resistance fighters, and approach the facility cautiously. "That was way too easy," says Freya. "Maybe they just didn't expect anyone to fight back against them?" The building looks vaguely like a radio transmitter, and as you get closer to it the ground seems to roll and pitch beneath your feet like the deck of a boat. "Graviton waves," says Freya. "This is it, all right. Captain, do you think you can hold off the Pug for long enough for me to figure out how this thing works?"|1567|0
units.english: You land your ship, meet up with the resistance fighters, and approach the facility cautiously. "That was way too easy," says Freya. "Maybe they just didn't expect anyone to fight back against them?" The building looks vaguely like a radio transmitter, and as you get closer to it the ground seems to roll and pitch beneath your feet like the deck of a boat. "Graviton waves," says Freya. "This is it, all right. Captain, do you think you can hold off the Pug for long enough for me to figure out how this thing works?"
units.italian: Fai atterrare la nave, incontri i combattenti della resistenza e ti avvicini con cautela alla struttura. "È stato fin troppo facile," dice Freya. "Magari semplicemente non si aspettavano che qualcuno reagisse?" L'edificio assomiglia vagamente a un trasmettitore radio, e man mano che ti avvicini il terreno sembra oscillare e beccheggiare sotto i piedi come il ponte di una barca. "Onde gravitoniche," dice Freya. "È questo, senza dubbio. Capitano, pensi di poter trattenere i Pug abbastanza a lungo perché io capisca come funziona questa cosa?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3B|	"I'll do my best."|1569|0
units.english: "I'll do my best."
units.italian: "Farò del mio meglio."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3B|	"You aren't afraid that their ground troops will attack you?"|1571|0
units.english: "You aren't afraid that their ground troops will attack you?"
units.italian: "Non temi che le loro truppe di terra ti attacchino?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3B|	"We can handle them," says one of the men. "As far as we know the only weapon they have is those stun sticks. Hardly a match for real bullets. Their ships are a much bigger threat."|1573|0
units.english: "We can handle them," says one of the men. "As far as we know the only weapon they have is those stun sticks. Hardly a match for real bullets. Their ships are a much bigger threat."
units.italian: "Sappiamo gestirli," dice uno degli uomini. "Per quanto ne sappiamo, la loro unica arma sono quei bastoni stordenti. Non sono certo all'altezza di proiettili veri. Le loro navi sono una minaccia molto più seria."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3B|	The resistance fighters tell you their own fleet will be launching shortly. You return to your ship and fire up the engines. Hopefully the ships that are left over from your attack fleet will be enough to hold off the Pug until Freya finishes her work down here...|1577|0
units.english: The resistance fighters tell you their own fleet will be launching shortly. You return to your ship and fire up the engines. Hopefully the ships that are left over from your attack fleet will be enough to hold off the Pug until Freya finishes her work down here...
units.italian: I combattenti della resistenza ti dicono che la loro flotta partirà a breve. Torni alla tua nave e accendi i motori. Speriamo che le navi rimaste della tua flotta d'attacco bastino a trattenere i Pug finché Freya non finisce il suo lavoro quaggiù...

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3B|	The resistance fighters tell you their own fleet will be launching shortly. You return to your ship and fire up the engines, wishing that you had managed to keep some of the ships from your attack fleet alive, and hoping you will be able to hold off the Pug until Freya finishes her work down here...|1580|0
units.english: The resistance fighters tell you their own fleet will be launching shortly. You return to your ship and fire up the engines, wishing that you had managed to keep some of the ships from your attack fleet alive, and hoping you will be able to hold off the Pug until Freya finishes her work down here...
units.italian: I combattenti della resistenza ti dicono che la loro flotta partirà a breve. Torni alla tua nave e accendi i motori, augurandoti di essere riuscito a tenere in vita qualche nave della tua flotta d'attacco, e sperando di riuscire a trattenere i Pug finché Freya non finisce il suo lavoro quaggiù...

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3B|dialog|1583|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but there are still Pug ships circling overhead. You should take off and help finish them off.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ci sono ancora navi Pug che girano là sopra. Dovresti decollare e aiutare a finirle.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3B|dialog|1613|0
units.english: You receive a message from Freya: "Captain, we need you back down here. I think I discovered a way to restore the link, but we're going to have to go back to New Austria to do it, and quickly before the Pug have time to send more ships to this system. And, I hope you have space in your cargo bay for a bunch of equipment."
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio da Freya: "Capitano, ci serve che torni quaggiù. Credo di aver scoperto un modo per ripristinare il collegamento, ma dovremo tornare su New Austria per farlo, e in fretta, prima che i Pug abbiano il tempo di mandare altre navi in questo sistema. E spero che tu abbia spazio nella stiva per un bel po' di attrezzatura."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3C|name|1619|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Torna su <planet>

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3C|description|1620|0
units.english: Return to <planet> with Freya, carrying a "graviton reflector" that Freya thinks can be used to restore the hyperspace link.
units.italian: Torna su <planet> con Freya, portando un "riflettore di gravitoni" che secondo Freya può essere usato per ripristinare il collegamento iperspaziale.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3C|blocked|1630|0
units.english: As you are landing, Freya contacts you and says, "You're going to need ten tons of cargo space for this next mission, and a bunk for me, as well." That means you have to free up <capacity>.
units.italian: Mentre stai atterrando, Freya ti contatta e dice: "Per questa missione ti serviranno dieci tonnellate di spazio di carico, e anche una cuccetta per me." Il che significa che devi liberare <capacity>.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3C|You land near the alien facility, and Freya meets you outside, with a large piece of alien machinery loaded onto a flatbed truck. "I hope you have room for this in your cargo hold," she says. You notice that the ground no longer seems to be rocking irregularly like before, but you still feel slightly dizzy, like the horizon will not quite stay level.|1636|0
units.english: You land near the alien facility, and Freya meets you outside, with a large piece of alien machinery loaded onto a flatbed truck. "I hope you have room for this in your cargo hold," she says. You notice that the ground no longer seems to be rocking irregularly like before, but you still feel slightly dizzy, like the horizon will not quite stay level.
units.italian: Atterri vicino alla struttura aliena, e Freya ti viene incontro fuori, con un grosso pezzo di macchinario alieno caricato su un camion a pianale. "Spero che tu abbia spazio nella stiva per questo," dice. Noti che il terreno non sembra più oscillare in modo irregolare come prima, ma ti senti ancora un po' stordito, come se l'orizzonte non volesse restare del tutto livellato.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3C|	"What did you figure out?"|1638|0
units.english: "What did you figure out?"
units.italian: "Che cosa hai scoperto?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3C|	"Is the link restored yet?"|1639|0
units.english: "Is the link restored yet?"
units.italian: "Il collegamento è già ripristinato?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3C|	She says, "I couldn't figure out exactly how this technology works, but it's some sort of graviton transmitter. I was able to switch it from sending a chaotic signal, to a coherent one. In theory, that will slowly strengthen the link. But it could take years for it to reopen, and we probably only have a few days before the Pug learn what happened here and overrun this system. So, we need to go back to <planet>, the other end of the link, and set up this thing. I think it's some sort of graviton reflector." She points to the alien equipment on the truck. "With it in place, we can set up a harmonic resonance between this star system and <system>, and in theory the link will regenerate much more quickly."|1641|0
units.english: She says, "I couldn't figure out exactly how this technology works, but it's some sort of graviton transmitter. I was able to switch it from sending a chaotic signal, to a coherent one. In theory, that will slowly strengthen the link. But it could take years for it to reopen, and we probably only have a few days before the Pug learn what happened here and overrun this system. So, we need to go back to <planet>, the other end of the link, and set up this thing. I think it's some sort of graviton reflector." She points to the alien equipment on the truck. "With it in place, we can set up a harmonic resonance between this star system and <system>, and in theory the link will regenerate much more quickly."
units.italian: Dice: "Non sono riuscita a capire esattamente come funzioni questa tecnologia, ma è una specie di trasmettitore di gravitoni. Sono riuscita a farlo passare dall'invio di un segnale caotico a uno coerente. In teoria questo rafforzerà lentamente il collegamento. Ma potrebbero volerci anni perché si riapra, e probabilmente abbiamo solo pochi giorni prima che i Pug scoprano che cosa è successo qui e travolgano questo sistema. Quindi dobbiamo tornare su <planet>, l'altro capo del collegamento, e installare questa cosa. Credo che sia una specie di riflettore di gravitoni." Indica l'attrezzatura aliena sul camion. "Una volta in posizione, possiamo creare una risonanza armonica fra questo sistema stellare e <system>, e in teoria il collegamento si rigenererà molto più in fretta."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3C|	"Okay, let's give it a try!"|1643|0
units.english: "Okay, let's give it a try!"
units.italian: "Va bene, proviamoci!"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3C|	"Do you actually have any idea what you're doing?"|1645|0
units.english: "Do you actually have any idea what you're doing?"
units.italian: "Ma hai davvero idea di quello che stai facendo?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3C|	"None whatsoever," she says. "I'm just making this up as I go along, based on what I know of hyperspace physics. And for all I know the Pug ships carry the same hyperspace disruption capabilities as this facility, and this is all for naught. But let's give it a try, okay?"|1646|0
units.english: "None whatsoever," she says. "I'm just making this up as I go along, based on what I know of hyperspace physics. And for all I know the Pug ships carry the same hyperspace disruption capabilities as this facility, and this is all for naught. But let's give it a try, okay?"
units.italian: "Nessuna," dice. "Sto solo improvvisando man mano, in base a quello che so della fisica dell'iperspazio. E per quanto ne so le navi Pug potrebbero avere le stesse capacità di disturbo iperspaziale di questa struttura, e tutto questo non servirebbe a niente. Ma proviamoci, va bene?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3C|dialog|1649|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Freya and the graviton reflector hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Freya e il riflettore di gravitoni non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3D|name|1655|0
units.english: Liberate <system>
units.italian: Libera <system>

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3D|description|1656|0
units.english: Travel to the <system> system with a combined fleet of Navy and Free Worlds ships, drive off the Pug, and occupy the system so that the Pug cannot return and sever the hyperspace link again.
units.italian: Recati nel sistema <system> con una flotta congiunta di navi della Marina e delle Free Worlds, scaccia i Pug e occupa il sistema perché i Pug non possano tornare a recidere il collegamento iperspaziale.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3D|log|1667|0
units.english: Succeeded in restoring the hyperspace link to the Rasalhague system. With the Navy's help, it might now be possible to turn the tide against the Pug.
units.italian: Sei riuscito a ripristinare il collegamento iperspaziale verso il sistema Rasalhague. Con l'aiuto della Marina, ora potrebbe essere possibile ribaltare le sorti contro i Pug.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3D|Although <origin> is now back under Navy control, they gladly allow your ship to land. You help Freya to set up the alien equipment and power it on. Once again you begin to feel dizzy, and the feeling slowly builds in intensity as Freya adjusts the controls. "It's working," she says. "I've got a positive feedback loop. See if you can contact Oblivion."|1670|0
units.english: Although <origin> is now back under Navy control, they gladly allow your ship to land. You help Freya to set up the alien equipment and power it on. Once again you begin to feel dizzy, and the feeling slowly builds in intensity as Freya adjusts the controls. "It's working," she says. "I've got a positive feedback loop. See if you can contact Oblivion."
units.italian: Anche se <origin> è ora di nuovo sotto il controllo della Marina, ti lasciano atterrare volentieri. Aiuti Freya a installare l'attrezzatura aliena e ad accenderla. Ancora una volta cominci a sentirti stordito, e la sensazione cresce lentamente di intensità mentre Freya regola i comandi. "Funziona," dice. "Ho un ciclo di retroazione positivo. Prova a contattare Oblivion."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3D|	You try to establish a communications link to the resistance fighters, and brief snatches of conversation come through, interspersed with static. After a few minutes the static begins to die down, and you can hear their voices more clearly. "It's working!" says Freya.|1671|0
units.english: You try to establish a communications link to the resistance fighters, and brief snatches of conversation come through, interspersed with static. After a few minutes the static begins to die down, and you can hear their voices more clearly. "It's working!" says Freya.
units.italian: Cerchi di stabilire un collegamento di comunicazione con i combattenti della resistenza, e arrivano brevi frammenti di conversazione, intervallati da fruscii. Dopo qualche minuto il fruscio comincia a calare, e riesci a sentire le loro voci più chiaramente. "Funziona!" dice Freya.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3D|	Meanwhile, Navy and Free Worlds ships have begun pouring into the system. You suspect that the battle ahead will be a fierce one, but with a Navy war fleet on your side, it no longer feels like a hopeless cause. "The link should be strong enough for us to travel through it soon," says Freya. "Time to get back to <system>."|1672|0
units.english: Meanwhile, Navy and Free Worlds ships have begun pouring into the system. You suspect that the battle ahead will be a fierce one, but with a Navy war fleet on your side, it no longer feels like a hopeless cause. "The link should be strong enough for us to travel through it soon," says Freya. "Time to get back to <system>."
units.italian: Nel frattempo navi della Marina e delle Free Worlds hanno cominciato a riversarsi nel sistema. Sospetti che la battaglia che ci aspetta sarà feroce, ma con una flotta da guerra della Marina dalla tua parte non sembra più una causa disperata. "Il collegamento dovrebbe essere abbastanza forte perché possiamo attraversarlo a breve," dice Freya. "È ora di tornare nel sistema <system>."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 3D|dialog|1675|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but there are still Pug ships circling overhead. You should take off and help finish them off.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ci sono ancora navi Pug che girano là sopra. Dovresti decollare e aiutare a finirle.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4|name|1773|0
units.english: Defend <system>
units.italian: Difendi <system>

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4|description|1774|0
units.english: Drive off the Pug fleet that is invading <system>.
units.italian: Scaccia la flotta Pug che sta invadendo <system>.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4|Your fleet lands on <planet>, and to your surprise the locals say that soon before your fleet arrived, all the Pug who were present on the planet departed; clearly they expected your arrival and had no desire to become your prisoners. You only have a few hours to take stock of the situation before the Navy informs you that they have detected another Pug fleet incoming...|1786|0
units.english: Your fleet lands on <planet>, and to your surprise the locals say that soon before your fleet arrived, all the Pug who were present on the planet departed; clearly they expected your arrival and had no desire to become your prisoners. You only have a few hours to take stock of the situation before the Navy informs you that they have detected another Pug fleet incoming...
units.italian: La tua flotta atterra su <planet>, e con tua sorpresa la gente del posto dice che poco prima del vostro arrivo tutti i Pug presenti sul pianeta se ne sono andati; chiaramente si aspettavano il vostro arrivo e non avevano alcun desiderio di diventare vostri prigionieri. Hai solo poche ore per farti un quadro della situazione prima che la Marina ti informi di aver rilevato un'altra flotta Pug in arrivo...

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4|dialog|1790|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but there are still Pug ships circling overhead. You should take off and help finish them off.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ci sono ancora navi Pug che girano là sopra. Dovresti decollare e aiutare a finirle.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4A|name|1857|0
units.english: Equipment from <planet>
units.italian: Equipaggiamento da <planet>

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4A|description|1858|0
units.english: Travel with Freya to pick up the alien equipment that you installed on <planet> and bring it to Arabia to reopen another of the hyperspace links.
units.italian: Viaggia con Freya per recuperare l'attrezzatura aliena che hai installato su <planet> e portala su Arabia per riaprire un altro dei collegamenti iperspaziali.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4A|log|1869|0
units.english: Drove off another Pug attack. Fighting side by side together is beginning to build some camaraderie between the Free Worlds and the Navy, even though they were enemies so recently.
units.italian: Hai respinto un altro attacco dei Pug. Combattere fianco a fianco comincia a creare un po' di cameratismo fra le Free Worlds e la Marina, anche se fino a poco fa erano nemici.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4A|When you land on <origin>, the Navy and Free Worlds crews are congratulating each other on having succeeded in resisting the alien attack. Freya says, "I guess nothing creates camaraderie faster than fighting side by side against a common enemy."|1871|0
units.english: When you land on <origin>, the Navy and Free Worlds crews are congratulating each other on having succeeded in resisting the alien attack. Freya says, "I guess nothing creates camaraderie faster than fighting side by side against a common enemy."
units.italian: Quando atterri su <origin>, gli equipaggi della Marina e delle Free Worlds si congratulano a vicenda per essere riusciti a resistere all'attacco alieno. Freya dice: "Immagino che niente crei cameratismo più in fretta del combattere fianco a fianco contro un nemico comune."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4A|	"Yes, I hope our people don't get too comfortable viewing the Navy as allies."|1873|0
units.english: "Yes, I hope our people don't get too comfortable viewing the Navy as allies."
units.italian: "Sì, spero solo che la nostra gente non si abitui troppo a considerare la Marina un alleato."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4A|	"I don't think we could have won that battle without the Navy's help. Perhaps we were wrong to think we had no need for the Republic at all."|1875|0
units.english: "I don't think we could have won that battle without the Navy's help. Perhaps we were wrong to think we had no need for the Republic at all."
units.italian: "Non credo che avremmo potuto vincere quella battaglia senza l'aiuto della Marina. Forse sbagliavamo a pensare di non avere affatto bisogno della Repubblica."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4A|	"Indeed," she says. "Still, it will be hard going back to fighting them once all this is over."|1879|0
units.english: "Indeed," she says. "Still, it will be hard going back to fighting them once all this is over."
units.italian: "Esatto," dice. "Resta comunque che sarà dura ricominciare a combatterli quando tutto questo sarà finito."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4A|	"You might be right," she says. "I wonder if instead of aiming for complete independence from the Republic, all along we should have tried for something closer to what the Syndicate has: relative autonomy, but within the framework of the Republic."|1883|0
units.english: "You might be right," she says. "I wonder if instead of aiming for complete independence from the Republic, all along we should have tried for something closer to what the Syndicate has: relative autonomy, but within the framework of the Republic."
units.italian: "Potresti avere ragione," dice. "Mi chiedo se, invece di puntare all'indipendenza completa dalla Repubblica, non avremmo dovuto provare qualcosa di più simile a quello che ha il Sindacato: autonomia relativa, ma dentro il quadro della Repubblica."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4A|	You meet up with Danforth, and he says, "Well, we have a beachhead now, but it's a fragile one. Miss Winters, do you think you can open up more of the hyperspace links?"|1887|0
units.english: You meet up with Danforth, and he says, "Well, we have a beachhead now, but it's a fragile one. Miss Winters, do you think you can open up more of the hyperspace links?"
units.italian: Incontri Danforth, che dice: "Beh, ora abbiamo una testa di ponte, ma è fragile. Signorina Winters, pensa di poter aprire altri collegamenti iperspaziali?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4A|	Freya says, "Sure, if we retrieve the equipment from Tundra. But, the transmitter station wasn't exactly portable, so if we want to open up other systems not linked to this one, we'll have to find transmitters already installed there, too."|1888|0
units.english: Freya says, "Sure, if we retrieve the equipment from Tundra. But, the transmitter station wasn't exactly portable, so if we want to open up other systems not linked to this one, we'll have to find transmitters already installed there, too."
units.italian: Freya dice: "Certo, se recuperiamo l'attrezzatura da Tundra. Ma la stazione trasmettitrice non era esattamente trasportabile, quindi se vogliamo aprire altri sistemi non collegati a questo, dovremo trovare trasmettitori già installati anche lì."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4A|	Danforth says, "Let's start by trying to reestablish the connection from here to the Ascella system. If that works, I'll send part of my fleet to take Zeta Aquilae and see if they can secure another transmitter station. That would give us two routes into Pug space instead of the single bottleneck we have now. Captain <last>, would you be willing to travel back with Freya to <planet>?"|1889|0
units.english: Danforth says, "Let's start by trying to reestablish the connection from here to the Ascella system. If that works, I'll send part of my fleet to take Zeta Aquilae and see if they can secure another transmitter station. That would give us two routes into Pug space instead of the single bottleneck we have now. Captain <last>, would you be willing to travel back with Freya to <planet>?"
units.italian: Danforth dice: "Cominciamo provando a ristabilire il collegamento da qui al sistema Ascella. Se funziona, manderò parte della mia flotta a prendere Zeta Aquilae e vedere se riescono a mettere in sicurezza un'altra stazione trasmettitrice. Ci darebbe due rotte verso lo spazio dei Pug invece del singolo collo di bottiglia che abbiamo adesso. Capitano <last>, saresti disposto a tornare indietro con Freya su <planet>?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4A|	"Sure, we can leave immediately."|1891|0
units.english: "Sure, we can leave immediately."
units.italian: "Certo, possiamo partire subito."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4A|	"What if the Pug attack here in the meantime?"|1893|0
units.english: "What if the Pug attack here in the meantime?"
units.italian: "E se i Pug attaccano qui nel frattempo?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4A|	"Shouldn't we just attack the Pug homeworld while we have such a big fleet here?"|1895|0
units.english: "Shouldn't we just attack the Pug homeworld while we have such a big fleet here?"
units.italian: "Non dovremmo attaccare il mondo natale dei Pug finché abbiamo qui una flotta così grande?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4A|	"Don't worry," he says, "Navy reinforcements are arriving constantly. Soon our fleet here will be twice as strong as the one we committed to yesterday's attack." Reluctantly, you agree to trust the defenses to him while you bring Freya back into Free space to help open more of the hyperlinks.|1899|0
units.english: "Don't worry," he says, "Navy reinforcements are arriving constantly. Soon our fleet here will be twice as strong as the one we committed to yesterday's attack." Reluctantly, you agree to trust the defenses to him while you bring Freya back into Free space to help open more of the hyperlinks.
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti," dice, "i rinforzi della Marina arrivano di continuo. Presto la nostra flotta qui sarà due volte più forte di quella che abbiamo impiegato nell'attacco di ieri." Di malavoglia, accetti di affidare a lui le difese mentre porti Freya nello spazio delle Free Worlds per aiutare ad aprire altri collegamenti iperspaziali.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4A|	"'Such a big fleet'?" he says. "This is not even a twentieth of the Navy's current fighting power. And I think we'll need many more ships before we're ready to take on the alien homeworld. But don't worry, reinforcements are arriving here constantly. You go do your part, and we'll see to ours."|1902|0
units.english: "'Such a big fleet'?" he says. "This is not even a twentieth of the Navy's current fighting power. And I think we'll need many more ships before we're ready to take on the alien homeworld. But don't worry, reinforcements are arriving here constantly. You go do your part, and we'll see to ours."
units.italian: "'Una flotta così grande'?" dice. "Questa non è nemmeno un ventesimo della potenza di combattimento attuale della Marina. E credo che ci serviranno molte più navi prima di essere pronti ad attaccare il mondo natale degli alieni. Ma non preoccuparti, i rinforzi arrivano qui di continuo. Tu vai a fare la tua parte, e noi baderemo alla nostra."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4A|dialog|1905|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but you realize that Freya is on one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che Freya è su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B|name|1911|0
units.english: Equipment to <planet>
units.italian: Equipaggiamento per <planet>

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B|description|1912|0
units.english: Travel with Freya to <planet> to set up the alien equipment and see if you can reopen another one of the disrupted hyperspace links.
units.italian: Viaggia con Freya su <planet> per installare l'attrezzatura aliena e vedere se puoi riaprire un altro dei collegamenti iperspaziali interrotti.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B|blocked|1919|0
units.english: When you land on <origin>, Freya says, "Captain, it looks like you're going to need <capacity> to continue with this mission." You should free up more space, then return here.
units.italian: Quando atterri su <origin>, Freya dice: "Capitano, sembra che ti serva <capacity> per continuare questa missione." Dovresti liberare altro spazio, poi tornare qui.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B|You land on <origin> and quickly begin packing up the alien equipment that you left here earlier. Quite a few of the locals are watching you from a distance, but they seem friendly despite the fact that their world was so recently occupied by the Free Worlds against their will. Clearly your success in opening a path for the Navy to enter the disconnected region of space has become known.|1925|0
units.english: You land on <origin> and quickly begin packing up the alien equipment that you left here earlier. Quite a few of the locals are watching you from a distance, but they seem friendly despite the fact that their world was so recently occupied by the Free Worlds against their will. Clearly your success in opening a path for the Navy to enter the disconnected region of space has become known.
units.italian: Atterri su <origin> e cominci subito a imballare l'attrezzatura aliena che avevi lasciato qui. Parecchi abitanti ti osservano da lontano, ma sembrano amichevoli nonostante il loro mondo sia stato occupato dalle Free Worlds contro la loro volontà così di recente. Chiaramente il tuo successo nell'aprire una via perché la Marina entrasse nella regione isolata dello spazio è diventato di dominio pubblico.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B|	As you are setting up the alien equipment, Freya says, "Doesn't this all seem a little too... neat, to you? I mean, that the aliens close off the hyperlinks but then for some reason leave behind the exact equipment that we need to gradually reopen them? And that the requisite technology is so simple, a transmitter and a reflector? It all fits together way too well."|1926|0
units.english: As you are setting up the alien equipment, Freya says, "Doesn't this all seem a little too... neat, to you? I mean, that the aliens close off the hyperlinks but then for some reason leave behind the exact equipment that we need to gradually reopen them? And that the requisite technology is so simple, a transmitter and a reflector? It all fits together way too well."
units.italian: Mentre stai installando l'attrezzatura aliena, Freya dice: "Non ti sembra tutto un po' troppo... pulito? Voglio dire, che gli alieni chiudano i collegamenti iperspaziali e poi, per qualche ragione, lascino dietro di sé esattamente l'attrezzatura che ci serve per riaprirli pian piano? E che la tecnologia necessaria sia così semplice, un trasmettitore e un riflettore? Combacia tutto fin troppo bene."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B|	"Are you suggesting that the aliens intended for us to do exactly what we're doing?"|1928|0
units.english: "Are you suggesting that the aliens intended for us to do exactly what we're doing?"
units.italian: "Stai suggerendo che gli alieni volessero che facessimo esattamente quello che stiamo facendo?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B|	"It does all seem odd, that we could have any success at all fighting a species that is apparently so sophisticated."|1929|0
units.english: "It does all seem odd, that we could have any success at all fighting a species that is apparently so sophisticated."
units.italian: "Sembra davvero strano che possiamo avere qualche successo combattendo una specie apparentemente così sofisticata."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B|	She nods. "I have the uncomfortable feeling that we're caught up in a game we don't understand," she says. "And before we make the next move, we should get more information."|1930|0
units.english: She nods. "I have the uncomfortable feeling that we're caught up in a game we don't understand," she says. "And before we make the next move, we should get more information."
units.italian: Annuisce. "Ho la sgradevole sensazione di essere dentro a un gioco che non capiamo," dice. "E prima di fare la prossima mossa dovremmo ottenere più informazioni."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B|	"From whom?" you ask.|1931|0
units.english: "From whom?" you ask.
units.italian: "Da chi?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B|	"The Quarg," she says. "We're just a few jumps away from their space, and they claim to know what's going on throughout the galaxy. And when this crisis started and we asked them for a jump drive, they said they didn't want to meddle in the affairs of other species, which means maybe they knew another species was involved here."|1932|0
units.english: "The Quarg," she says. "We're just a few jumps away from their space, and they claim to know what's going on throughout the galaxy. And when this crisis started and we asked them for a jump drive, they said they didn't want to meddle in the affairs of other species, which means maybe they knew another species was involved here."
units.italian: "Dai Quarg," dice. "Siamo a pochi salti dal loro spazio, e sostengono di sapere che cosa succede in tutta la galassia. E quando è cominciata questa crisi e abbiamo chiesto loro un motore di salto, hanno detto che non volevano intromettersi negli affari di altre specie, il che significa che forse sapevano che qui era coinvolta un'altra specie."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B|	"Our mission is urgent. We should just continue to Arabia."|1934|0
units.english: "Our mission is urgent. We should just continue to Arabia."
units.italian: "La nostra missione è urgente. Dovremmo andare avanti verso Arabia."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B|	"Okay, let's take a detour to talk with the Quarg."|1935|0
units.english: "Okay, let's take a detour to talk with the Quarg."
units.italian: "Va bene, facciamo una deviazione per parlare con i Quarg."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B|	"Well," she says, "you're the captain, I'll leave that choice up to you."|1938|0
units.english: "Well," she says, "you're the captain, I'll leave that choice up to you."
units.italian: "Beh," dice, "sei tu il capitano, lascio decidere a te."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B|	"Thanks," she says, "Let's just hope that we can get some real answers."|1941|0
units.english: "Thanks," she says, "Let's just hope that we can get some real answers."
units.italian: "Grazie," dice, "speriamo solo di riuscire a ottenere qualche risposta vera."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B|dialog|1944|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but you realize that Freya and the graviton reflector are on one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che Freya e il riflettore di gravitoni sono su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B: Quarg|name|1950|0
units.english: Visit the Quarg
units.italian: Visita i Quarg

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B: Quarg|description|1951|0
units.english: If you want, visit the Quarg to see what they can tell you about the Pug, before you continue fighting them.
units.italian: Se vuoi, visita i Quarg per vedere che cosa possono dirti sui Pug, prima di continuare a combatterli.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B: Quarg|log|1960|0
units.english: Learned from the Quarg that they have long been aware of the presence of the Pug in the Deneb system. Apparently the Pug are from another galaxy and possess such advanced technology that even the Quarg do not dare to interfere with them.
units.italian: Hai saputo dai Quarg che sono consapevoli da molto tempo della presenza dei Pug nel sistema Deneb. A quanto pare i Pug vengono da un'altra galassia e possiedono una tecnologia così avanzata che nemmeno i Quarg osano interferire con loro.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B: Quarg|log|1961|0
units.english: However, the Pug are known to treat warfare like a game, intentionally using weaker technology when fighting less advanced species in order to give them a fair chance at winning the battle. So, fighting them will not be a lost cause, but the Quarg are unwilling to provide any assistance.
units.italian: Tuttavia, è noto che i Pug trattano la guerra come un gioco, usando intenzionalmente tecnologia più debole quando combattono specie meno avanzate, per dare loro una possibilità equa di vincere la battaglia. Quindi combatterli non sarà una causa persa, ma i Quarg non sono disposti a fornire alcun aiuto.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B: Quarg|log|1962|0
units.english: The Quarg claim that the Pug treat warfare like a game. When battling another species, the Pug will limit themselves to ships and weapons that are weak enough that the other species has a chance of defeating them.
units.italian: I Quarg sostengono che i Pug trattano la guerra come un gioco. Quando combattono un'altra specie, i Pug si limitano a navi e armi abbastanza deboli perché l'altra specie abbia una possibilità di sconfiggerli.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B: Quarg|You land on the Quarg station, but neither of you knows what to do next. How do you locate a Quarg diplomat? Do they even have such a thing? As you and Freya stand in the hangar looking somewhat lost, one of the Quarg approaches you and says, "These ones have questions?"|1964|0
units.english: You land on the Quarg station, but neither of you knows what to do next. How do you locate a Quarg diplomat? Do they even have such a thing? As you and Freya stand in the hangar looking somewhat lost, one of the Quarg approaches you and says, "These ones have questions?"
units.italian: Atterrate sulla stazione dei Quarg, ma nessuno dei due sa che cosa fare adesso. Come si trova un diplomatico Quarg? Ne hanno mai avuto uno? Mentre tu e Freya restate nell'hangar con un'aria piuttosto smarrita, uno dei Quarg vi si avvicina e dice: "Questi qui hanno domande?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B: Quarg|	Freya says, "We've been attacked by aliens who call themselves the Pug. We're wondering what you know about them."|1965|0
units.english: Freya says, "We've been attacked by aliens who call themselves the Pug. We're wondering what you know about them."
units.italian: Freya dice: "Siamo stati attaccati da alieni che si fanno chiamare Pug. Ci chiedevamo che cosa sapete di loro."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B: Quarg|	Quarg skin is normally entirely gray, as is their clothing, but several patches of skin on the Quarg's face turn red at the word "Pug." You've heard theories that this is a sign of emotion in the Quarg, but no one knows what emotion precisely. Anger? Embarrassment? The Quarg you are speaking with simply says, "Come," and leads you to a nook in one of the main hallways, where another Quarg stands behind a desk. You are struck by how little you know about this species: are you speaking to a tour guide, or to a diplomat? Is this the governor of the station, or just an expert in human languages? The Quarg behind the desk says, "Do you have questions for me?"|1966|0
units.english: Quarg skin is normally entirely gray, as is their clothing, but several patches of skin on the Quarg's face turn red at the word "Pug." You've heard theories that this is a sign of emotion in the Quarg, but no one knows what emotion precisely. Anger? Embarrassment? The Quarg you are speaking with simply says, "Come," and leads you to a nook in one of the main hallways, where another Quarg stands behind a desk. You are struck by how little you know about this species: are you speaking to a tour guide, or to a diplomat? Is this the governor of the station, or just an expert in human languages? The Quarg behind the desk says, "Do you have questions for me?"
units.italian: La pelle dei Quarg è normalmente tutta grigia, come i loro vestiti, ma diverse macchie di pelle sul volto del Quarg diventano rosse alla parola "Pug". Hai sentito teorie secondo cui sarebbe un segno di emozione nei Quarg, ma nessuno sa con precisione quale emozione. Rabbia? Imbarazzo? Il Quarg con cui stai parlando dice semplicemente: "Venite," e vi guida in un angolo di uno dei corridoi principali, dove un altro Quarg sta dietro una scrivania. Ti colpisce quanto poco sappiate di questa specie: stai parlando con una guida turistica, o con un diplomatico? È il governatore della stazione, o solo un esperto di lingue umane? Il Quarg dietro la scrivania dice: "Avete domande per me?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B: Quarg|	"Can you help us to fight the Pug?"|1968|0
units.english: "Can you help us to fight the Pug?"
units.italian: "Potete aiutarci a combattere i Pug?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B: Quarg|	"Can you give us information about the Pug?"|1969|0
units.english: "Can you give us information about the Pug?"
units.italian: "Potete darci informazioni sui Pug?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B: Quarg|	"No," it says. "Long ago we tried to resist the Pug. In retribution, they broke one of our rings." It points out the window of the station at the half-finished ringworld. "This ring is half complete, and it has taken a thousand of your years to build. The rings are our most precious creations, nearly impossible to destroy, but the Pug know how to twist and cut the fabric of space itself."|1972|0
units.english: "No," it says. "Long ago we tried to resist the Pug. In retribution, they broke one of our rings." It points out the window of the station at the half-finished ringworld. "This ring is half complete, and it has taken a thousand of your years to build. The rings are our most precious creations, nearly impossible to destroy, but the Pug know how to twist and cut the fabric of space itself."
units.italian: "No," dice. "Molto tempo fa abbiamo provato a resistere ai Pug. Per rappresaglia hanno spezzato uno dei nostri anelli." Indica dalla finestra della stazione il mondo ad anello mezzo finito. "Questo anello è completo a metà, e ci sono voluti mille dei vostri anni per costruirlo. Gli anelli sono le nostre creazioni più preziose, quasi impossibili da distruggere, ma i Pug sanno come torcere e tagliare il tessuto dello spazio stesso."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B: Quarg|	"So you've encountered the Pug before?" asks Freya. "You know about them?"|1973|0
units.english: "So you've encountered the Pug before?" asks Freya. "You know about them?"
units.italian: "Quindi avete già incontrato i Pug?" chiede Freya. "Sapete di loro?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B: Quarg|	"The Pug have meddled with the affairs of many species in this galaxy," it says, "but they are not native to it. They came here through artificial wormholes: a technology that not even the Drak possess. Their actions are unpredictable. They are either entirely illogical, or operating on a logic so far above ours that it appears as nonsense to us. They claim it is the latter: that they operate on some special knowledge of time and future."|1976|0
units.english: "The Pug have meddled with the affairs of many species in this galaxy," it says, "but they are not native to it. They came here through artificial wormholes: a technology that not even the Drak possess. Their actions are unpredictable. They are either entirely illogical, or operating on a logic so far above ours that it appears as nonsense to us. They claim it is the latter: that they operate on some special knowledge of time and future."
units.italian: "I Pug si sono intromessi negli affari di molte specie di questa galassia," dice, "ma non sono nativi di qui. Sono arrivati per mezzo di wormhole artificiali: una tecnologia che nemmeno i Drak possiedono. Le loro azioni sono imprevedibili. O sono del tutto illogici, o operano secondo una logica così superiore alla nostra da apparire priva di senso per noi. Sostengono che sia la seconda: che si muovano secondo una qualche conoscenza speciale del tempo e del futuro."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B: Quarg|	"If they're so advanced, do we have any chance of defeating them?"|1978|0
units.english: "If they're so advanced, do we have any chance of defeating them?"
units.italian: "Se sono così avanzati, abbiamo qualche possibilità di sconfiggerli?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B: Quarg|	"Do you think the Drak would join us in fighting them?"|1980|0
units.english: "Do you think the Drak would join us in fighting them?"
units.italian: "Pensi che i Drak si unirebbero a noi per combatterli?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B: Quarg|	"Yes," it says. "In battle the Pug always respond with just enough force that their opponent has a fair chance at victory."|1984|0
units.english: "Yes," it says. "In battle the Pug always respond with just enough force that their opponent has a fair chance at victory."
units.italian: "Sì," dice. "In battaglia i Pug rispondono sempre con la forza appena sufficiente perché il loro avversario abbia una possibilità equa di vittoria."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B: Quarg|	Freya is confused. "What do you mean?" she says.|1985|0
units.english: Freya is confused. "What do you mean?" she says.
units.italian: Freya è confusa. "Che cosa vuoi dire?" chiede.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B: Quarg|	"No," it says. "The Drak do not interfere in a war unless their rules are broken. And, it would not help you anyway; the Pug always adjust the strength of their fleet to give their opponent what they consider to be fair odds."|1989|0
units.english: "No," it says. "The Drak do not interfere in a war unless their rules are broken. And, it would not help you anyway; the Pug always adjust the strength of their fleet to give their opponent what they consider to be fair odds."
units.italian: "No," dice. "I Drak non interferiscono in una guerra, a meno che le loro regole non vengano infrante. E comunque non vi aiuterebbe; i Pug regolano sempre la forza della loro flotta per dare all'avversario quelle che considerano possibilità eque."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B: Quarg|	"Wait," says Freya, "you're saying they would intentionally attack us with a weaker force instead of using all their strength and guaranteeing victory?"|1990|0
units.english: "Wait," says Freya, "you're saying they would intentionally attack us with a weaker force instead of using all their strength and guaranteeing victory?"
units.italian: "Aspetta," dice Freya, "stai dicendo che ci attaccherebbero intenzionalmente con una forza più debole invece di usare tutta la loro potenza e garantirsi la vittoria?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B: Quarg|	"War is a game to the Pug," the Quarg says. "They are a strange species. Even if they start a war, their goal may not be to win it, but to lose in a certain way. We have seen them lose battles against species far less advanced than your own, even though they had weapons that would have guaranteed them victory. If they want war, you must play their game, and if you play their game, they may allow you to win."|1994|0
units.english: "War is a game to the Pug," the Quarg says. "They are a strange species. Even if they start a war, their goal may not be to win it, but to lose in a certain way. We have seen them lose battles against species far less advanced than your own, even though they had weapons that would have guaranteed them victory. If they want war, you must play their game, and if you play their game, they may allow you to win."
units.italian: "La guerra è un gioco per i Pug," dice il Quarg. "Sono una specie strana. Anche quando iniziano una guerra, il loro scopo può non essere vincerla, ma perderla in un certo modo. Li abbiamo visti perdere battaglie contro specie molto meno avanzate della vostra, anche se avevano armi che avrebbero garantito loro la vittoria. Se vogliono la guerra, dovete giocare al loro gioco, e se giocate al loro gioco, potrebbero permettervi di vincere."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B: Quarg|	"That makes no sense," says Freya. "They would die for the sake of a game?"|1995|0
units.english: "That makes no sense," says Freya. "They would die for the sake of a game?"
units.italian: "Non ha alcun senso," dice Freya. "Morirebbero per il bene di un gioco?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B: Quarg|	The Quarg pauses for a moment as if struggling for words. "I am myself, and also I am Quarg. You are yourselves, and also you are human. But we think perhaps a Pug is Pug first, and then also itself."|1996|0
units.english: The Quarg pauses for a moment as if struggling for words. "I am myself, and also I am Quarg. You are yourselves, and also you are human. But we think perhaps a Pug is Pug first, and then also itself."
units.italian: Il Quarg resta in silenzio un momento, come se cercasse le parole. "Io sono me stesso, e sono anche Quarg. Voi siete voi stessi, e siete anche umani. Ma pensiamo che forse un Pug è Pug prima, e poi anche se stesso."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B: Quarg|	"Their identity is communal, rather than individual?" says Freya.|1997|0
units.english: "Their identity is communal, rather than individual?" says Freya.
units.italian: "La loro identità è comunitaria, non individuale?" dice Freya.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B: Quarg|	"Indeed. And because they are so deeply connected, they perceive all things as being connected to them. At least, that is the best understanding we have been able to gain of their species."|1998|0
units.english: "Indeed. And because they are so deeply connected, they perceive all things as being connected to them. At least, that is the best understanding we have been able to gain of their species."
units.italian: "Esatto. E poiché sono così profondamente connessi, percepiscono tutte le cose come connesse a loro. Almeno, è la migliore comprensione che siamo riusciti a raggiungere della loro specie."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4B: Quarg|	You talk for a while longer, but gain no more information of value.|1999|0
units.english: You talk for a while longer, but gain no more information of value.
units.italian: Parlate ancora un po', ma non ottenete altre informazioni di valore.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4C|name|2005|0
units.english: Liberate <planet>
units.italian: Libera <planet>

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4C|description|2006|0
units.english: Travel to the <system> system to assist the Navy in driving out the Pug and reestablishing a direct hyperspace link to the Ascella system.
units.italian: Recati nel sistema <system> per assistere la Marina nello scacciare i Pug e nel ristabilire un collegamento iperspaziale diretto al sistema Ascella.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4C|You help Freya to unload and set up the reflector equipment, then contact the Navy on Oblivion and instruct them to point the transmitter in your direction. A few minutes later Admiral Danforth contacts you. "This link appears to be returning too," he says. "So, let's move on. We're going to make an attack on the <system> system, now, and we would welcome your assistance in this battle." You leave the equipment on <origin> and return to your ship with Freya.|2020|0
units.english: You help Freya to unload and set up the reflector equipment, then contact the Navy on Oblivion and instruct them to point the transmitter in your direction. A few minutes later Admiral Danforth contacts you. "This link appears to be returning too," he says. "So, let's move on. We're going to make an attack on the <system> system, now, and we would welcome your assistance in this battle." You leave the equipment on <origin> and return to your ship with Freya.
units.italian: Aiuti Freya a scaricare e installare il riflettore, poi contatti la Marina su Oblivion e le ordini di puntare il trasmettitore nella tua direzione. Pochi minuti dopo l'ammiraglio Danforth ti contatta. "Anche questo collegamento sembra tornare," dice. "Quindi andiamo avanti. Ora faremo un attacco al sistema <system>, e accoglieremmo con piacere il tuo aiuto in questa battaglia." Lasci l'attrezzatura su <origin> e torni alla tua nave con Freya.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4C|dialog|2024|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but there are still Pug ships circling overhead. You should take off and help finish them off.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ci sono ancora navi Pug che girano là sopra. Dovresti decollare e aiutare a finirle.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4C|log|2026|0
units.english: Succeeded in restoring a few more hyperspace connections, and in driving back the Pug (with the help of the Navy). But, Freya thinks it is way too coincidental that the aliens have left behind the exact technology needed to fix the hyperspace disruptions; it feels like the Pug are playing a game rather than fighting a serious war.
units.italian: Sei riuscito a ripristinare altri collegamenti iperspaziali e a respingere i Pug (con l'aiuto della Marina). Ma Freya pensa che sia fin troppo casuale che gli alieni abbiano lasciato dietro di sé esattamente la tecnologia necessaria per riparare i disturbi iperspaziali; sembra che i Pug stiano giocando a un gioco invece di combattere una guerra seria.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 4C|dialog|2028|0
units.english: After a few minutes of scanning the surface of <planet>, Freya locates another transmitter station that matches the one you found on Oblivion. You contact Admiral Danforth to tell him its location, and he dispatches a crew to take control of it. He also reports to you that once again, apparently all the Pug left the planet during the course of the battle. "A pity," he says. "If we had taken prisoners, maybe we could have gotten some answers from them. Anyway, meet me in the spaceport whenever you're ready to help with our next mission."
units.italian: Dopo qualche minuto di scansione della superficie di <planet>, Freya individua un'altra stazione trasmettitrice identica a quella che avevi trovato su Oblivion. Contatti l'ammiraglio Danforth per dirgli dove si trova, e lui manda un equipaggio a prenderne il controllo. Ti riferisce anche che, ancora una volta, a quanto pare tutti i Pug hanno lasciato il pianeta nel corso della battaglia. "Peccato," dice. "Se avessimo preso dei prigionieri, forse avremmo potuto ottenere qualche risposta da loro. Comunque, raggiungimi allo spazioporto quando sei pronto ad aiutare con la prossima missione."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5|name|2084|0
units.english: Liberate <system>
units.italian: Libera <system>

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5|description|2085|0
units.english: Some of the Navy ships have been outfitted with jump drives. Travel with them to the <system> system, avoiding the main Pug fleet in their home system, and reclaim control of the planet.
units.italian: Alcune navi della Marina sono state dotate di motori di salto. Viaggia con loro nel sistema <system>, evitando la flotta principale dei Pug nel loro sistema natale, e riprendi il controllo del pianeta.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5|You find Admiral Danforth supervising the repairs of the damaged Navy ships. "Glad you survived that battle!" he says. "These alien ships are much more advanced than ours, but we outnumber them, so now that we've established a strong beachhead I think we actually have a chance at defeating them. The only problem is, the majority of our fleet is still up north. With the Vega system cut off, our supply lines are having to go all the way around through the Dirt Belt. So I'd like to propose liberating Vega next."|2098|0
units.english: You find Admiral Danforth supervising the repairs of the damaged Navy ships. "Glad you survived that battle!" he says. "These alien ships are much more advanced than ours, but we outnumber them, so now that we've established a strong beachhead I think we actually have a chance at defeating them. The only problem is, the majority of our fleet is still up north. With the Vega system cut off, our supply lines are having to go all the way around through the Dirt Belt. So I'd like to propose liberating Vega next."
units.italian: Trovi l'ammiraglio Danforth che sovrintende alle riparazioni delle navi danneggiate della Marina. "Sono contento che tu sia sopravvissuto a quella battaglia!" dice. "Queste navi aliene sono molto più avanzate delle nostre, ma noi siamo più numerosi, quindi ora che abbiamo stabilito una solida testa di ponte credo che abbiamo davvero una possibilità di sconfiggerli. L'unico problema è che la maggior parte della nostra flotta è ancora a nord. Con il sistema Vega tagliato fuori, le nostre linee di rifornimento devono fare tutto il giro attraverso la Fascia di Terra. Quindi vorrei proporre di liberare Vega come prossimo passo."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5|	"That does sound like a good strategic choice."|2100|0
units.english: "That does sound like a good strategic choice."
units.italian: "Mi sembra davvero una buona scelta strategica."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5|	"How will your fleet get to Vega without traveling through the Pug home system? That system is swarming with their ships."|2101|0
units.english: "How will your fleet get to Vega without traveling through the Pug home system? That system is swarming with their ships."
units.italian: "Come farà la tua flotta ad arrivare a Vega senza passare dal sistema natale dei Pug? Quel sistema brulica delle loro navi."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5|	Danforth says, "During the battle, we managed to salvage jump drives from a few of the Pug ships. We've installed them in three of our Carriers. Hopefully, with your help, that will be enough to overcome any resistance in the Vega system. Then Miss Winters can work her magic with the hyperlinks again, and we'll be able to bring a massive reinforcement fleet from Sol."|2102|0
units.english: Danforth says, "During the battle, we managed to salvage jump drives from a few of the Pug ships. We've installed them in three of our Carriers. Hopefully, with your help, that will be enough to overcome any resistance in the Vega system. Then Miss Winters can work her magic with the hyperlinks again, and we'll be able to bring a massive reinforcement fleet from Sol."
units.italian: Danforth dice: "Durante la battaglia siamo riusciti a recuperare dei motori di salto da alcune navi Pug. Li abbiamo installati su tre delle nostre portaerei. Speriamo che, con il tuo aiuto, basti a superare qualsiasi resistenza nel sistema Vega. Poi la signorina Winters potrà fare di nuovo la sua magia con i collegamenti iperspaziali, e potremo portare dalla Sol una flotta di rinforzo imponente."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5|	"Sounds good to me," says Freya. "I wish more of our own ships had jump drives, so we could assist you."|2103|0
units.english: "Sounds good to me," says Freya. "I wish more of our own ships had jump drives, so we could assist you."
units.italian: "Mi sembra bene," dice Freya. "Vorrei che più navi nostre avessero motori di salto, così potremmo assistervi."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5|	"Indeed," says Danforth. "That's why it's so important for Captain <last>'s ship to be part of this battle. When it's all over, I want to be able to tell Parliament that this war was won by the Free Worlds and the Navy fighting side by side every step of the way. And I hope you will be able to tell your Senate the same thing, so that they will be more amenable to a compromise between us."|2104|0
units.english: "Indeed," says Danforth. "That's why it's so important for Captain <last>'s ship to be part of this battle. When it's all over, I want to be able to tell Parliament that this war was won by the Free Worlds and the Navy fighting side by side every step of the way. And I hope you will be able to tell your Senate the same thing, so that they will be more amenable to a compromise between us."
units.italian: "Esatto," dice Danforth. "È per questo che è così importante che la nave del capitano <last> faccia parte di questa battaglia. Quando sarà finita, voglio poter dire al Parlamento che questa guerra è stata vinta dalle Free Worlds e dalla Marina combattendo fianco a fianco in ogni momento. E spero che tu possa dire lo stesso al tuo Senato, così sarà più disposto a un compromesso fra noi."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5|	"I'm glad to hear you say that. Your fleet is so much stronger than ours that you could easily take all the credit."|2106|0
units.english: "I'm glad to hear you say that. Your fleet is so much stronger than ours that you could easily take all the credit."
units.italian: "Sono contento di sentirtelo dire. La tua flotta è così più forte della nostra che potresti prenderti facilmente tutto il merito."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5|	"We were the ones who discovered the aliens and the way to restore the hyperspace links. The Free Worlds deserve the real credit here."|2108|0
units.english: "We were the ones who discovered the aliens and the way to restore the hyperspace links. The Free Worlds deserve the real credit here."
units.italian: "Siamo stati noi a scoprire gli alieni e il modo di ripristinare i collegamenti iperspaziali. Il merito vero spetta alle Free Worlds."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5|	"I don't want the credit," he says, "I want peace." He wishes you the best of luck in your attack on Vega, and says to contact him as soon as the link is restored and the reinforcements are ready.|2111|0
units.english: "I don't want the credit," he says, "I want peace." He wishes you the best of luck in your attack on Vega, and says to contact him as soon as the link is restored and the reinforcements are ready.
units.italian: "Non voglio il merito," dice, "voglio la pace." Ti augura buona fortuna nell'attacco a Vega e ti dice di contattarlo appena il collegamento sarà ripristinato e i rinforzi pronti.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5|	"Captain," he says, "the point isn't who deserves more credit. The point is, how do we tell this story in a way that makes people on my side and on yours more willing to make peace with each other? That's all I care about."
