He wishes you the best of luck in your attack on Vega, and says to contact him as soon as the link is restored and the reinforcements are ready.|2114|0
units.english: "Captain," he says, "the point isn't who deserves more credit. The point is, how do we tell this story in a way that makes people on my side and on yours more willing to make peace with each other? That's all I care about." He wishes you the best of luck in your attack on Vega, and says to contact him as soon as the link is restored and the reinforcements are ready.
units.italian: "Capitano," dice, "il punto non è chi merita più merito. Il punto è come raccontiamo questa storia in modo che la gente dalla mia parte e dalla tua sia più disposta a fare la pace. È l'unica cosa che mi interessa." Ti augura buona fortuna nell'attacco a Vega e ti dice di contattarlo appena il collegamento sarà ripristinato e i rinforzi pronti.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5|dialog|2118|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but there are still Pug ships circling overhead. You should take off and help finish them off.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ci sono ancora navi Pug che girano là sopra. Dovresti decollare e aiutare a finirle.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5B|name|2153|0
units.english: Travel to <planet>
units.italian: Va' su <planet>

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5B|description|2154|0
units.english: Travel with Freya to <planet>, where you can set up the "graviton reflector" to restore the hyperspace link from Sol to the Pug territory. (She thinks Mars is a better option than a heavily populated planet like Earth.)
units.italian: Viaggia con Freya su <planet>, dove puoi installare il "riflettore di gravitoni" per ripristinare il collegamento iperspaziale dalla Sol al territorio dei Pug. (Pensa che Marte sia un'opzione migliore di un pianeta densamente popolato come la Terra.)

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5B|blocked|2162|0
units.english: When you land on <origin>, Freya says, "Captain, it looks like you're going to need <capacity> to continue with this mission." You should free up more space, then return here.
units.italian: Quando atterri su <origin>, Freya dice: "Capitano, sembra che ti serva <capacity> per continuare questa missione." Dovresti liberare altro spazio, poi tornare qui.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5B|log|2167|0
units.english: Drove the Pug out of the Vega system with the help of some Navy ships equipped with jump drives. Once again, the Pug somehow managed to evacuate all their people from the planet before the Navy arrived, as if they were already expecting to lose this system.
units.italian: Hai scacciato i Pug dal sistema Vega con l'aiuto di alcune navi della Marina dotate di motori di salto. Ancora una volta i Pug sono riusciti in qualche modo a evacuare tutta la loro gente dal pianeta prima dell'arrivo della Marina, come se si aspettassero già di perdere questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5B|Once again, the Pug seem to have anticipated your attack and evacuated all their personnel from the planet before your arrival. It's a little disconcerting that they seem to have planned for events to unfold in exactly this way. Once again, you find one of the transmitter stations, abandoned on <origin> but still in working order, and inside the station Freya locates another one of the "reflectors" that she needs in order to complete the link. "I don't get it," she says. "They should've destroyed all this before they left."|2169|0
units.english: Once again, the Pug seem to have anticipated your attack and evacuated all their personnel from the planet before your arrival. It's a little disconcerting that they seem to have planned for events to unfold in exactly this way. Once again, you find one of the transmitter stations, abandoned on <origin> but still in working order, and inside the station Freya locates another one of the "reflectors" that she needs in order to complete the link. "I don't get it," she says. "They should've destroyed all this before they left."
units.italian: Ancora una volta i Pug sembrano aver previsto il tuo attacco e aver evacuato tutto il loro personale dal pianeta prima del tuo arrivo. È un po' inquietante che sembrino aver pianificato che gli eventi andassero esattamente in questo modo. Ancora una volta trovi una delle stazioni trasmettitrici, abbandonata su <origin> ma ancora funzionante, e dentro la stazione Freya individua un altro dei "riflettori" che le servono per completare il collegamento. "Non capisco," dice. "Avrebbero dovuto distruggere tutto questo prima di andarsene."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5B|	"Yes, I hope we're not playing into some sort of trap."|2171|0
units.english: "Yes, I hope we're not playing into some sort of trap."
units.italian: "Sì, spero che non stiamo cadendo in qualche tipo di trappola."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5B|	"Well, let's just be thankful they didn't."|2173|0
units.english: "Well, let's just be thankful they didn't."
units.italian: "Beh, ringraziamo il cielo che non l'abbiano fatto."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5B|	"I suppose," she says. "I just don't like not understanding things, and I do not understand these aliens at all."|2174|0
units.english: "I suppose," she says. "I just don't like not understanding things, and I do not understand these aliens at all."
units.italian: "Immagino," dice. "È solo che non mi piace non capire le cose, e di questi alieni non capisco proprio niente."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5B|	"Indeed," she says. "It's hard to imagine that a species so advanced could be making so many tactical errors."|2177|0
units.english: "Indeed," she says. "It's hard to imagine that a species so advanced could be making so many tactical errors."
units.italian: "Esatto," dice. "È difficile immaginare che una specie così avanzata possa fare così tanti errori tattici."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5B|	You load the equipment onto your ship, and Freya says, "Let's set it up on <planet>, rather than Earth. I don't think the graviton radiation is harmful to human beings, but there's no point in placing it on such a densely populated planet."|2179|0
units.english: You load the equipment onto your ship, and Freya says, "Let's set it up on <planet>, rather than Earth. I don't think the graviton radiation is harmful to human beings, but there's no point in placing it on such a densely populated planet."
units.italian: Carichi l'attrezzatura sulla tua nave, e Freya dice: "Installiamola su <planet>, invece che sulla Terra. Non credo che le radiazioni gravitoniche siano dannose per gli esseri umani, ma non ha senso metterla su un pianeta così densamente popolato."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5B|dialog|2182|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Freya and the graviton reflector hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Freya e il riflettore di gravitoni non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5C|name|2206|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Torna su <planet>

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5C|description|2207|0
units.english: Return to <planet>, and join the Navy fleet in preparing for an attack on the Pug home system. A Free Worlds fleet will be attacking from the south at the same time.
units.italian: Torna su <planet> e unisciti alla flotta della Marina preparandoti a un attacco al sistema natale dei Pug. Una flotta delle Free Worlds attaccherà da sud nello stesso momento.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5C|As soon as Freya has set up her equipment and verified that it is working, you contact Admiral Danforth. "We're on Mars," you tell him, "and we should have the hyperspace link to Vega restored soon."|2220|0
units.english: As soon as Freya has set up her equipment and verified that it is working, you contact Admiral Danforth. "We're on Mars," you tell him, "and we should have the hyperspace link to Vega restored soon."
units.italian: Appena Freya ha installato la sua attrezzatura e verificato che funzioni, contatti l'ammiraglio Danforth. "Siamo su Marte," gli dici, "e dovremmo avere presto ripristinato il collegamento iperspaziale verso Vega."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5C|	"Excellent," he says. "Please contact your Council and arrange for your fleet to strike from the south at the same time as the fleet from Vega jumps in from the north."|2221|0
units.english: "Excellent," he says. "Please contact your Council and arrange for your fleet to strike from the south at the same time as the fleet from Vega jumps in from the north."
units.italian: "Eccellente," dice. "Per favore contatta il tuo Consiglio e organizza la vostra flotta perché colpisca da sud nello stesso momento in cui la flotta da Vega salta dentro da nord."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5C|	You contact Tomek and tell him the Navy is ready for a final assault, and he agrees to send as many ships as he can spare to join you. Now it's time to return to <planet> and await the attack signal.|2222|0
units.english: You contact Tomek and tell him the Navy is ready for a final assault, and he agrees to send as many ships as he can spare to join you. Now it's time to return to <planet> and await the attack signal.
units.italian: Contatti Tomek e gli dici che la Marina è pronta per un assalto finale, e lui accetta di mandare tutte le navi che può risparmiare per unirsi a te. Ora è il momento di tornare su <planet> e attendere il segnale dell'attacco.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 5C|dialog|2225|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Freya hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Freya non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|name|2249|0
units.english: Defeat the Pug
units.italian: Sconfiggi i Pug

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|description|2250|0
units.english: Join the Navy fleet in attacking the Pug home system. Once their fleet is eliminated, land on their home world of <planet> to attempt to negotiate for peace.
units.italian: Unisciti alla flotta della Marina nell'attacco al sistema natale dei Pug. Una volta eliminata la loro flotta, atterra sul loro mondo natale <planet> per tentare di negoziare la pace.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|blocked|2258|0
units.english: You need at least one bunk free for Freya in order to continue this mission.
units.italian: Per continuare questa missione ti serve almeno una cuccetta libera per Freya.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|You enter the Deneb system expecting a massive Pug battle fleet to be waiting for you. Instead, it is entirely deserted. Also, your sensors are picking up some sort of anomaly outside the orbit of the outermost planet.|2261|0
units.english: You enter the Deneb system expecting a massive Pug battle fleet to be waiting for you. Instead, it is entirely deserted. Also, your sensors are picking up some sort of anomaly outside the orbit of the outermost planet.
units.italian: Entri nel sistema Deneb aspettandoti una massiccia flotta da battaglia Pug ad attenderti. Invece è del tutto deserto. Inoltre i tuoi sensori captano una qualche anomalia fuori dall'orbita del pianeta più esterno.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|log|2266|0
units.english: Preparing for the final assault on the Pug homeworld. There seems to be no other option but to force them to surrender, but with the help of the Navy that no longer seems like an impossible task.
units.italian: Ti stai preparando all'assalto finale al mondo natale dei Pug. Non sembra esserci altra opzione che costringerli ad arrendersi, ma con l'aiuto della Marina non sembra più un'impresa impossibile.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|The tiny spaceport on Silver is packed with people as more and more Navy ships come in for a landing. The Navy admirals have decided that there is no sense in delaying: you will be launching an attack on the Pug homeworld in the morning. Despite your success so far in battling the Pug, you know that if their entire fleet opposes you, even the Navy may not be strong enough to defeat them. This may be the last time you see many of these officers and crew members alive.|2269|0
units.english: The tiny spaceport on Silver is packed with people as more and more Navy ships come in for a landing. The Navy admirals have decided that there is no sense in delaying: you will be launching an attack on the Pug homeworld in the morning. Despite your success so far in battling the Pug, you know that if their entire fleet opposes you, even the Navy may not be strong enough to defeat them. This may be the last time you see many of these officers and crew members alive.
units.italian: Il piccolo spazioporto su Silver è stipato di gente, mentre sempre più navi della Marina arrivano ad atterrare. Gli ammiragli della Marina hanno deciso che non ha senso rimandare: domani mattina lancerete un attacco al mondo natale dei Pug. Nonostante i successi ottenuti finora contro i Pug, sai che, se l'intera loro flotta vi si opponesse, nemmeno la Marina potrebbe essere abbastanza forte da sconfiggerli. Questa potrebbe essere l'ultima volta che vedi vivi molti di questi ufficiali e membri degli equipaggi.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	Everyone prepares for death in different ways. The spaceport's pub is packed, with the crowd spilling out into the hallway and loud music blasting. The chapel is equally full, and the sound of whispered prayers and chanting clashes with the dance music from the pub. Through the doorway of the chapel you see some people sitting cross-legged on the floor and others kneeling on prayer rugs, as the various cultures that make up the Republic do their best to share the space.|2270|0
units.english: Everyone prepares for death in different ways. The spaceport's pub is packed, with the crowd spilling out into the hallway and loud music blasting. The chapel is equally full, and the sound of whispered prayers and chanting clashes with the dance music from the pub. Through the doorway of the chapel you see some people sitting cross-legged on the floor and others kneeling on prayer rugs, as the various cultures that make up the Republic do their best to share the space.
units.italian: Ognuno si prepara alla morte a modo suo. Il pub dello spazioporto è pieno zeppo, con la folla che si riversa nel corridoio e musica ad alto volume che rimbomba. La cappella è altrettanto piena, e il suono di preghiere sussurrate e canti si scontra con la musica da ballo del pub. Dalla porta della cappella vedi alcuni seduti a gambe incrociate sul pavimento e altri inginocchiati su tappeti da preghiera, mentre le varie culture che compongono la Repubblica fanno del loro meglio per condividere lo spazio.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	You find Freya sitting in a secluded nook on the upper floor of the spaceport building, watching the stars and the drifting sand out the window. "Ready for the last battle, Captain?" she asks.|2271|0
units.english: You find Freya sitting in a secluded nook on the upper floor of the spaceport building, watching the stars and the drifting sand out the window. "Ready for the last battle, Captain?" she asks.
units.italian: Trovi Freya seduta in un angolo appartato al piano superiore dell'edificio dello spazioporto, a guardare le stelle e la sabbia che scorre fuori dalla finestra. "Pronto per l'ultima battaglia, Capitano?" chiede.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	"Sure, with the Navy at our backs I think we've got a good chance."|2273|0
units.english: "Sure, with the Navy at our backs I think we've got a good chance."
units.italian: "Certo, con la Marina alle spalle credo che abbiamo buone possibilità."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	"As ready as I'll ever be, I guess."|2274|0
units.english: "As ready as I'll ever be, I guess."
units.italian: "Pronto quanto lo sarò mai, immagino."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	She laughs. "I suppose that's the best we can hope for. Do you mind if I ride in your ship tomorrow, rather than one of the others? If this is the end, I'd rather face it with people I know." You agree. She turns back to look out the window.|2275|0
units.english: She laughs. "I suppose that's the best we can hope for. Do you mind if I ride in your ship tomorrow, rather than one of the others? If this is the end, I'd rather face it with people I know." You agree. She turns back to look out the window.
units.italian: Ride. "Immagino sia il meglio che possiamo sperare. Ti dispiace se domani viaggio sulla tua nave, invece che su una delle altre? Se questa è la fine, preferirei affrontarla con gente che conosco." Sei d'accordo. Lei si volta di nuovo a guardare fuori dalla finestra.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	Since Freya seems to want to be alone, you return downstairs, and discover that a sizable Oathkeeper fleet has arrived. In the main vestibule of the spaceport, an Oathkeeper officer is leading a group in qigong meditation. And surprisingly, you spot Admiral Danforth sitting with the Muslim prayer group and chanting in fluent Arabic. Meanwhile, the party outside the pub continues.|2276|0
units.english: Since Freya seems to want to be alone, you return downstairs, and discover that a sizable Oathkeeper fleet has arrived. In the main vestibule of the spaceport, an Oathkeeper officer is leading a group in qigong meditation. And surprisingly, you spot Admiral Danforth sitting with the Muslim prayer group and chanting in fluent Arabic. Meanwhile, the party outside the pub continues.
units.italian: Dato che Freya sembra voler restare sola, torni di sotto, e scopri che è arrivata una flotta consistente di Oathkeepers. Nel vestibolo principale dello spazioporto, un ufficiale Oathkeeper guida un gruppo in meditazione qigong. E con sorpresa scorgi l'ammiraglio Danforth seduto con il gruppo di preghiera musulmana, che canta in un arabo fluente. Intanto la festa fuori dal pub continua.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	Eventually morning comes, and you prepare your ship for the assault on the Pug homeworld...|2277|0
units.english: Eventually morning comes, and you prepare your ship for the assault on the Pug homeworld...
units.italian: Alla fine arriva il mattino, e prepari la tua nave all'assalto al mondo natale dei Pug...

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|dialog|2351|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Freya hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Freya non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|log|2353|0
units.english: The Pug have fled, apparently traveling through an artificial wormhole back to whatever galaxy they came from. And, it turns out that many of their cities on "Pugglemug" were only for show: buildings with no inhabitants, and with holograms creating the appearance of a heavily populated world. They left no advanced technology behind, and no sign of what their true intentions were, but it turns out that the fake cities here were designed for human habitation. They must have been planning this departure for a very long time.
units.italian: I Pug sono fuggiti, a quanto pare attraversando un wormhole artificiale verso qualunque galassia da cui erano venuti. E si scopre che molte delle loro città su "Pugglemug" erano solo di facciata: edifici senza abitanti, con ologrammi che creavano l'apparenza di un mondo densamente popolato. Non hanno lasciato tecnologia avanzata, né traccia di quali fossero le loro vere intenzioni, ma si scopre che le città finte qui erano progettate per l'abitazione umana. Dovevano aver pianificato questa partenza da molto, molto tempo.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|log|2354|0
units.english: Now that the Pug are gone, the Navy will be able to use the "graviton reflectors" to repair the broken hyperspace links and to reconnect all of human space.
units.italian: Ora che i Pug se ne sono andati, la Marina potrà usare i "riflettori di gravitoni" per riparare i collegamenti iperspaziali interrotti e riconnettere tutto lo spazio umano.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|log|2355|0
units.english: The Pug disappeared from human space, and left behind more questions than answers. It is possible that the true purpose of their attack was to give human beings a common enemy that would force them to band together and forget their internal struggles.
units.italian: I Pug sono spariti dallo spazio umano, lasciando dietro di sé più domande che risposte. È possibile che il vero scopo del loro attacco fosse dare agli esseri umani un nemico comune che li costringesse a unirsi e a dimenticare le loro lotte interne.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|As you bring your fleet in for a landing, you find that the main Pug spaceport is surprisingly empty. However, a group of Pug children are gathered in a loose circle on one of the landing pads. They appear to be playing some sort of game; they ignore your fleet overhead.|2361|0
units.english: As you bring your fleet in for a landing, you find that the main Pug spaceport is surprisingly empty. However, a group of Pug children are gathered in a loose circle on one of the landing pads. They appear to be playing some sort of game; they ignore your fleet overhead.
units.italian: Mentre porti la tua flotta ad atterrare, scopri che lo spazioporto principale dei Pug è sorprendentemente vuoto. Però un gruppo di bambini Pug è raccolto in cerchio su una delle piazzole. Sembrano giocare a qualcosa; ignorano la tua flotta sopra di loro.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	(Attack them.)|2363|0
units.english: (Attack them.)
units.italian: (Attaccali.)

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	(Avoid harming them and land.)|2364|0
units.english: (Avoid harming them and land.)
units.italian: (Evita di fargli del male e atterra.)

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	You fire a single shot into the center of the circle, leaving a dark scar on the landing pad and sending a plume of dust and smoke into the air. The children continue their game, as if nothing has happened.|2367|0
units.english: You fire a single shot into the center of the circle, leaving a dark scar on the landing pad and sending a plume of dust and smoke into the air. The children continue their game, as if nothing has happened.
units.italian: Spara un solo colpo al centro del cerchio, lasciando una cicatrice scura sulla piazzola e sollevando una colonna di polvere e fumo. I bambini continuano il loro gioco, come se non fosse successo niente.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	You land your ship near the circle of Pug children. They are bouncing a ball back and forth between them, and studiously ignoring your presence. Aside from the sound of the ball striking the pavement, the entire city is eerily quiet. "This is really weird," says Freya.|2369|0
units.english: You land your ship near the circle of Pug children. They are bouncing a ball back and forth between them, and studiously ignoring your presence. Aside from the sound of the ball striking the pavement, the entire city is eerily quiet. "This is really weird," says Freya.
units.italian: Fai atterrare la nave vicino al cerchio dei bambini Pug. Si passano una palla avanti e indietro, e ignorano ostinatamente la tua presenza. A parte il rumore della palla che colpisce l'asfalto, l'intera città è inquietantemente silenziosa. "È davvero strano," dice Freya.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	(Explore the city.)|2371|0
units.english: (Explore the city.)
units.italian: (Esplora la città.)

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	(Join the game.)|2373|0
units.english: (Join the game.)
units.italian: (Unisciti al gioco.)

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	You step into the circle and make a grab for the ball, but it passes straight through your fingers. Freya reaches out to touch one of the children, and her hand, too, passes through them. "Some sort of holographic projection," she says.|2377|0
units.english: You step into the circle and make a grab for the ball, but it passes straight through your fingers. Freya reaches out to touch one of the children, and her hand, too, passes through them. "Some sort of holographic projection," she says.
units.italian: Entri nel cerchio e cerchi di afferrare la palla, ma ti passa dritta attraverso le dita. Freya allunga la mano per toccare uno dei bambini, e anche la sua mano li attraversa. "Qualche tipo di proiezione olografica," dice.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	The Navy ships are beginning to land and send crew out to explore. You and Freya walk into the city, passing by a pair of adult Pug who sit at a table outside what looks like some sort of cafe, playing a board game with black and white stones on a hexagonal grid. You check and find that they, too, are a holographic illusion.|2378|0
units.english: The Navy ships are beginning to land and send crew out to explore. You and Freya walk into the city, passing by a pair of adult Pug who sit at a table outside what looks like some sort of cafe, playing a board game with black and white stones on a hexagonal grid. You check and find that they, too, are a holographic illusion.
units.italian: Le navi della Marina cominciano ad atterrare e a mandare gli equipaggi a esplorare. Tu e Freya entrate in città, passando accanto a due Pug adulti seduti a un tavolo fuori da quello che sembra una specie di caffè, che giocano a un gioco da tavolo con pietre bianche e nere su una griglia esagonale. Controlli e scopri che anche loro sono un'illusione olografica.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	The Navy ships are beginning to land and send crew out to explore. You and Freya walk into the city. The streets are mostly deserted, but on one of them you pass by a pair of adult Pug who sit at a table outside what looks like some sort of cafe, playing a board game with black and white stones on a hexagonal grid.|2382|0
units.english: The Navy ships are beginning to land and send crew out to explore. You and Freya walk into the city. The streets are mostly deserted, but on one of them you pass by a pair of adult Pug who sit at a table outside what looks like some sort of cafe, playing a board game with black and white stones on a hexagonal grid.
units.italian: Le navi della Marina cominciano ad atterrare e a mandare gli equipaggi a esplorare. Tu e Freya entrate in città. Le strade sono per lo più deserte, ma in una passate accanto a due Pug adulti seduti a un tavolo fuori da quello che sembra una specie di caffè, che giocano a un gioco da tavolo con pietre bianche e nere su una griglia esagonale.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	(Attack them.)|2384|0
units.english: (Attack them.)
units.italian: (Attaccali.)

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	(Try to talk to them.)|2386|0
units.english: (Try to talk to them.)
units.italian: (Prova a parlare con loro.)

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	You throw a punch at one of the Pug at the table, but your fist passes right through its head as if nothing is there. Surprised, Freya reaches out to touch the other one, and again her hand passes through them. "Some sort of holographic projection," she says. You continue exploring.|2390|0
units.english: You throw a punch at one of the Pug at the table, but your fist passes right through its head as if nothing is there. Surprised, Freya reaches out to touch the other one, and again her hand passes through them. "Some sort of holographic projection," she says. You continue exploring.
units.italian: Tiri un pugno a uno dei Pug al tavolo, ma il tuo pugno attraversa la sua testa come se non ci fosse nulla. Sorpresa, Freya allunga la mano per toccare l'altro, e di nuovo la sua mano li attraversa. "Qualche tipo di proiezione olografica," dice. Continuate a esplorare.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	You try to talk to the Pug, but they, like the children, are ignoring you completely; they do not even seem to be aware of your existence. Finally, Freya reaches out to shake one of them by the shoulder, and her hand passes straight through it. Surprised, she waves her hands back and forth through both of them. "Some sort of holographic projection," she says.|2394|0
units.english: You try to talk to the Pug, but they, like the children, are ignoring you completely; they do not even seem to be aware of your existence. Finally, Freya reaches out to shake one of them by the shoulder, and her hand passes straight through it. Surprised, she waves her hands back and forth through both of them. "Some sort of holographic projection," she says.
units.italian: Provi a parlare con i Pug, ma loro, come i bambini, ti ignorano completamente; non sembrano nemmeno accorgersi della tua esistenza. Alla fine Freya allunga la mano per scuotere uno di loro per la spalla, e la sua mano lo attraversa. Sorpresa, agita le mani avanti e indietro attraverso entrambi. "Qualche tipo di proiezione olografica," dice.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	You continue to explore for a while. Aside from the illusions, the city seems to be deserted. "Let's check inside one of the houses," Freya says at last. You climb up the steps to what looks like an apartment building and find that all the doors are unlocked. Inside one of the living spaces, you explore the different rooms and find that the water fixtures and electricity are working, but a thick layer of dust covers everything. Freya, meanwhile, is staring at one of the electrical outlets. "<first>," she says, "do you see anything odd about this?"|2398|0
units.english: You continue to explore for a while. Aside from the illusions, the city seems to be deserted. "Let's check inside one of the houses," Freya says at last. You climb up the steps to what looks like an apartment building and find that all the doors are unlocked. Inside one of the living spaces, you explore the different rooms and find that the water fixtures and electricity are working, but a thick layer of dust covers everything. Freya, meanwhile, is staring at one of the electrical outlets. "<first>," she says, "do you see anything odd about this?"
units.italian: Continuate a esplorare per un po'. A parte le illusioni, la città sembra deserta. "Diamo un'occhiata dentro una delle case," dice alla fine Freya. Salite i gradini di quello che sembra un edificio di appartamenti e scoprite che tutte le porte sono aperte. Dentro uno degli alloggi esplorate le varie stanze e scoprite che gli impianti idraulici e l'elettricità funzionano, ma uno spesso strato di polvere copre ogni cosa. Freya, intanto, fissa una delle prese elettriche. "<first>," dice, "ci vedi niente di strano?"

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	"No, it's just an ordinary electric outlet."|2400|0
units.english: "No, it's just an ordinary electric outlet."
units.italian: "No, è una normale presa elettrica."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	"Everything here is odd. The city, the holograms, all of it."|2401|0
units.english: "Everything here is odd. The city, the holograms, all of it."
units.italian: "Qui è tutto strano. La città, gli ologrammi, tutto."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	She says, "It's an ordinary, human style electrical outlet. Human. In an alien city. And the steps we came up to get here: the Pug have legs half again as long as ours. But the tread spacing was at the normal human height. This building wasn't made for the Pug. It was made for us."|2402|0
units.english: She says, "It's an ordinary, human style electrical outlet. Human. In an alien city. And the steps we came up to get here: the Pug have legs half again as long as ours. But the tread spacing was at the normal human height. This building wasn't made for the Pug. It was made for us."
units.italian: Dice: "È una presa elettrica normale, di tipo umano. Umana. In una città aliena. E i gradini che abbiamo salito per arrivare qui: i Pug hanno le gambe una volta e mezza le nostre. Ma l'altezza dei gradini era quella normale per un umano. Questo edificio non è stato fatto per i Pug. È stato fatto per noi."

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	Reports begin coming in as the Navy explores the rest of the planet, and they are all finding the same thing: the cities are abandoned, many of them with signs that they were never inhabited in the first place. The first time you visited this planet, you thought it must have a billion inhabitants, but now it seems that its true population was less than a million - all of whom have apparently departed to somewhere beyond the wormhole.|2403|0
units.english: Reports begin coming in as the Navy explores the rest of the planet, and they are all finding the same thing: the cities are abandoned, many of them with signs that they were never inhabited in the first place. The first time you visited this planet, you thought it must have a billion inhabitants, but now it seems that its true population was less than a million - all of whom have apparently departed to somewhere beyond the wormhole.
units.italian: Cominciano ad arrivare rapporti mentre la Marina esplora il resto del pianeta, e trovano tutti la stessa cosa: le città sono abbandonate, molte con segni che non sono mai state abitate. La prima volta che hai visitato questo pianeta, hai pensato che dovesse avere un miliardo di abitanti, ma ora sembra che la popolazione reale fosse meno di un milione: tutti quanti, a quanto pare, partiti verso un luogo oltre il wormhole.

units.id: mission:FWC Pug 6|	Freya says, "Let's get back to the spaceport and meet up with the admirals."|2404|0
units.english: Freya says, "Let's get back to the spaceport and meet up with the admirals."
units.italian: Freya dice: "Torniamo allo spazioporto e incontriamo gli ammiragli."

units.id: mission:FWC End|name|2409|0
units.english: Talk to Parliament
units.italian: Parla con il Parlamento

units.id: mission:FWC End|description|2410|0
units.english: Travel to Earth for another meeting with Parliament. Alondo and Katya will meet you there. (Hopefully it will go better than your last visit.)
units.italian: Va' sulla Terra per un altro incontro con il Parlamento. Alondo e Katya ti incontreranno lì. (Speriamo che vada meglio della tua ultima visita.)

units.id: mission:FWC End|blocked|2417|0
units.english: You need at least one bunk free for Freya in order to continue this mission.
units.italian: Per continuare questa missione ti serve almeno una cuccetta libera per Freya.

units.id: mission:FWC End|You find Admiral Danforth inspecting the Pug spaceport. "This is all very odd," he says. "I'm glad the aliens appear to have left, but I wish we knew where they came from and whether they're likely to return."|2424|0
units.english: You find Admiral Danforth inspecting the Pug spaceport. "This is all very odd," he says. "I'm glad the aliens appear to have left, but I wish we knew where they came from and whether they're likely to return."
units.italian: Trovi l'ammiraglio Danforth che ispeziona lo spazioporto dei Pug. "È tutto molto strano," dice. "Sono contento che gli alieni sembrino essersene andati, ma vorrei sapere da dove sono venuti e se è probabile che tornino."

units.id: mission:FWC End|	Freya says, "What should we do now?"|2425|0
units.english: Freya says, "What should we do now?"
units.italian: Freya dice: "Che cosa dovremmo fare adesso?"

units.id: mission:FWC End|	"I've contacted New Austria and told them that Councilor Reynolds is free to leave," he says. "She told me that your Senate has agreed to the Free Worlds being a semi-autonomous district of the Republic, similar to the Syndicate systems. She also asked that you and Captain <last> meet up with her and Alondo Gruyere on Earth, where they will be meeting with Parliament. I sent a report to Earth that places a very heavy emphasis on the role that the Free Worlds played in this victory, so Parliament ought to be quite willing to negotiate with you."|2426|0
units.english: "I've contacted New Austria and told them that Councilor Reynolds is free to leave," he says. "She told me that your Senate has agreed to the Free Worlds being a semi-autonomous district of the Republic, similar to the Syndicate systems. She also asked that you and Captain <last> meet up with her and Alondo Gruyere on Earth, where they will be meeting with Parliament. I sent a report to Earth that places a very heavy emphasis on the role that the Free Worlds played in this victory, so Parliament ought to be quite willing to negotiate with you."
units.italian: "Ho contattato New Austria e ho detto loro che la consigliera Reynolds è libera di andarsene," dice. "Mi ha detto che il vostro Senato ha accettato che le Free Worlds diventino un distretto semiautonomo della Repubblica, simile ai sistemi del Sindacato. Ha anche chiesto che tu e il capitano <last> la incontriate insieme ad Alondo Gruyere sulla Terra, dove si incontreranno con il Parlamento. Ho mandato alla Terra un rapporto che sottolinea con molta forza il ruolo che le Free Worlds hanno avuto in questa vittoria, quindi il Parlamento dovrebbe essere abbastanza disposto a negoziare con voi."

units.id: mission:FWC End|	"Thank you. It's been an honor to fight alongside you."|2428|0
units.english: "Thank you. It's been an honor to fight alongside you."
units.italian: "Grazie. È stato un onore combattere al tuo fianco."

units.id: mission:FWC End|	"Last time we visited Parliament, they violated our safe passage agreement and put us on trial."|2430|0
units.english: "Last time we visited Parliament, they violated our safe passage agreement and put us on trial."
units.italian: "L'ultima volta che abbiamo visitato il Parlamento, hanno violato il nostro accordo di salvacondotto e ci hanno messo sotto processo."

units.id: mission:FWC End|	"No, the honor has been mine," he says. "Feel free to drop by and visit me on Farpoint any time you're in the area."|2433|0
units.english: "No, the honor has been mine," he says. "Feel free to drop by and visit me on Farpoint any time you're in the area."
units.italian: "No, l'onore è stato mio," dice. "Passa a trovarmi su Farpoint ogni volta che sei da queste parti."

units.id: mission:FWC End|	"Trust me," he says, "you won't need to worry about that this time around. Having an alien attack so close to Earth be thwarted through the assistance of the Free Worlds has put Parliament in a very... receptive mood. Good luck, Captain <last>, and I hope our paths will cross again."|2436|0
units.english: "Trust me," he says, "you won't need to worry about that this time around. Having an alien attack so close to Earth be thwarted through the assistance of the Free Worlds has put Parliament in a very... receptive mood. Good luck, Captain <last>, and I hope our paths will cross again."
units.italian: "Fidati," dice, "questa volta non dovrai preoccupartene. Il fatto che un attacco alieno così vicino alla Terra sia stato sventato con l'aiuto delle Free Worlds ha messo il Parlamento in un umore molto... ricettivo. Buona fortuna, capitano <last>, e spero che le nostre strade si incrocino di nuovo."

units.id: mission:FWC End|log|2440|0
units.english: Parliament has agreed to a peace treaty, because the threat of alien invasion now seems much more pressing than the civil war with the Free Worlds. Whatever the true intention of the Pug was, the result of their interference is that humanity is at peace once more. There has been great loss of life, but nothing compared to what would have happened if the Free Worlds had tried to conquer Earth.
units.italian: Il Parlamento ha accettato un trattato di pace, perché la minaccia di un'invasione aliena ora sembra molto più urgente della guerra civile con le Free Worlds. Qualunque fosse la vera intenzione dei Pug, il risultato del loro intervento è che l'umanità è di nuovo in pace. Ci sono state perdite enormi, ma nulla in confronto a quello che sarebbe successo se le Free Worlds avessero provato a conquistare la Terra.

units.id: mission:FWC End|log|2441|0
units.english: It may be a while before members of the Free Worlds manage to re-earn the trust of the rest of humanity, however.
units.italian: Potrebbe volerci un po' prima che i membri delle Free Worlds riescano a riconquistare la fiducia del resto dell'umanità.

units.id: mission:FWC End|log|2442|0
units.english: Tensions between the Free Worlds and the Republic mounted when additional systems decided to leave the Republic and join the Free Worlds culminating in a series of military confrontations, that ended when the Pug invaded human space. After humanity united to drive out the Pug invaders, the Republic officially granted the Free Worlds autonomy.
units.italian: Le tensioni fra le Free Worlds e la Repubblica crebbero quando altri sistemi decisero di lasciare la Repubblica e unirsi alle Free Worlds, culminando in una serie di scontri militari che terminarono quando i Pug invasero lo spazio umano. Dopo che l'umanità si unì per scacciare gli invasori Pug, la Repubblica concesse ufficialmente l'autonomia alle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FWC End|You arrive in the Parliament building just as Alondo and Katya have finished meeting with them. "Good news," says Katya. "We're all officially pardoned. And you, Captain <last>, have become something of a hero."|2452|0
units.english: You arrive in the Parliament building just as Alondo and Katya have finished meeting with them. "Good news," says Katya. "We're all officially pardoned. And you, Captain <last>, have become something of a hero."
units.italian: Arrivi nell'edificio del Parlamento proprio mentre Alondo e Katya hanno appena finito di incontrarli. "Buone notizie," dice Katya. "Siamo tutti ufficialmente graziati. E tu, capitano <last>, sei diventato una specie di eroe."

units.id: mission:FWC End|	"Better yet," says Alondo, "the war with the Republic is over. We agreed to limiting our territory to its current size, and to a very minor tax to cover the cost of Navy protection if the aliens attack again or some other major catastrophe strikes. In return, the Free Worlds have been granted autonomy from the Republic."|2453|0
units.english: "Better yet," says Alondo, "the war with the Republic is over. We agreed to limiting our territory to its current size, and to a very minor tax to cover the cost of Navy protection if the aliens attack again or some other major catastrophe strikes. In return, the Free Worlds have been granted autonomy from the Republic."
units.italian: "Meglio ancora," dice Alondo, "la guerra con la Repubblica è finita. Abbiamo accettato di limitare il nostro territorio alle dimensioni attuali, e una tassa molto ridotta per coprire il costo della protezione della Marina se gli alieni attaccheranno di nuovo o se capiterà qualche altra catastrofe. In cambio, alle Free Worlds è stata concessa l'autonomia dalla Repubblica."

units.id: mission:FWC End|	"Also," says Katya, "as their own expression of gratitude, the Syndicate members of Parliament have offered to make some of their new technology, developed during the war, available to us at an affordable price."|2454|0
units.english: "Also," says Katya, "as their own expression of gratitude, the Syndicate members of Parliament have offered to make some of their new technology, developed during the war, available to us at an affordable price."
units.italian: "Inoltre," dice Katya, "come loro espressione di gratitudine, i membri del Sindacato nel Parlamento hanno offerto di mettere a nostra disposizione, a un prezzo accessibile, alcune delle loro nuove tecnologie sviluppate durante la guerra."

units.id: mission:FWC End|	"That's very generous of them."|2456|0
units.english: "That's very generous of them."
units.italian: "È molto generoso da parte loro."

units.id: mission:FWC End|	"I wonder if that's their way of buying our support and keeping us quiet about the supposed defector."|2457|0
units.english: "I wonder if that's their way of buying our support and keeping us quiet about the supposed defector."
units.italian: "Mi chiedo se sia il loro modo di comprarsi il nostro sostegno e di farci stare zitti sul presunto disertore."

units.id: mission:FWC End|	"Maybe so," says Alondo. "The CEO of the Syndicate, Alastair Korban, is also resigning. Perhaps the events are related. In other news, now that the war has ended, and the Pug have been defeated, the Senate has voted to dissolve the Council, leaving us free to return to civilian life. However, they've also agreed to pay you, <first>, a reduced salary in honor of your service. So, what do you think you will do next?"|2458|0
units.english: "Maybe so," says Alondo. "The CEO of the Syndicate, Alastair Korban, is also resigning. Perhaps the events are related. In other news, now that the war has ended, and the Pug have been defeated, the Senate has voted to dissolve the Council, leaving us free to return to civilian life. However, they've also agreed to pay you, <first>, a reduced salary in honor of your service. So, what do you think you will do next?"
units.italian: "Può darsi," dice Alondo. "Anche l'amministratore delegato del Sindacato, Alastair Korban, si dimette. Forse gli eventi sono collegati. Per il resto, ora che la guerra è finita e i Pug sono stati sconfitti, il Senato ha votato per sciogliere il Consiglio, lasciandoci liberi di tornare alla vita civile. Tuttavia hanno anche accettato di pagarti, <first>, uno stipendio ridotto in onore del tuo servizio. Allora, che cosa pensi di fare adesso?"

units.id: mission:FWC End|	"Build a merchant fleet and live a safe, quiet life."|2460|0
units.english: "Build a merchant fleet and live a safe, quiet life."
units.italian: "Metterò su una flotta mercantile e vivrò una vita tranquilla e sicura."

units.id: mission:FWC End|	"See if folks in the fringe worlds need any help against the pirates."|2461|0
units.english: "See if folks in the fringe worlds need any help against the pirates."
units.italian: "Vedrò se la gente dei mondi di frontiera ha bisogno di aiuto contro i pirati."

units.id: mission:FWC End|	"Use my jump drive to explore beyond human space."|2462|0
units.english: "Use my jump drive to explore beyond human space."
units.italian: "Userò il mio motore di salto per esplorare oltre lo spazio umano."

units.id: mission:FWC End|	"Well, we all wish you the best of luck," says Freya. "We would never have won this war without you. Be sure to stay in touch." You hug each of them goodbye, and return to your ship. What you do next is up to you...|2463|0
units.english: "Well, we all wish you the best of luck," says Freya. "We would never have won this war without you. Be sure to stay in touch." You hug each of them goodbye, and return to your ship. What you do next is up to you...
units.italian: "Beh, ti auguriamo ogni bene," dice Freya. "Non avremmo mai vinto questa guerra senza di te. Mi raccomando, tieniti in contatto." Abbracci ciascuno di loro per salutarti e torni alla tua nave. Quello che farai adesso dipende da te...
